name: Technology Consultant (Senior / Manager) - Card Management & Payment Systems (FSO Consulting)
description_html:
Role Overview

EY is seeking experienced professionals to support Card Management System transformation, card migration, and payment-system implementation and integration programmes for banks and financial institutions. The role will serve as a functional subject-matter expert across card issuing, payment switching, payment fraud controls, settlement, reconciliation, clearing and delivery from requirements through go-live and stabilisation.

Primary focus: Card Management System implementation and migration; settlement and reconciliation solution design; and integration with card schemes, domestic switching networks, SNAP, BI-FAST and other payment infrastructures.

Main Responsibilities, one of the following:

Card Management System and Migration

  • Lead functional analysis, configuration and delivery for CMS/CMP implementation, enhancement and migration.
  • Design end-to-end card issuing lifecycle requirements: onboarding, product set-up, issuance, personalisation, PIN, activation, limits, renewal, replacement, blocking/hotlisting, closure and servicing.
  • Perform legacy-to-target gap analysis, data mapping and validation; define mock migrations, cutover sequencing, reconciliation controls, rollback criteria, production validation and stabilisation.
  • Analyse authorisation, clearing, settlement, reversals, adjustments, disputes and chargebacks across debit and credit card products.

Payment Systems and Integration

  • Lead functional design and integration across international card schemes (Visa/Mastercard), domestic switching networks (Rintis/Alto/Jalin/Artajasa), and payment infrastructures including SNAP, BI-FAST and RTGS.
  • Analyse and validate ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 message flows, routing rules, interfaces, APIs and exception handling; familiarity with SWIFT MT/MX is preferred.
  • Support scheme/network certification, interface testing, end-to-end testing and production readiness with client, vendor and network stakeholders.

Settlement, Reconciliation and Fraud Controls

  • Design the target settlement and reconciliation solution, including source-to-ledger data flows, matching logic, settlement cycles, fee and interchange treatment, suspense handling, exception workflows, control points, reporting and audit trails.
  • Configure and validate reconciliation, clearing and settlement rules; investigate transaction exceptions, reconciliation breaks, settlement discrepancies and production incidents.
  • Define and validate Fraud Detection / Fraud Management integration, including real-time monitoring, rules and thresholds, alerts, case workflows, investigation and reporting.
  • Perform root cause analysis and recommend remediation across process, configuration, interfaces, data and operational controls.

SIT, UAT, Migration and Delivery Governance

  • Define the SIT strategy and scope, integration scenarios, test data, traceability, entry/exit criteria, defect severity and completion evidence across CMS, switching, fraud, settlement and reconciliation interfaces.
  • Define the UAT strategy and scope, business scenarios, acceptance criteria, user roles, test data, defect triage, sign-off requirements and operational-readiness evidence.
  • Define the migration strategy and scope, including data objects, mapping and cleansing rules, reconciliation controls, mock migrations, cutover sequence, rollback criteria, acceptance and post-migration validation.
  • Gather requirements and prepare functional specifications, process flows, configuration documents, user stories, test artefacts, issue logs, operating procedures and training materials.
  • Coordinate business, operations, technology, vendors and payment networks; manage status, risks, issues, decisions and knowledge transfer. Manager candidates will lead workstreams and coach team members.

Required Qualifications And Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance or a related discipline.
  • 5–12 years of relevant experience in banking, cards, payments, transaction banking, fintech, payment processing or financial-services technology.
  • Hands-on experience with CMS/CMP, debit/credit card issuing, card migration and payment-system integration.
  • Strong knowledge of the card issuing and transaction lifecycles, including authorisation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, reversals, adjustments, disputes and chargebacks.
  • Experience with Visa/Mastercard and Rintis/Alto/Jalin/Artajasa, with familiarity in SNAP and BI-FAST.
  • Hands-on experience in a PCI-DSS-compliant system or cardholder-data environment.
  • Experience with Fraud Detection / Fraud Management systems, including transaction monitoring, rules, alerts, cases and investigation workflows.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 8583 and ISO 20022; familiarity with SWIFT and RTGS.
  • Strong business analysis, structured problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Prior experience in one or more delivery roles: Project Manager, Solution Architect, Business Analyst, or Quality Assurance / Test Lead.
  • Card scheme or payment-network certification; issuer, acquirer, switch, payment hub, settlement or reconciliation-engine implementation.
  • Experience with recognised card platforms such as HPS PowerCARD, OpenWay Way4, VisionPLUS, PRIME, TSYS, FIS, Fiserv, Compass Plus or comparable solutions.
  • Experience leading workshops and workstreams in complex, multi-vendor delivery environments.

Success profile

A credible functional consultant who combines deep cards and payments knowledge with disciplined solution design and delivery. The candidate should connect business, operations, technology, vendors and payment networks, while maintaining clear requirements, controls, traceability and acceptance evidence.

EY values diversity, collaboration, integrity and a commitment to building a better working world.

Candidates who meet more than 1 criterias above are encouraged to apply.

name: Senior Specialist, Impact & Reporting
description_html:
About the role

The Senior Specialist, Impact & Reporting serves as the critical anchor for data workstreams within the Science & Impact (S&I) team, coordinating daily project-to-S&I data workflows. This position is responsible for ensuring the accurate, consistent, and timely collection, validation, and reporting of data across both offsetting and insetting projects, encompassing carbon, biodiversity, community, social, and project implementation reporting requirements.


Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Senior Specialist manages end-to-end data pipelines from field teams, executes advanced QA/QC protocols, and ensures data readiness for carbon accounting and formal verification. This role goes beyond basic task execution to actively manage reporting workstreams, solve non-routine data complexities under moderate ambiguity, track issue resolution, and pre-emptively mitigate reporting risks. You will act as a trusted cross-functional bridge between corporate frameworks and field operations, representing the S&I function confidently in operational and audit discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Workstream Ownership & Data Flow Coordination

  • Manage the day-to-day data collection and processing workstreams for community, climate, and biodiversity (CCB) metrics across the project portfolio.
  • Act as the primary cross-functional focal point, aligning corporate reporting frameworks with field realities, coordinating closely with Program Management and field teams.
  • Maintain responsibility for the quality, completeness, and timeliness of incoming project data, proactively resolving field collection bottlenecks.
  • Support the implementation of defined impact indicators in the field, ensuring alignment between methodology definitions, digital tools, and centralized datasets


Process Optimization & Capacity Building

  • Implement and continuously improve data collection workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for CCB and social indicators to handle non-routine field complexities.
  • Design and deliver technical training, guidelines, and toolkits for Program Management and field teams to ensure standardized data entry.
  • Promote a shared understanding of data integrity standards across cross-functional teams to minimize data friction at the source.


Dashboard Administration & Systems Oversight

  • Oversee and validate data integration into internal dashboards and management information systems covering core environmental and social metrics.
  • Structure and organize complex data repositories to ensure they are clean, highly accessible, and optimized for carbon accounting, reporting, and strategic decision-making.
  • Coordinate collaborative workstreams with GIS and IT/Digital teams to build, iterate, and refine impact data visualization dashboards


Advanced QA/QC & Risk Management

  • Execute advanced QA/QC protocols on multi-source field data (including community surveys, forest inventory measurements, biodiversity logs, and climate data).

name: Performance Marketing Analyst
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000311

About The Team

We are building a performance marketing organization where every dollar of spend is justified by evidence, not intuition. As an Analyst, you will support our Metasearch channel across APAC markets and help decide where we put our growth budget.

Job Summary

Metasearch is different from other performance channels. We sell inventory, not ads. Results depend on pricing, inventory and the full funnel, so you will work closely with business units, not only with marketers.

You will turn data into decisions: tracking performance, running tests to measure incremental impact, and giving the team clear recommendations. You will own specific problems and see them through, not only report numbers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own your analysis. Take ownership of defined problems in the Metasearch portfolio, such as bid efficiency, market performance and funnel drop-off. Follow them through to a recommendation and the result.
  • Support experimentation. Help design, run and read tests (A/B, geo holdouts, audience splits, lift studies). Check that results are sound before they inform a decision.
  • Connect the funnel. Track performance from traffic through to bookings and margin. Flag where pricing, inventory or availability is limiting results.
  • Partner with the business. Work with commercial, supply and pricing teams to understand constraints and bring those insights into channel decisions.
  • Be data-fluent. Frame the right questions, use SQL or AI-assisted queries to get answers, and validate the output yourself.
  • Build the reporting rhythm. Maintain dashboards and regular reporting. Identify manual work that should be automated and work with analytics and engineering to fix it.
  • Communicate clearly. Turn analysis into short narratives that managers and non-marketers can act on.

Job Requirements

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in an analytically demanding role. Relevant backgrounds include business analysis, growth, performance marketing (in-house preferred), product, revenue management and pricing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (STEM preferred), or strong demonstrated quantitative ability in another discipline.
  • Working knowledge of analytical techniques such as regression, incrementality testing, split testing and holdouts, and the ability to apply them to real business problems.
  • Evidence of owning a business problem over time, not only producing analysis on request.
  • Understanding of the end-to-end funnel and how channel activity ties to business output.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting findings to senior stakeholders.

Strong Plus

  • Exposure to Metasearch (Skyscanner, Kayak, Trivago, Google Hotel Ads) or other paid channels.
  • Experience working with pricing, inventory or supply team
  • Familiarity with incrementality measurement or causal inference.
  • Background in travel, hospitality, e-commerce, marketplace or another high-volume transactional business.
  • Hands-on SQL, BI tool fluency (Tableau, Looker, Data Studio) or scripting (Python, R).
  • Multi-market or APAC regional experience.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Systems

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Design API-First Architecture

Integrate the Ecosystem

Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other strategic partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Scale Infrastructure

Deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure designed for reliability, performance, and global growth across multiple property management businesses.

Solve Complex Operational Problems

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

name: Senior Backend Engineer
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000334

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

We are the engineers behind the part of the trip people actually remember. Travel Activities powers Traveloka's experiences business — attraction tickets, guided tours, cruises, and local experiences across Southeast Asia and beyond. You will build the systems that turn a fragmented, messy supply landscape into something a traveller books in seconds: search and inventory that span thousands of operators, booking flows tuned for eleven markets, and apps that work on the phone in someone's hand at the gate of a theme park.

Whether you write backend, frontend, or mobile, you ship to millions and see the impact in real bookings. We move fast, lean hard into AI to scale what we build, and partner with world-class brands. If you want product rigour and commercial creativity in equal measure — not a Western playbook, but a new one written for this region — this is your team.

About The Job

As a Senior Backend Engineer on Traveloka's Travel Activities team, you are a technical expert who designs the systems your area is built on and sets the technical direction others build against, with direct impact on the domain's results.

  • Design and ship multi-service systems for Travel Activities, owning the system-level consistency, latency, and cost tradeoffs, and lead deep architecture work that spans services and teams, untangling complex trade-offs across performance, cost, and correctness
  • Decompose an ambiguous product problem into a service architecture, API contracts, and a plan others can execute
  • Set the technical bar through rigorous, constructive review, and shape the APIs other teams build against cleanly
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through review and pairing, growing their judgment without managing them
  • Act as senior on-call authority on your systems, killing whole classes of incidents through durable design, not patching
  • Influence the engineering roadmap with technical proposals that shape what the wider team builds next
  • Direct how the team uses AI tools in its workflow, judging where they speed delivery and where they introduce risk

Job Requirements

  • You have at least 6 years of backend engineering — and your judgment on system design now comes from having built and operated systems, however you got there.
  • You have designed a system that spans multiple services from scratch, and it has held up in production.
  • You own the consistency, latency, and cost tradeoffs at the system level, not just within one service.
  • You can take an ambiguous product problem and decompose it into a clean service architecture.
  • You produce clear API contracts and a delivery plan others can execute.
  • You have owned a system through real scale growth or a reliability turnaround.
  • You can point to the architectural decisions that made it hold.
  • You set the technical bar for an area through rigorous, constructive review, and engineers around you get better because of how you review and design.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent depth from real-world engineering.
  • You mentor junior to middle-level engineers deliberately — you grow their judgment, not just unblock their tickets.
  • You partner with Product to map technical dependencies and shape APIs and integrations that other teams build against cleanly.
  • You set how your team uses AI tools in its workflow.
  • You can judge where they accelerate delivery and where they introduce risk worth guarding against.

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

name: Software Engineer
description_html:
Job Objective

Your role as Software Engineer is to independently design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack software solutions across backend and frontend layers. You will own assigned features from requirement analysis through implementation, integration, QA handover, and production support, while ensuring solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with established engineering standards.


Main Tasks

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, business logic, data processing, frontend applications, dashboards, portals, forms, reporting screens, internal tools, and reusable components.
  • Own assigned features from requirement analysis through development, testing support, QA handover, defect resolution, and production support, with limited supervision.
  • Implement complete end-to-end features covering frontend user interactions, backend processing, PostgreSQL data persistence, event queue processing, integrations, and final user or system responses.
  • Design and consume REST APIs, including request and response models, validations, authentication, authorization, error handling, and appropriate integration behavior.
  • Implement and maintain integration flows with internal services, operators, aggregators, third-party systems, callbacks, and webhooks, ensuring proper error handling and operational visibility.
  • Develop and validate PostgreSQL queries and database interactions, including transaction behavior, indexing, constraints, data persistence, and consistency requirements for assigned features.
  • Implement and support RabbitMQ and event-driven workflows, including event publishing, message consumption, payload validation, retries, dead-letter handling awareness, logging, and queue-processing monitoring.
  • Implement and support asynchronous workflows such as notifications, billing triggers, delivery reports, background jobs, audit events, and integration callbacks according to system requirements.
  • Analyze business and technical requirements, identify implementation gaps and dependencies, and propose appropriate technical approaches for assigned features before development.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across backend services, APIs, frontend behavior, PostgreSQL results, event queues, integrations, asynchronous processes, and end-to-end application flows.
  • Perform unit testing, support integration and regression testing, resolve identified defects, and validate implemented changes before QA handover and release.
  • Optimize standard application performance, including API response times, frontend rendering behavior, PostgreSQL queries, database interactions, and event-processing efficiency.
  • Collaborate with QA, Product, DevOps, Support, Security, and other engineering teams to resolve dependencies and ensure smooth end-to-end delivery.
  • Provide basic technical guidance to Junior Software Engineers when required and support them in resolving straightforward development and troubleshooting issues.
  • Escalate complex architectural, scalability, security, performance, event-driven design, and production-critical concerns to Senior or Lead Software Engineers when required.
  • Maintain technical documentation covering APIs, integrations, frontend components, database interactions, event flows, application workflows, configurations, and known technical limitations.
  • Ensure development activities comply with Jira traceability, Git and branching practices, pull request and code review requirements, SonarQube validation, secure coding, documentation, and release standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in software development across backend and frontend applications.
  • Hands-on experience developing and integrating APIs, databases, and full-stack application features.
  • Experience with database-driven applications, event-driven or asynchronous processing, and system integrations.
  • Exposure to messaging, real-time, high-volume, or integration-heavy platforms is considered an advantage.
  • Professional proficiency in Local Language and English is required.
  • Good hands-on knowledge of backend development using Java or C#.NET and frontend development using React and Next.js.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, authentication, authorization, integration patterns, callbacks, webhooks, and error handling.
  • Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL queries, transactions, indexing fundamentals, constraints, data persistence, and validation.
  • Good understanding of RabbitMQ or similar event-queuing technologies, including producers, consumers, message handling, retries, dead-letter concepts, and asynchronous processing.
  • Ability to independently develop and troubleshoot complete features across backend, frontend, database, integration, and event-processing layers.
  • Good knowledge of Git workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and development traceability.

name: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
description_html:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

What You Will Do

  • Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself
  • Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits
  • Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten
  • Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix
  • Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit
  • Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted

Who You Are

  • You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you
  • High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start
  • Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts
  • Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you
  • Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully
  • Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point

Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect at This Level

  • 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained
  • Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here
  • Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher
  • Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation
  • Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one

Not Suitable for the Role If...

  • You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build
  • You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes
  • You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger
  • You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product
  • You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform

Why CoverGo

Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • 100% Remote Work
  • Paid Annual Leave
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Company Activities and Events
  • Learning and Development Plan

CoverGo Company Video

Posisi ini memegang peranan penting dalam membangun antarmuka pengguna (user interface) yang cepat, intuitif, responsif, serta terintegrasi secara mulus dengan sistem backend guna mendukung operasional aplikasi web modern.

Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman solid dalam ekosistem Laravel dan Next.js/React, mahir menerjemahkan desain menjadi kode antarmuka yang presisi, serta terbiasa bekerja secara kolaboratif dalam tim yang dinamis, kami mengundang Anda untuk menjadi bagian dari tim kami.

Informasi Posisi

  • Posisi: Frontend Developer (Laravel/Next.JS)
  • Lokasi Kerja: Hybrid - Sidoarjo
  • Status Kerja: Full-time
  • Level Posisi: Middle Level

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Sebagai Frontend Developer, Anda Akan Berkontribusi Langsung Pada Tampilan Visual Dan Interaksi Pengguna Di Aplikasi Kami, Dengan Tanggung Jawab Utama Meliputi

  • Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan antarmuka aplikasi web yang responsif dan interaktif menggunakan Laravel (Blade / Inertia.js) dan Next.js / React.js.
  • Menerjemahkan desain UI/UX dari Figma menjadi kode frontend yang presisi (pixel-perfect), terstruktur, dan mudah dipelihara.
  • Melakukan integrasi antarmuka dengan layanan RESTful API atau GraphQL yang disediakan oleh tim backend.
  • Melakukan optimasi performa rendering, efisiensi pemuatan halaman (page load speed), dan fleksibilitas tampilan di berbagai ukuran layar (responsive web design).
  • Melakukan pemeliharaan kode, debugging, serta code review guna memastikan standar kualitas kode (clean code) dan kompatibilitas cross-browser.
  • Bekerja sama secara erat dengan UI/UX Designer, Backend Developer, dan Quality Assurance (QA) dalam siklus pengembangan sistem.

Target utama posisi ini adalah mengeksekusi pengembangan frontend yang responsif, cepat, dan sesuai spesifikasi desain antarmuka, mematuhi standar best practice, serta memberikan pengalaman pengguna (user experience) yang optimal.

Requirement

Kualifikasi

Pendidikan S1/D3 Di Bidang

  • Teknik Informatika
  • Sistem Informasi
  • Ilmu Komputer

Atau bidang terkait yang relevan

Pengalaman

Minimal 1–3 Tahun Pengalaman Pada Posisi

  • Frontend Developer / Web Developer
  • Software Engineer (Frontend Focus)

Kemampuan Teknis

Kandidat Diharapkan Memiliki Penguasaan Terkait

  • Penguasaan mendalam pada ekosistem Next.js / React.js (Server-Side Rendering, Static Site Generation, State Management).
  • Penguasaan pada ekosistem Laravel (Blade Templating, Inertia.js, Vite/Mix integration).
  • Mahir dalam HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), dan TypeScript.
  • Penguasaan styling framework modern seperti Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, atau UI Component Libraries (Shadcn/UI, MUI, Ant Design).
  • Pengalaman dalam mengonsumsi dan mengintegrasikan REST API, penanganan kueri asinkron (async/await, Axios/Fetch), serta otentikasi (JWT/Sanctum).
  • Pemahaman dalam penggunaan version control system (Git, GitHub, GitLab).

Soft Skill

  • Ketelitian tinggi terhadap detail tata letak visual (eye for detail) dan kepresisian desain.
  • Kemampuan analisis dan problem solving yang baik dalam mendiagnosis masalah tampilan atau integrasi API.
  • Komunikasi yang proaktif dan kolaboratif dengan tim UI/UX, Backend Developer, dan QA.
  • Keinginan yang kuat untuk terus belajar (eagerness to learn) dan mengikuti perkembangan teknologi frontend.

Target Kinerja

Dalam Posisi Ini Anda Diharapkan Mampu

  • Menyelesaikan implementasi modul tampilan tepat waktu sesuai dengan target sprint atau timeline proyek.
  • Menerjemahkan prototipe desain UI/UX menjadi tampilan aplikasi yang presisi dengan minim pergeseran layout.
  • Memastikan performa pemuatan halaman dan responsivitas aplikasi berjalan optimal di berbagai perangkat dan browser.

Nilai Tambah

Kandidat Dengan Pengalaman Berikut Akan Menjadi Prioritas

  • Pengalaman menggunakan Inertia.js untuk menjembatani Laravel dan React secara monolith-modern.
  • Pemahaman dasar mengenai optimasi SEO, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), serta teknik caching/state management lanjutan (Redux, React Query, Zustand).
  • Memiliki portofolio aplikasi web berbasis Next.js atau Laravel yang sudah beroperasi di lingkungan production.

Mengapa Bergabung Dengan Vascomm?

  • Kesempatan untuk terlibat langsung dalam pengembangan berbagai aplikasi web berskala enterprise.
  • Pengalaman bekerja dengan modern tech stack dan standar arsitektur kode yang terstruktur.
  • Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif, suportif, dan memberikan ruang bagi Anda untuk berkembang secara profesional.

name: Fullstack Developer (E-commerce)
description_html:
An exciting opportunity awaits for a Fullstack Developer to join a renowned leader in the Indonesian food and beverage distribution sector, based in Bekasi, West Java.

Fullstack Developer

Salary: Competitive and based on experience

Location: Bekasi, West Java

Keywords: fullstack development, web applications, mobile experience, Javascript NodeJS NextJS, collaborative environment, food and beverage industry, distribution network, inclusive workplace, growth opportunities

This role offers you the chance to work at the heart of a company that has been connecting international and local brands with millions of consumers across Indonesia for decades. You will be part of a supportive team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal growth, all within an inclusive and welcoming environment. If you are passionate about building robust web solutions and eager to contribute to projects that reach across retail, wholesale, catering, healthcare, and more, this is the perfect place for you to thrive.

  • Join a well-established organisation with a rich history in food and beverage distribution, offering stability and long-term career prospects as you help shape their digital future.
  • Work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in an environment that encourages teamwork, open communication, and continuous learning through training opportunities tailored to your professional development.
  • Enjoy the benefits of flexible working arrangements while contributing to impactful projects that support essential supply chains serving communities throughout Indonesia.

What you'll do:

As a Fullstack Developer based in Bekasi, West Java, you will play an integral role in driving forward the digital capabilities of one of Indonesia's most respected food and beverage distributors. Your day-to-day activities will involve collaborating with talented professionals from various departments to create robust web applications using PHP (Laravel) alongside Javascript technologies like NodeJS and NextJS. You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas during project planning sessions, participate in code reviews that promote knowledge sharing, and ensure all solutions are secure and reliable. By supporting both web-based systems-and potentially mobile integrations-you will help streamline operations across multiple distribution channels. Your commitment to clear documentation and ongoing learning will not only enhance your own skills but also strengthen the collective expertise of your team.

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality web applications using PHP (Laravel) as well as Javascript frameworks such as NodeJS and NextJS, ensuring seamless user experiences across platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver reliable solutions that meet business requirements.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and sharing best practices to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues efficiently by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions to minimise downtime or disruption for users.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of new features or enhancements by translating functional requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Ensure all software developed adheres to security standards and data protection regulations relevant to the food and beverage industry.
  • Support integration efforts between web applications and mobile platforms where required, leveraging your experience or willingness to learn mobile technologies.
  • Document technical processes clearly so that knowledge can be shared easily among team members for ongoing maintenance or future upgrades.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging trends in fullstack development by participating in training sessions or self-directed learning initiatives provided by the company.

What you bring:

To excel as a Fullstack Developer in this organisation, you will bring hands-on experience building scalable web applications using PHP (Laravel) combined with advanced Javascript skills-particularly with NodeJS for backend services and NextJS for frontend development. Your background should include working effectively within collaborative teams where interpersonal skills are highly valued. A keen eye for detail when it comes to troubleshooting ensures smooth operation of critical systems supporting diverse business functions. While prior exposure to mobile app development is advantageous, what matters most is your openness to learning new tools as needed. Your approach should reflect a commitment to best practices around security, documentation, and continuous improvement-qualities that will help you succeed in an environment dedicated to delivering excellence across Indonesia's food supply chain.

  • Proven experience developing fullstack web applications using PHP (Laravel), demonstrating strong understanding of backend architecture and database management.
  • Solid proficiency with Javascript frameworks such as NodeJS for server-side logic and NextJS for building modern frontend interfaces.
  • Familiarity with responsive design principles ensuring optimal performance across desktop and mobile devices.
  • Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams where open communication is valued.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues methodically while maintaining a positive attitude towards problem-solving.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies or expand into mobile application development if required by project needs.
  • Commitment to writing clean, maintainable code supported by thorough documentation for ease of future updates or handovers.
  • Understanding of security best practices relevant to handling sensitive data within large-scale distribution networks.
  • Enthusiasm for participating in ongoing training opportunities aimed at enhancing both technical skills and industry knowledge.

What sets this company apart:

This organisation stands out as one of Indonesia's premier food and beverage distributors-a trusted partner connecting global brands with local markets since the 1970s. As part of a larger group renowned for its commitment to quality service delivery, you'll benefit from being part of an enterprise that values every employee's contribution. The company operates an extensive refrigerated distribution network from its main base, ensuring products reach customers safely across retail, wholesale, QSR, catering, healthcare channels, and beyond. Whether you're looking for stability or opportunities for advancement within a supportive environment-this is an ideal place for those who want their work to have real-world impact while growing professionally alongside passionate colleagues.

What's next:

If you are ready to take your fullstack development career further within an organisation making a difference every day across Indonesia's food landscape-this is your moment!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided-your next rewarding challenge awaits!

Due to the high volume of applications we are experiencing, our team will only be in touch with you if your application is shortlisted.

name: Senior Frontend Engineer
description_html:
Are you a talented Senior Frontend Engineer looking to take the next step in your career? Do you want to be part of building and enhancing ECCO’s global digital B2B customer experience?

Then you could be the person we are looking for as our new Senior Frontend Engineer.


Join our Digital Showroom team and play a key role in shaping the future of ECCO’s global B2B eCommerce platform. You will have the opportunity to build scalable, high-performance, and user-friendly digital experiences using Angular and NestJS, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that support business growth and customer engagement worldwide.


Job Summary


As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Digital Showroom team, you help shape the future of

our digital B2B customer experience. You will play a key role in building performant, scalable,

and user-friendly interfaces using Angular and NestJS (Node.js). This is a high-impact role

where your work will directly influence customer engagement and conversion across our

global B2B platform.


Duties and Responsibilities


In your new position as our Senior Frontend Engineer, you will have a critical role in the above and you will have the following main responsibilities:


  • Lead the development of new features and enhancements for our B2B eCommerce platform using Angular and NestJS.
  • Design and implement scalable frontend architecture and reusable components with focus on performance and scalability.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with the Nest.js Backend For Frontend (BFF) and backend services, collaborating with product owner, designers and backend engineers.
  • Implement and maintain automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Monitor and optimize application performance, reliability, and security.
  • Proactively Identify, prioritize, and address technical debt.
  • Stay up to date with the latest technologies, trends, and advocate for best engineering practices


Experiences & Requirements

  • 5+ years of frontend development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Angular and NestJS.
  • Proficient in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS/SASS.
  • Experience with Angular routing, state management, RxJS, and component architecture.
  • Familiar with headless CMS, GraphQL/REST APIs, and eCommerce platforms.
  • Strong understanding of application performance, security, and reliability.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (Playwright/Jest), and production deployments.
  • Able to troubleshoot production issues and deliver features across Angular and NestJS.
  • Experience with Azure, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with Kendo UI or similar component libraries.
  • Knowledge of React/Next.js and application modernization.
  • Able to communicate effectively in English.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented and well-organized.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and adaptable.
  • Collaborative team player who values knowledge sharing.
  • Committed to delivering high-quality results.


Join a global team that feels local

At ECCO, you’ll be part of a friendly, international workplace where people care about each other and the work we do. You’ll help shape people practices that make a real difference – and enjoy great colleagues, meaningful challenges – and yes, you’ll get a nice discount on the shoes.


Are you ready for your next chalange

We will invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not hesitate to apply. Imagining yourself at ECCO? Get a glimpse of what your new exciting career entails on https://enter.ecco.com.


CREATE THE FOOTPRINTS OF TOMORROW

At ECCO, you become part of a meaningful, developing and multicultural workplace. You join a global family of more than 23,000 people who are proud to create the footprints of tomorrow. Headquartered in Denmark, we are a family-owned company that offers international opportunities. Our offices and facilities have an informal culture and relaxed dress code - our shoe code is slightly stricter.Join us and we guarantee lifelong learning - the speed of progress is up to you. So, if you´re curious, passionate and ready to make an impact, you´ll fit right in.

Bandung Full-time 09.00–17.00 WIB 1–2 tahun pengalaman

Tentang Peran Ini

Fullstack Developer berperan dalam merancang, mengembangkan, dan memelihara sistem aplikasi end-to-end yang digunakan dalam operasional perusahaan. Posisi ini bertanggung jawab memastikan pengembangan berjalan secara scalable, efisien, dan sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis.

Peran ini tidak hanya berfokus pada coding, tetapi juga mencakup perancangan arsitektur sistem, kolaborasi lintas tim, serta kontribusi dalam pengambilan keputusan teknis.

Fullstack Developer akan terlibat dalam pengembangan berbagai produk digital perusahaan, baik internal tools maupun produk eksternal, serta memastikan kualitas dan keberlanjutan sistem yang dibangun.

Peran ini ideal bagi kandidat yang memiliki kemampuan problem solving yang kuat, berpikir sistematis, serta mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim dengan standar profesional tinggi.

name: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description_html:
Bandung, Indonesia

  • Full-Time

About The Role

We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who is passionate about building impactful solutions that transform education. This role requires strong skills across both front-end and back-end, with the ability to design, build, and scale applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with our mission.

You'll build end-to-end across our stack, working heavily with AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) — which means you'll direct that work, review it critically, and own the correctness and quality of what ships, front to back. We value adaptability, ownership, and a strong learning attitude.

Our stack: Next.js + React (TypeScript, Tailwind) on the front end

  • Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI on the back end
  • MongoDB + Redis
  • Git + CI/CD
  • GCP. These are deliberate, AI-friendly choices, so you can move fast and still review with confidence.

Before You Apply

This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You'll handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision — including code an AI agent drafted and you made correct. You must stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your work, and deliver reliable outputs even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround.

If you want a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Stack Development

  • Design and build front-end and back-end features for web and mobile: responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js/React, and scalable APIs and services in Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI.
  • Own features end-to-end — data model to UI — with sound design decisions and rigorous testing.
  • Work with MongoDB and Redis for reliable, performant data and state.

AI-Assisted Development & Oversight

  • Direct Claude Code and other AI tools to build features fast, writing clear specs and prompts.
  • Review and refine AI-generated code across the stack; you're accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability — not the AI.
  • Set conventions and tests that keep AI output consistent and safe to ship.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner with product, design, and program teams to turn requirements into effective solutions.
  • Take part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, keep CI/CD deployments fast and safe, and provide prompt support for live systems.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years as a full-stack developer shipping applications in production.
  • Front end: proficiency with Next.js/React and TypeScript (Tailwind or similar).
  • Back end: strong skills in Node.js/Express and/or Python/FastAPI; comfortable with Next.js server-side code. (Depth on one end plus solid range across the rest is fine — you don't need to be an expert in everything.)
  • Experience with MongoDB and Redis, and sound API design.
  • Disciplined testing, plus Git and CI/CD.
  • Ability to direct AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) and critically review their output — strong enough to catch what the AI gets wrong.
  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently under pressure.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Containerized deployments (Docker or similar).
  • Experience with AI/ML or data-driven applications.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD beyond the basics.
  • A real knack for prompt and workflow design with agentic coding tools.
  • Experience in edtech, mission-driven, or non-profit projects.

Why Join Us?

You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for routine work, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to build end-to-end solutions that matter and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

name: Senior Frontend Engineer
description_html:
About WegoPro

WegoPro is the business travel platform built for modern companies. We help organisations simplify and control corporate travel by bringing together booking, approvals, policy, payments, and reporting into one intelligent platform. As part of the Wego Group, we're combining deep travel expertise with AI-first product development to redefine how businesses travel.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build the frontend platform that powers WegoPro. You'll work on a sophisticated, data-rich product used every day by travel managers, finance teams, and business travellers around the world.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with significant technical ownership. You'll shape our frontend architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor other developers, and build AI-powered experiences that make complex workflows feel intuitive.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture and evolution of our frontend platform, including our design system, application state, routing, build tooling, and performance.
  • Build scalable frontend systems on top of a microservices architecture, designing resilient API integrations, caching strategies, and graceful fallbacks when services fail.
  • Develop AI-powered product experiences, including conversational booking, agentic workflows, and streaming interfaces that make AI interactions feel reliable and trustworthy.
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development, helping define best practices for using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex across the engineering team.
  • Lead technical design discussions, perform thoughtful code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the quality of the team's work.
  • Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications.
  • Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of Vue's reactivity model.
  • Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite, code splitting, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals.
  • Excellent frontend engineering fundamentals, with a passion for building polished, accessible, responsive user interfaces.
  • Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgement about where they accelerate development and where they don't.
  • Familiarity with modern AI application development, including MCP, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and shipping user-facing AI features.
  • Practical experience with AWS services including S3, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS, CI/CD pipelines, and feature flagging.
  • Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a bias for ownership, delivery, and continuous improvement.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building products in business travel, fintech, or B2B SaaS.
  • Experience with micro-frontend architectures.
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems.
  • Contributions to open-source projects in the Vue or AI tooling ecosystem.

Why Join WegoPro?

At WegoPro, you'll solve meaningful engineering challenges spanning global travel inventory, multi-currency pricing, enterprise policy engines, and large-scale integrations. You'll join a highly collaborative team where engineers have real ownership, technical decisions have lasting impact, and modern AI tooling is embedded into the way we build software every day.

If you're excited by complex frontend engineering, AI-native product development, and building software that powers business travel at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

You will own features or product areas end to end - from specification, to delivery, QA, customer feedback etc. If you are someone who likes to work with an early stage startup that is building a SAAS product from scratch and solving customers' challenges, this is an amazing opportunity.

  • Lead architecture design and set standards for future growth: Research and identify industry best practices and state-of-the-art tools to leverage.
  • Influence the features and direction of the platform with your own ideas and proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes and customer satisfaction.

Who You Are

  • You resonate with our mission to promote greater mental wellbeing in workplaces.

  • Entrepreneurial spirit. You have worked in a startup or on your own side projects or built products from the ground up.

Bonus If You Have

  • Experience in building dashboard products.
  • Good exposure to security best practices, bonus: experience working with security constraints such as HIPAA.

Benefits

  • The chance to drive impact within the mental healthcare landscape in Asia and Pacific region.
  • The opportunity to help build a rapidly scaling start-up organization by taking strong ownership of your work, mentorship, and our unbounded leadership opportunities.

name: Frontend Engineer (Contract Basis)

  • Duration: 24 months fixed term (subject to change based on business needs)

The Role

Senior

description_html:

Web Designer / Developer

About KyLeads

Our customers refer to us as the all-in-one lead generation and customer feedback platform. We create survey, popup, and quiz software to help our customers reach their goals of building better businesses – faster.

Our team calls us the most chill place to work and build impactful products while having a meaningful stake in the outcome. You know, you’re more than just a cog in the machine. You should know us as a rapidly growing software company that takes care of its people while giving them room to grow and develop.

Job Description

We believe design is life and as our web designer/developer, you play a key role in translating our go-to-market strategy into visual branding that nurtures leads into long-term, successful customers. You’ll hold primary responsibility for designing and developing our marketing website. This includes design, both graphic and layout, and website development.

You’ll represent the KyLeads brand across many visual design projects and mediums which could include anything from landing pages, ultimate guide micro-sites, interactive tools, blog posts, and other things we haven’t thought up yet. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the best designers, marketers, and strategists in the industry.

The story of KyLeads is the story of real people that approach their work as art. Each member of our team consistently strives for excellence, and always seeks to perform at the top of their field. When we build things, we do it for the sake of the art just as much as for the sake of the project. We believe great marketing is only truly as great as the design that complements it.

A Web Designer At KyLeads Will

  • Serve a key role in holding primary responsibility for KyLeads marketing website and its related properties.
  • Create conversion-optimized landing pages, micro-sites, WordPress templates, interactive tools and more from the ground-up: from strategy and wireframes, to design and web development.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize the technical aspects of our WordPress CMS.
  • Measure key performance indicators by implementing event-driven analytics to evaluate the success of your designs and offer strategic suggestions to improve results. What we ship is only as good as the results it produces.
  • Collaborate with team members to understand goals, and build environments that empower the team to self-serve as often as possible without needing your assistance. Understand how to build templates and frameworks that help you scale yourself.
  • Demo work in process and proactively seek feedback with a positive outlook. Develop multiple versions of wireframes, layouts, and designs as necessary from which to receive feedback.
  • Conduct graphic (Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe Suite) and layout design, while keeping conversion design in mind.
  • Design front-end web components using HTML and CSS; also utilizing JavaScript, jQuery, and PHP.
  • Develop and optimize interaction with back-end databases and APIs.
  • Support Product Marketing in brand positioning and strategic marketing initiatives, as well as all marketing teams.
  • Create consistent visual designs (graphics, logos, illustrations, etc.) across various promotions.
  • Stay (and keep us) up to date on design, brand, and marketing trends.
  • You ship every day.

We have a multidisciplinary team that works across design, front-end, and back-end. It’s what keeps us agile and competitive. We don’t want a candidate that’s too specialized in one area. The successful team member will be able to do many things well and they’re always open to learning.

Words we hate: “That’s not my job."

Requirements

The Musts:

  • You have 4+ years’ experience in visual design, website design, and/or website development.
  • You have a portfolio showcasing a breadth of creative work; must include web design and/or development examples.
  • You get digital marketing - PPC, SEM, SEO, AdWords, Conversion Optimization, CRM’s, and any other acronym we throw at you.
  • You are creative, flexible, detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and handle constructive feedback well.
  • You can work well with a team and give constructive feedback.
  • Work well with other designers and cross-functional team members.
  • You understand and produce ROI on great design.
  • You are proficient in Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You have experience with front-end development and a strong knowledge of HTML/CSS.
  • You are self-motivated, take initiative, and are a team player.
  • You have a bachelor's degree or equal experience.
  • You complete all other duties as assigned.

The “important but not deal breakers”

  • BS/MS in Visual Design, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or related field.
  • Mobile design experience.
  • You love building websites from start to finish
  • Experience working with SaaS applications
  • Comfortable with user testing
  • Experience with A/B testing, monitoring, and analytics.
  • Experience working with marketing teams
  • Experience with WordPress, PHP, JavaScript/jQuery
  • Understanding of code versioning tools such as Git.

Benefits

Some of the goodies you get when you work at KyLeads:

  • Full benefits package with vision, dental, and medical.
  • Sick and vacation days
  • Yearly learning allowance
  • Partial payment to go back and get a formal degree
  • Casual Fridays (and probably some other days)
  • Free wi-fi and an internet allowance (for those days when you’re working from home)

name: Android Engineer (Flutter)
description_html:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Android Engineer to build fast, reliable, and maintainable applications used daily in our electric mobility and battery-swap ecosystem. You will ship features end-to-end using Flutter across Android, iOS, and Web — ensuring great experience, high performance, and scalability as we grow.

What You Will Do

  • Build and ship end-to-end product features in Flutter for Android, iOS, and Web.

  • Translate product requirements into production-ready UI/UX flows, reusable widgets, and clean architecture.

  • Implement state management, data fetching, and API integrations (REST/GraphQL/WebSockets).

  • Own app performance and reliability through profiling and proactive optimization.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Backend, and QA to ensure seamless delivery.

  • Maintain code quality via reviews, testing, and CI/CD best practices (feature flags, safe rollout).

  • Monitor app health using Firebase tools (Crashlytics, Performance, Analytics) and iterate continuously.

  • Contribute to and expand Flutter Design System (component library, theming) for consistency across products.

What You BringExperience

  • 5+ years developing production-scale apps; 3+ years hands-on with Flutter/Dart.

  • Demonstrated success delivering features across multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Web).

  • Experience with other frontend frameworks (React Native/React/Next.js) and Android native (Kotlin) is a strong plus.

Skills

  • Strong in state management patterns (Bloc/Cubit, Riverpod, Provider, etc.).

  • Skilled in API integration using Dio/Retrofit/http with robust error handling and caching.

  • Solid UI/UX execution: responsive layouts, animations, accessibility, theming.

  • CI/CD awareness (GitHub Actions) and release workflows (multi-flavor, environment configs).

  • Firebase knowledge: Auth, Firestore, Crashlytics, Performance, Analytics, Remote Config.

  • Competent with Flutter DevTools for performance/memory/network debugging.

  • Strong communication and teamwork with cross-functional partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or maintaining a Flutter Design System (design tokens, reusable components).

  • Knowledge of Flutter Web deployment nuances (routing, asset optimization, web constraints).

  • Comfortable using AI-driven tooling to improve developer productivity (assistants, auto-tests, code suggestions).

name: Frontend Developer SEO - Contract Based - ADMO
description_html:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Desain Arsitektur

  • Merancang dan mengembangkan arsitektur solusi frontend yang memenuhi kebutuhan produk, skalabilitas, dan tujuan kinerja.
  • Menetapkan dan menegakkan standar pengkodean, praktik terbaik, dan prinsip arsitektur untuk pengembangan frontend.
  • Mengevaluasi dan memilih teknologi, framework, dan library frontend yang tepat untuk digunakan dalam proyek.

Pengembangan Frontend

  • Memimpin pengembangan fitur dan komponen frontend yang kompleks.
  • Menulis kode frontend yang berkualitas tinggi, mudah dirawat, dan efisien.
  • Mengoptimalkan kinerja frontend dan pengalaman pengguna.
  • Menangani dan memperbaiki masalah serta bug pada frontend.

Peralatan Dan Infrastruktur

  • Menyiapkan dan memelihara alat pengembangan frontend, pipeline build, dan infrastruktur.
  • Mengimplementasikan serta mengotomatisasi pengujian, deployment, dan proses pemantauan frontend.
  • Mengevaluasi dan merekomendasikan alat serta teknologi untuk meningkatkan alur kerja dan produktivitas pengembangan frontend.

Dokumentasi Dan Berbagi Pengetahuan

  • Mendokumentasikan desain arsitektur, keputusan, dan pola.Membuat dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis untuk sistem dan komponen frontend.
  • Mengadakan sesi berbagi pengetahuan dan workshop untuk mentransfer keahlian kepada anggota tim lain.

Optimisasi Kinerja

  • Mengidentifikasi dan mengatasi hambatan kinerja pada aplikasi frontend.
  • Mengoptimalkan kode, aset, dan sumber daya frontend untuk meningkatkan waktu muat halaman dan kinerja rendering.
  • Menerapkan strategi caching, lazy loading, dan teknik optimisasi lainnya.

Riset Dan Inovasi

  • Tetap mengikuti perkembangan teknologi frontend terbaru, tren, dan perkembangan industri.
  • Melakukan riset dan eksperimen untuk mengeksplorasi teknologi, framework, dan alat frontend baru.
  • Mencoba dan mengevaluasi teknologi frontend baru untuk menilai kelayakan dan manfaat potensialnya.

Perbaikan Berkelanjutan

  • Secara terus-menerus mengevaluasi dan meningkatkan proses, alur kerja, dan metodologi pengembangan frontend.
  • Mengidentifikasi area yang perlu diperbaiki dan mengimplementasikan inisiatif untuk meningkatkan kualitas, efisiensi, dan inovasi frontend.

Persyaratan

  • Lulusan Sarjana dengan IPK minimal 3.00.
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1-2 tahun.
  • Memiliki keahlian dan pengalaman terbukti dalam mengawasi dan meningkatkan performa SEO (Search Engine Optimization).
  • Berpengalaman dalam pengembangan aplikasi menggunakan JavaScript, ReactJS, VueJS, NodeJS, HTML5, CSS3/CSS4, dan teknologi UI lainnya.
  • Pengalaman membangun aplikasi Progressive Web Apps (PWA) yang kaya fitur.
  • Memahami dan berpengalaman dengan asynchronous processing, partial page refresh, DOM traversal, dan manipulasi DOM.

name: Mobile Developer
description_html:
We're Hiring: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native + TypeScript)


Location: Fully Remote

Schedule: Midshift

Employment Type: Full-time | 12-Month Rolling Contract


We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer to lead the development of a mobile application for an innovative agricultural technology platform.


This is an exciting opportunity to own a mobile application from the ground up, building an offline-first solution for field teams operating in environments with limited or no internet connectivity.


You'll work across React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL, taking full ownership of features from backend development through to mobile deployment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Mobile Development: Build and launch a React Native application (iOS and Android), owning the full development lifecycle from architecture to app store releases.
  • Offline-First Architecture: Design local storage, background synchronization, retry mechanisms, conflict resolution, and offline data management.
  • Maps & Device Integration: Develop map-based features using MapLibre, integrating GPS, camera, and photo capture capabilities.
  • Backend Engineering: Design and develop APIs, database models, authentication, and permissions using Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.
  • Web Development: Build and enhance React 19 / TanStack Start applications, sharing business logic and validation across platforms.
  • DevOps & Quality: Manage mobile CI/CD, automated builds, OTA updates, crash monitoring, and automated testing.


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on React Native development.
  • Proven experience independently delivering at least one production mobile application to both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Strong full-stack development expertise using TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
  • Hands-on experience building offline-first mobile applications, including SQLite, WatermelonDB, or similar local databases, synchronization, and conflict handling.
  • Solid backend development experience covering REST/RPC APIs, SQL, database design, authentication, and authorization.
  • Experience with native iOS/Android development tooling, including Xcode, Gradle, and app store deployment.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, testing, and technical decision-making.
  • Excellent written communication skills and ability to collaborate with distributed teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing applications for agriculture, logistics, ERP, or field workforce management.
  • Geospatial and mapping technologies such as MapLibre, Mapbox, GeoJSON, or offline maps.
  • Familiarity with TanStack Start, TanStack Query, oRPC/tRPC, Zod, and Microsoft SSO.
  • Exposure to agribusiness operations, particularly the fresh-fruit supply chain.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Long-term engagement with an initial 12-month rolling contract.
  • Opportunity to lead mobile architecture and development from scratch.
  • Work on a meaningful platform connecting technology with real-world agricultural operations.
  • Take ownership across mobile, backend, and web development using a modern TypeScript stack.



If this isn't the right opportunity for you but you know someone who might be a great fit, referrals are always welcome!

name: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
description_html:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
  • Dynamic pricing intelligence
  • Smart lock access and key management
  • Automated guest communication across channels
  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys
  • Operational forecasting
  • Cleaning and maintenance automation
  • Owner reporting and financial workflows
  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • React
  • TypeScript
  • Supabase
  • PostgreSQL
  • AWS
  • Serverless architecture
  • OpenAI APIs
  • Twilio
  • Stripe
  • Docker
  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software
  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems
  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies
  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture
  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature
  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs
  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution
  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders
  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes
  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus Points For Experience With

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
  • AI agents and workflow automation
  • Product analytics and experimentation
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Supabase
  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use
  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built
  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks
  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete
  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably
  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations
  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions
  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement
  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress
  • You avoid ownership and accountability
  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

Responsibilities

About the team

Tokopedia is an e-Commerce platform that connects sellers and buyers across Indonesia. Our aim is to empower sellers to grow their businesses and enable buyers to easily discover and purchase affordable, high-quality products — improving the quality of life for everyone.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Candidates who pass resume screening will be invited to participate in Our Company's technical online assessment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop efficient, highly scalable, and secured services to build/integrate e-Commerce solutions for TikTok Shop.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and other disciplines to explore the next generation of shopping experiences on TikTok.
  • Be responsible for building an intuitive and reliable shopping experience, including browsing product details, check-out, shopping, return, refund etc.
  • Be responsible for TikTok's Shop Tab, building platforms and tools for merchants, clients, and businesses to manage campaigns, deliver the best results, and receive actionable insights.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Undergraduate in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Coding experience with a general purpose programming language (HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript).
