name: Point of Sales Platforms
description_html:
ROLE PURPOSE

Lead the development, enhancement, integration, and operational excellence of Point of Sales (POS) applications within the Sales & Distribution ecosystem. Drive technology modernization, process automation, and AI-powered innovation to improve sales productivity, operational efficiency, system reliability, and user experience across all sales channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • POS Application Leadership & Ownership
  • Own the end-to-end POS application lifecycle, including architecture, development, configuration, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Ensure POS applications support business requirements across sales channels, outlets, dealers, and distribution operations.
  • Drive application simplification, standardization, and modernization to support business transformation and system integration.
  • Define technical roadmaps, development priorities, and delivery plans aligned with Sales & Distribution business objectives.
  • Technical Development & Solution Engineering
  • Lead and actively participate in hands-on development, coding, debugging, configuration, and technical problem-solving.
  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performance application solutions using modern technologies and development practices.
  • Manage API development, middleware integration, database design, and connectivity with core systems and other enterprise applications.
  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure compliance with IT architecture, security, and quality standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective actions.
  • AI Development & Intelligent Automation
  • Develop and implement AI-powered solutions to improve POS capabilities, sales processes, and operational efficiency.
  • Build AI applications and services using appropriate AI models, APIs, frameworks, and enterprise data.
  • Explore and implement Generative AI and Agentic AI to automate repetitive tasks, accelerate development, and improve operational decision-making.
  • Develop AI-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, predictive analysis, and intelligent incident management capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate AI into sales operations, outlet management, transaction monitoring, and user support.
  • Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise security, data privacy, governance, accuracy, and reliability requirements.
  • System Integration & Technology Modernization
  • Ensure seamless integration between POS and other Sales & Distribution systems, including outlet management, dealer management, sales applications, incentive systems, and enterprise platforms.
  • Drive API standardization, reusable services, and system interoperability across business applications.
  • Lead technology upgrades and migration initiatives to improve scalability, maintainability, and integration readiness.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, IT Operations, and external technology partners.
  • Service Reliability & Operational Excellence
  • Ensure POS application availability, performance, scalability, and transaction reliability.
  • Monitor application health, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement proactive monitoring and automation.
  • Lead incident resolution, problem management, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Establish service KPIs, technical documentation, disaster recovery readiness, and operational handover standards.

Required Technical Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of POS applications, sales distribution systems, and enterprise application architecture.
  • Hands-on software development skills in relevant programming languages and frameworks.
  • Experience in REST APIs, microservices, middleware, databases, and enterprise system integration.
  • Practical experience developing and deploying AI solutions, including Generative AI, LLM integration, or Agentic AI.
  • Knowledge of AI frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, and model/API integration.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, application security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, observability tools, and AI-assisted monitoring is an advantage.

Leadership & Business Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and technology roadmap development.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development.
  • Agile delivery and project management.
  • Stakeholder communication and vendor management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making.
  • Ability to translate business challenges into scalable technology and AI solutions.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for delivery and production stability.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • POS application availability and transaction success rate.
  • Application performance and reduction in critical incidents.
  • On-time delivery of development projects and business requirements.
  • Number and business impact of AI solutions successfully implemented.
  • Productivity improvement and operational cost reduction through automation.
  • Reduction in manual processes and mean time to resolve incidents (MTTR).
  • Quality of system integration and successful technology modernization.
  • Team capability development and engineering quality improvement.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in application development, enterprise systems, and IT solution delivery minimal 3 years
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and managing business-critical applications.
  • Demonstrated hands-on capability in software engineering and solution design.
  • Practical experience building or implementing AI-powered applications or automation solutions.
  • Experience managing partners, budgets, projects, and cross-functional stakeholders.

name: DevOps Engineer
description_html:
24Slides is a leading presentation design company specializing in high-impact PowerPoint presentations. We are committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. We believe diversity drives innovation and success, and we strive to build an environment where every identity is valued. At 24Slides, we don't just celebrate differences—we make them central to our culture, ensuring everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive.

As our infrastructure and platform services expand, we are building operational coverage and infrastructure redundancy across global time zones. We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer based in our Malang office to join our Technology organization, working closely with your DevOps and Engineering colleagues in Europe.

About The Position

As a DevOps in 24Slides you will be part of a dynamic workplace, and engage with different stakeholders, across different offices, and participate in recurring tasks and ad-hoc projects across 24Slides. You will be working closely with 24Slides software engineers, our Data team and our QA team, and in collaboration optimize deployment pipelines, data pipelines and support increased levels of automation.

We take pride in being curious, so we experiment with new technologies to help elevate our customers' experience, and being interested in new advancements within the DevOps/DevEx domain is a plus.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and maintain Kubernetes clusters across our primary hosting environment(s)
  • Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and containerization best practices to streamline resource management and ensure environment consistency.
  • Monitor cloud compute utilization and cost efficiency across production and non-production environments.
  • Maintain CI/CD build runners and automation pipelines
  • Conduct security patch updates.
  • Monitor system health, application metrics, and log pipelines
  • Participate in proactive troubleshooting, incident management, and post-incident root-cause analysis (RCA)
  • Conduct periodic Disaster Recovery (DR) drills to validate recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).

Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in a DevOps, SRE, or Systems Engineering role supporting production applications.
  • Managing cloud infrastructure. Previous experience from DigitalOcean is a plus.
  • Building, maintaining and optimizing CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
  • Knowledge of Cloudflare, reverse proxies, and Linux system administration.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and Redis/Vkey caching engines.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in English (both written and spoken) for cross-regional team collaboration.

A plus if you

  • Have experience operating under formal security compliance frameworks (SOC 2).
  • Are familiar with PHP/Laravel runtime environments and Node.js / React build systems.
  • Have experience with log management stacks.

Benefits:

  • Salary & Insurances: Enjoy a competitive salary with additional incentives, plus comprehensive health coverage, including BPJS and private insurance.
  • Global & Flexible Work Culture: Gain international experience in a multinational environment with a global team, a fun office vibe, casual attire, and a flexible hybrid working model.
  • Continuous Growth & Development: We invest in your future through professional training, clear career progression paths, and dedicated personal growth programs.
  • Holistic Well-being: We prioritize your happiness and mental health with access to psychological counseling, annual leave that increases with tenure, plus situational leave, and engaging "experience programs" (non-work activities).
  • Operational Support: Get the tools you need to succeed with the provided working devices.

Application & Recruitment Process:

Please submit your application as soon as possible. Our recruitment process is designed to be thorough and transparent, consisting of some stages: an initial screening, a online technical test to evaluate your skill, a online psychological test, an HR interview, a user interview, and a final interview with the user team. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to the team!

name: DevOps Engineer
description_html:
About FireRock

FireRock Holdings Limited (SEHK: 01909) is a listed gaming and interactive entertainment company headquartered in Singapore with a global footprint across Asia, Europe, Southeast Asia, and beyond. We develop, publish, and operate web and mobile games that reach millions of players worldwide, and we’re actively expanding in emerging markets with localized content and cutting-edge experiences.


At FireRock, innovation isn’t a buzzword—it’s how we build games that players love and communities that thrive. Our Singapore, Indonesia, and SEA teams are at the heart of this growth, bringing creative ideas to life and shaping the future of play in the region.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Kubernetes-focused DevOps Engineer to design, manage, and scale infrastructure across multiple projects. You’ll be the bridge between development and production—automating deployments, maintaining high-performance CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the security and observability of our Go and PHP-based services.


Key Responsibilities

  • K8s Orchestration: Own and improve Kubernetes-based deployments (RBAC, scaling, services/ingress, and rollouts).
  • Pipeline Automation: Design and maintain automated build/test/deploy workflows using GitHub Actions, Github CI and Jenkins.
  • Observability: Drive system health through logging, monitoring, and alerting using Grafana and Promtail.
  • Infrastructure Ops: Manage and optimize high-performance databases and messaging systems (NATS/NSQ).
  • Traffic & Security: Configure and maintain Nginx, WAFs, and Load Balancers for secure operations.
  • Reliability: Maintain detailed run books and participate in on-call rotations to ensure 24/7 system availability.
  • Passion for games or experience in the gaming industry is a plus.
  • Proficiency in English (written and spoken) is essential.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years in DevOps, Infrastructure, or SRE with strong Linux system administration skills.
  • Orchestration: Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes and Docker troubleshooting.
  • The Stack: Proficiency in deploying and running Go backend services and PHP applications.
  • Observability Tools: Experience with Grafana and Promtail for log collection, custom dashboards, and alert workflows.
  • Data Management: Proven ability to install, configure, and maintain:
  • SQL: MySQL and PostgreSQL.
  • NoSQL & Caching: MongoDB and Redis.
  • Analytics: ClickHouse (optimization for ingestion and storage).
  • CI/CD Tools: Strong proficiency in building and managing pipelines via GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
  • Multi-Cloud: Familiarity with major providers including AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, or Azure.


What We Offer

  • A strategic role with real influence on FireRock’s growth, revenue, and community engagement across Indonesia and the broader SEA region.
  • A chance to shape how FireRock engages with Indonesia’s indie game ecosystem and connects with players and partners globally.
  • Close collaboration with a small, high-impact team where your network, insights, and execution matter.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive private health insurance coverage for you, your spouse, and your children.**


How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter outlining relevant experience and motivation. By applying, you agree to background checks as part of our recruitment process. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.


Equal Opportunity Statement

FireRock is committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where diverse voices make us stronger. We know creativity and effective problem-solving come from teams that reflect many backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Together, we’re building games and communities that matter.

name: Senior DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer
description_html:
This role is open only to candidates currently based in Thailand or Indonesia, with a hybrid arrangement in Bangkok and a remote arrangement in Indonesia.

Cube is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer to help us build, automate, and manage the cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines behind our products.

You will design and maintain secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-efficient infrastructure while enabling our engineering teams to deliver software and data pipelines reliably. You will work closely with the Software Engineering and Data Engineering teams to build and improve our infrastructure and operational practices.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure and architectures
  • Provision, manage, and automate infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and automated software delivery
  • Deploy, manage, and maintain containerized workloads and orchestration platforms, including Kubernetes and cloud container services
  • Manage and maintain cloud networking, databases, monitoring, logging, alerting, backups, and disaster recovery infrastructure
  • Perform day-to-day infrastructure operations, troubleshoot technical issues, respond to incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks and continuously improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency
  • Collaborate closely with the Software Engineering and Data Engineering teams to design and deliver reliable, practical infrastructure solutions
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and operational processes
  • Support the migration and modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a similar role
  • Strong experience administering Linux servers and managing cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS
  • Hands-on experience designing and managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
  • Hands-on experience managing Docker containers and Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and working with Git-based development workflows
  • Good understanding of cloud networking concepts, including VPCs/VNets, subnets, routing, VPNs, DNS, and load balancers
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability systems
  • Working knowledge of commonly used databases, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
  • Ability to write basic Bash, Python, or similar scripts for automation and operational tasks
  • Proven experience troubleshooting infrastructure and production issues and working effectively across engineering teams
  • Experience migrating, modernizing, or transitioning legacy systems and infrastructure
  • Good to have experience with data analytics and big-data services
  • Infrastructure or cloud certifications are a plus

name: Dev Ops / Cloud Engineer
description_html:
Bandung, Indonesia

  • Full-Time

About The Role

Solve Education! is hiring a DevOps / Cloud Engineer to build and own the cloud foundation behind our mission: helping young people everywhere reach their potential through accessible, AI-powered learning. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants their work to keep a global learning platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient.

You'll design, operate, and improve our cloud environment (primarily AWS, with some GCP) across infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, security, reliability, and cost. You'll work with a high degree of autonomy and make sound calls without waiting for direction.

Our stack: AWS (primary) and GCP

  • Pulumi/Terraform
  • GitLab CI
  • Python/Bash for automation.

Before You Apply

This role carries real ownership of production systems learners depend on. You'll handle ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and weigh reliability, security, and cost in your decisions. Some of the near-term work is foundational — tightening how we manage access, credentials, and deployments. We look for engineers who stay composed under pressure, take full accountability, and hold a high bar without close supervision.

If you want a role where infrastructure decisions have visible impact and your work directly supports a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure & IaC

  • Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS (and GCP where needed) using Pulumi/Terraform.
  • Keep infrastructure available, performant, and scalable as the platform grows.

CI/CD & Deployments

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) for fast, safe, repeatable deployments.
  • Manage releases, rollbacks, and deployment safety to minimize disruption.

Security, Reliability & Monitoring

  • Apply least-privilege access, sensible network configuration, and good secrets management.
  • Run monitoring, logging, and incident response; keep downtime low and detection useful.
  • Maintain backups and a workable disaster-recovery plan.

Cost & Collaboration

  • Keep cloud spend visible and efficient with budgets and usage controls.
  • Work with the Product & Technology team so infrastructure supports what's being built, and keep documentation and operational standards up to date.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (and GCP experience a plus).
  • Proficiency with Pulumi/Terraform and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent).
  • Solid cloud-security fundamentals: IAM, least-privilege, networking, and secrets management.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and incident response.
  • Scripting for automation (Python or Bash).
  • Pragmatic judgment about reliability vs. cost, with the ability to work independently and own outcomes.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Containerized workloads (Cloud Run, ECS) and basic orchestration.
  • Experience moving from static credentials to federated identity (Workload Identity Federation, OIDC).
  • Exposure to data-platform infrastructure (BigQuery, Airflow).
  • A habit of using AI tools to speed up infrastructure and automation work.
  • Experience in mission-driven or non-profit organizations.

Why Join Us?

You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for a conventional engineering role, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to lead with technology, build solutions that matter, and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

Our team operates at the intersection of partner experience, platform reliability, and release execution. We manage DevHome and the operational systems that support partner onboarding, access, documentation publishing, and partner-facing product releases across mobile and web surfaces.

This team focuses on more than feature development. A large part of our work is making sure critical platforms remain stable, secure, and operationally efficient. That means managing incidents, improving deployment safety, maintaining infrastructure, and building automation that removes manual work from daily operations.

As part of the team, you will work closely with various departments, including Engineering, QA, Release Train, PM, BD, Legal, and Operations. Your collaboration will focus on keeping launches moving and ensuring that partner-facing platforms are reliable at scale.

Get to Know the Role

As a Senior TechOps & Release Automation Engineer (G4), you will lead the operational health and release readiness of DevHome and related partner-facing platforms. This is a hybrid engineering role for someone who enjoys solving operational problems with code, improving reliability, and taking ownership across the full platform lifecycle.

You will help keep systems production-safe, supporting partner onboarding and access workflows, managing release execution for Android and iOS, and driving automation across operational processes. You will span application support, infrastructure maintenance, incident response, deployment safety, and internal tooling. You will report to the Tech Support Engineering Manager and onsite in the Jakarta office based.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Manage end-to-end DevHome operations, partner onboarding support, and release execution from intake through post-release verification.
  • Manage Android and iOS release activities, including cutoffs, submissions, phased rollouts, cherry-picks, rollback readiness, and release tracking.
  • Resolve operational escalations related to partner access, login issues, onboarding blockers, scope or configuration requests, and documentation publishing flows.
  • Make safe production changes across Go services, React/Docusaurus surfaces, configurations, secrets, tokens, and developer documentation.
  • Maintain Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure, GitLab runners, CI/CD pipelines, and other reliability-critical operational tooling.
  • Investigate and respond to production incidents using Datadog, Kibana, and system-level troubleshooting to resolve performance, latency, and partner-helping issues.
  • Support infrastructure lifecycle work such as AMI rotation, EC2 and Docklet maintenance, backend scaling, and migration to MEKS.
  • Develop automation, scripts, and internal tools that reduce manual effort across release management, approvals, assessment, and partner operations.
  • Contribute to on-call readiness, RCA follow-ups, SOP improvements, and runbook maintenance.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to unblock launches and keep platform operations moving smoothly.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in TechOps, DevOps, SRE, release engineering, platform support, or similar operational engineering roles.
  • Go (Golang) skills, with the ability to safely navigate and modify a large shared monorepo.
  • Comfortable working across both application and operations layers, including code, infrastructure, CI/CD, secrets, documentation, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience with release operations, production change management, feature rollouts and mobile app releases.
  • Troubleshooting judgment, with the ability to assess growth, identify root causes, and lead issues through to resolution independently.
  • Working knowledge of GitLab, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and AWS, including practical knowledge of Route53, Security Groups, runners, compute lifecycle management, and safe infrastructure changes.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes/EKS, with experience in Helm charts, service-mesh-style networking, namespaces, staged migrations, or MEKS/Kubernetes migration work.
  • Trigger, debug, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, including GitLab pipeline troubleshooting, release automation, and deployment workflows such as Conveyor or similar tools.
  • Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), token flows, HMAC, and secret management, especially for partner-facing API platforms.
  • Experience with HashiCorp Vault or equivalent secret and token management systems.
  • Familiarity with React and Docusaurus to maintain partner portal UI and developer documentation workflows, even if your core strength is in backend or operations engineering.
  • Experience investigating operational issues using Datadog, Kibana, logs, and production telemetry.
  • Experience building internal admin tools, workflow automation, approval systems, Slack bots, or similar operational tooling.
  • Partner management skills and empathy, with the ability to bridge engineering systems and operational needs across BD, Legal, Ops, partner engineering teams, and external developer contacts.
  • Experience supporting external-facing partner or developer platforms, including canary or phased rollouts, production hardening, post-mortems, runbook creation, or mentoring team members.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

name: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description_html:
POSITION SUMMARY:

AccelByte is building a 24x7 operations team for AAA multiplayer video games. In this position, we need a driven Site Reliability Engineer who can actively participate in the day-to-day combat by maintaining high reliability of our service and drive prioritization in fixing what may be broken today, as well as able to envision, design, and implement processes and technologies to improve the ability to identify, isolate, correlate, and mitigate service impacting problems in the system. The Site Reliability Engineer must also know some coding to automate routine tasks in service metrics gathering, correlating, organizing, and presenting, in addition to detail and in-depth root cause analysis


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is accountable for the following functions and responsibilities:

  • Design, build and maintain high-performance backend services, tools, and control planes to automate operations and improve system reliability.
  • Architect, implement and maintain a highly scalable deployment framework and tooling that improves our products' stability, reliability, and availability.
  • Build and run service deployment using K8s and other CNCF projects
  • Provide a secure, high-scalable, and cost-effective cloud platform
  • Construct and build effective systems to monitor the health of our system/applications, and to handle outages
  • Solve problems occurring in all our environments and create solutions to prevent them from happening again
  • Produce automation and innovative tools to assist the product development teams and to deliver operational excellence
  • Create and maintain infrastructure-related documentation and SRE runbooks
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to provide cost-effective, operational excellence, and performance-efficient infrastructure solutions to improve our products.
  • Identify technology, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement
  • Liaise, communicate, and work directly with our clients
  • Perform any other design-related duties as required
  • Envision, design, and implement AIOps solutions to enhance operational efficiency and predictive maintenance.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code (primarily in Go/Python) for core platform components.


QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • 5+ years Cloud Engineering or DevOps experience with AWS, 2+ years Kubernetes, Certification in AWS preferred
  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Deep knowledge of cloud service providers and best practices around implementation and configuration, preferably managing AWS and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with infrastructure management and operations lifecycle concepts and ecosystem, deep understanding of IaC and GitOps
  • Proven track record of building infrastructure as code (Terraform is a must), configuration management, and package manager (eg: Helm Chart)
  • Experience in delivering products against a plan in a fast-paced, multi-disciplined, and often ambiguous environment
  • Experience working independently to design, plan, and execute technical projects
  • Demonstrated deep knowledge of technical program management and engineering best practices
  • Innovative thinking balanced with a strong customer and quality and cost efficiency focus
  • Comfort and experience with cross-organizational communication; excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Working experience with some of the following technologies and tools: Docker, Kubernetes, git, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, GitLab CI, Nexus, SonarQube, Terraform, Helm, Prometheus, ELK/EFK, Grafana, CloudWatch
  • Solid security best practices
  • Strong proficiency in Go, including the ability to conduct high-quality code reviews. Experience with Python and Bash is also required.
  • Keen problem-solving skills with the ability to work under pressure (during a production event)
  • Flexibility in working with people with different timezones
  • Experience with AIOps and building/harnessing AI tools to automate and optimize operational tasks.


QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE PREFERRED

  • Previous experience working in the game industry
  • Working experience with one or more of the following: Emissary, Linkerd, Istio, Nomad, Kafka, Flux, ArgoCD, GitOps, DevSecOps
  • Familiar with web services patterns/architectures, e.g. REST, SOAP, etc.
  • Experience working with auto-scaling workloads both in containers and VMs
  • Experience with other cloud technologies and infrastructure: GCP, Azure
  • Experience with Confluence, Jira, and BitBucket
  • IT standards, methodologies, Cryptographic key management regulations, and audit experience would be asset(s).

name: DevSecOps Engineer
description_html:
Company Summary:

Since 2002, DVI Solutions has been a leading provider of audio-visual setups to help our clients communicate and collaborate better--whether it's with colleagues across the office, or partners on the other side of the world. We have presence across Japan, Singapore, Thailand, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Philippines, Vietnam, India, Malaysia and Indonesia. Our satisfied clients include corporations, government agencies, schools, retail stores, hotels and many more.


Role Overview

We are seeking a DevSecOps Engineer to design, secure, and scale the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines powering our SaaS platform.

In this role, you will be responsible for building a secure, automated, and highly visible delivery ecosystem where Azure cloud infrastructure, Bitbucket CI/CD pipelines, and Jira workflows are tightly integrated. You will ensure that deployments are secure, traceable, compliant, and aligned with engineering best practices.


Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

CI/CD & DevOps

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and manage tools such as Snyk, SonarQube, Aikido, or similar security platforms.
  • Investigate, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities.
  • Support SOC 2 compliance initiatives by maintaining audit trails, security controls, and evidence collection processes.

Collaboration

  • Partner with Software Engineers and QA teams to improve developer experience and release quality.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to planning, estimation, and delivery activities.
  • Promote DevSecOps best practices across the engineering organization.


Requirements

  • Cloud Infrastructure — Azure + Terraform/IaC, cloud cost optimisation (FinOps), resource governance
  • CI/CD — Bitbucket Pipelines, Git workflows, production operations / platform reliability
  • Security & Observability — Security scanning (Snyk, SonarQube, Aikido), monitoring/alerting and operational automation
  • 5+ years of experience in DevSecOps, cloud security, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, or related fields.


Why Join us

  • Opportunities to work on regional projects with global brands.
  • Exposure to multinational clients, cross-border teams, and cutting-edge technology.
  • Exposure to solutions that include immersive video walls, hybrid meeting tech, collaboration tech, digital transformation, smart workspace integration and much more.
  • Team-oriented culture that encourages collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Involved in custom projects for high-profile clients, DVI offers opportunities to expand your portfolio and build a specialized skill set.
  • A booming industry with the rise of hybrid workspaces and smart office solutions.

name: Site Reliability Engineer
description_html:
Role Overview

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems. You will apply engineering principles to operations, focusing on automation, observability, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort and enhance system resilience. You will work closely with development teams to build and operate highly reliable services, embedding reliability into the full software lifecycle.


Main Responsibilities

  • Monitor system reliability and define, implement, and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for production services
  • Lead incident response activities, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution
  • Automate infrastructure processes and reduce operational toil through scripting and tooling enhancements
  • Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters, including resource configurations, manifests, and kustomize overlays
  • Maintain and monitor GitOps workflows using ArgoCD to ensure consistent and reliable application deployments
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins Job DSL (Groovy)
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve system reliability, scalability, and deployment readiness
  • Maintain and upgrade platform tools such as Jenkins, ArgoCD, and container registries
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, postmortems, and internal technical documentation


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or infrastructure engineering
  • Solid understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, and error budget frameworks
  • Experience operating and managing systems in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Strong proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and deployment strategies (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
  • Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools such as ArgoCD or FluxCD
  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, logging and alerting systems)
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Bash, Python, Groovy) and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)
  • Strong foundation in Linux/Unix systems and Git-based version control workflows

name: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description_html:
About The Role

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. At the Senior Level, you own reliability, performance, and cost outcomes for the systems under your area end-to-end, not just executing well-defined tasks, but deciding between tradeoffs, scoping ambiguous problems, and driving process and system improvements that span teams. You'll work closely with development, security, and product teams, and mentor other engineers as a technical point of reference for the team.

What You Will Do

  • Own the availability, performance, scalability, and security of production systems end-to-end, across cloud (AWS/GCP) and on-premises environments.
  • Design and evolve Kubernetes deployment strategy for production workloads.
  • Own CI/CD and GitOps pipelines in production (ArgoCD or equivalent) and the Terraform that provisions the infrastructure behind them.
  • Diagnose and resolve database performance issues.
  • Build and maintain observability that surfaces problems before they become incidents.
  • Seek out and implement process and system improvements affecting performance and security, coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Scope and lead medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives: gather requirements, prioritize by business impact, and communicate impact to stakeholders.
  • Negotiate technical tradeoffs with stakeholders to meet business SLAs.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers and junior engineers; promote best practices and standards across the team.
  • Maintain documentation and process discipline for the systems and incidents you own.
  • Lead structured incident investigation, isolating server, database, and application layers with a metrics-first approach, including on-call during high-traffic events.

What Are We Looking For

  • At least 4 years of experience in either SRE, DevOps, MLOps, or platform engineering, including senior-level scope at a high-traffic company.
  • Deep expertise in one major cloud provider (preferably AWS), with a proven ability to ramp up on the other quickly.Production experience & expertise with Kubernetes & Linux fundamentals
  • CI/CD & GitOps (ArgoCD or other equivalent stacks)
  • Database performance analysis & monitoring (MySQL, Postgres)
  • Observability tooling & standards (Datadog, OpenTelemetry)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Strong working English, verbal & written communication. Strong documentation and process discipline.
  • On-call & incident handling experience during high-traffic events.
  • Comfortable negotiating with stakeholders to propose technical compromises that meet business SLAs.
  • Demonstrated growth mindset and proven ability to own ambiguous scope.

name: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description_html:
About the Role


We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our existing SRE team and build tools and automation that improve production reliability and day-to-day operations. As a senior individual contributor, you will turn initial operational needs into clear requirements, practical system designs, working proofs of concept, and maintainable production solutions.


You will work closely with SRE, Engineering, and Production Support teams, quickly learn our products and support model, and contribute to daily SRE activities. Building new tools and automation is the primary focus of this role, alongside participation in the weekly support rotation.


Location – Hybrid | Bandung, Indonesia (at least 2-3 days per week in the office)


What You’ll be Doing

Tooling and Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain internal tools, services, and scripts using Python, Go, and shell scripting to reduce repetitive work and improve operational efficiency.
  • Gather and clarify raw requirements from SRE and Engineering teams; define the problem, scope, acceptance criteria, and expected operational outcomes.
  • Create system designs covering components, integrations, data flows, security, scalability, and failure handling; explain design choices and trade-offs.
  • Build and demonstrate proofs of concept, incorporate feedback, and own delivery through testing, rollout, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines for reliable builds, automated testing, deployment, and rollback; automate infrastructure and configuration workflows.

Product Learning and SRE Operations

  • Quickly learn product architecture, service dependencies, infrastructure, deployment processes, and the production support model.
  • Work alongside the existing SRE team on daily server and service operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and controlled changes.
  • Participate in the weekly rota for SRE operations and on-call support, including out-of-hours incident response when scheduled; follow escalation and handover procedures.
  • Investigate production incidents with Engineering and Production Support, contribute to root cause analysis, and turn recurring issues into lasting automation improvements.

Collaboration and Engineering Quality

  • Work closely with SRE, Engineering, and Production Support to prioritize operational needs and deliver tools that fit existing workflows.
  • Write tested, maintainable code, participate in code and design reviews, and apply secure development practices.
  • Maintain system designs, runbooks, operating procedures, and user documentation; demonstrate solutions and support their adoption across teams.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and service performance, and evaluate delivered automation by its reliability and reduction in manual effort.


About You

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, systems engineering, or production software engineering with operational responsibilities.
  • Strong hands-on programming ability in Python or Go, practical shell scripting skills such as Bash, and willingness to work across the team’s languages and tooling.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining operational tools or automation beyond one-off scripts, including APIs, error handling, testing, and version control.
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD automation using tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or equivalent platforms.
  • Ability to independently clarify incomplete requirements, design a suitable solution, and build a proof of concept that demonstrates its value and feasibility.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, Linux server administration, networking fundamentals, and troubleshooting production services.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management, such as Terraform or Ansible, and monitoring and logging platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch.
  • Strong ownership, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to different teams.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar products and support processes quickly, collaborate within an established team, and participate reliably in the weekly operational rota.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Docker and Kubernetes, distributed systems, and reliability practices such as service level objectives, capacity planning, and post-incident reviews.
  • Cloud backup or SaaS platforms, databases, storage, or messaging systems.
  • Building self-service operational tools and integrating cloud APIs, monitoring systems, or ticketing workflows.


About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.


The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.


NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.


What You’ll Love

  • We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community
  • We prioritise your work/life balance offering a hybrid work environment and free in-office lunches throughout the week
  • We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement
  • Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally
  • Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
  • Receive competitive compensation
  • Collaborate with an amazing international workforce


Additional Information

Applicants must hold valid working rights in Indonesia at the time of application. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.


We are an equal opportunity employer in accordance with Indonesia's Manpower Law. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment regardless of nationality, gender, age, disability, or background. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees.

name: Lead Infrastructure Engineer, Managed Kubernetes Platform (MEKS)
description_html:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Role

The Lead Infrastructure Engineer – Kubernetes & Service Mesh is a lead technical authority within the MEKS platform team. This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating the high-scale container and service mesh infrastructure. This infrastructure powers critical backend services across Grab. Reporting directly to the Platform Engineering Manager, this hands-on lead role focuses entirely on deep technical execution, platform architecture, system reliability, and developer experience. You will serve as the primary architect and technical mentor for the platform, driving multi-cluster AWS EKS strategies, Istio service mesh implementations, and cross-team developer enablement. This is an onsite position based in the Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform Architecture & Platform Engineering

  • Service Mesh Implementation involves designing and deploying production-grade Istio service mesh infrastructure. This infrastructure consists of a data plane and control plane. It requires managing various aspects, including mTLS, traffic management, canary/blue-green deployments, rate limiting, and circuit breaking, to optimize the service mesh.
  • Architect and manage large-scale AWS EKS clusters, driving multi-cluster/multi-region topologies, node-pool optimization, custom scheduler strategies, and automated cluster lifecycles.
  • Establish standardized cluster templates, namespaces, network policies, RBAC, and policy-as-code guardrails across the organization.

Developer Experience & Self-Service Tooling

name: Release Engineer
description_html:
About the Role

We are looking for a Release Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build, operate, coordinate, and continuously improve the processes used to reliably deliver software into production.

This role combines hands-on Release Engineering operations with program management. You will build and improve release planning and operations while coordinating releases across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SiteOps, Product, and Production Support.

You will help ensure that release scope, dependencies, risks, readiness, and timelines are visible across teams, while progressively automating the underlying release process.

The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and cross-functional release coordination — troubleshooting a failed pipeline one moment and facilitating a release-readiness discussion the next.

Location – Hybrid, Indonesia (2 days per week in the office)


What You’ll be Doing

Release Program Management

  • Coordinate the end-to-end release program across Engineering, QA, Product, DevOps/SiteOps, and Production Support.
  • Set and communicate milestones, timelines, dependencies, readiness criteria, and decision points, while keeping visibility of release scope (Jira tickets, PRs, services, repos).
  • Track cross-team dependencies, risks, actions, decisions, exceptions, and blockers through to closure, escalating material risks early to Engineering leadership.
  • Facilitate release planning, readiness reviews, go/no-go discussions, and post-release reviews, and make sure release owners and teams understand their responsibilities and timelines.
  • Coordinate communication on scope, timeline, or production plan changes, and provide concise status reporting drawn from engineering systems rather than manual updates.

Release Operations

  • Coordinate releases across Sandbox, Sanity/Staging, and Production: work with QA on testing and certification, validate release branches (correct PRs and Jira tickets), and keep release notes accurate (changes, dependencies, deployment steps, config/DB changes, known issues, rollback).
  • Drive production readiness across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SiteOps, Product, and Support, support deployments and post-deployment verification, and handle hotfixes, emergency releases, rollbacks, and release-related production issues.
  • Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) and hotfix governance: manage approvals, risks, dependencies, go/no-go decisions, change calendar, deployment tracking, and post-release validation.
  • Run RCAs after failed releases and post-release improvement discussions, driving agreed actions to completion.
  • Act as a central coordination point without becoming a bottleneck: write tested release automation, join code/design reviews, maintain runbooks and release calendars, build dashboards and metrics (deployment success, rollbacks, change failure rate, release duration, manual interventions), and move toward exception-based release management.


About You

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in Release Engineering, DevOps, Build Engineering, Technical Program Management, or related role.
  • Hands-on CI/CD automation (Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or similar) and strong Git workflow knowledge: branches, PRs, merges, tags, versioning, cherry-picks, release branches.
  • Scripting or programming in Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell, or similar, with a solid grasp of build, test, packaging, deployment, and rollback processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting build, pipeline, deployment, configuration, and environment issues, with familiarity in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Coordinating technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders, managing dependencies, risks, milestones, actions, and decisions without unnecessary process overhead.
  • Strong organizational, ownership, problem-solving, facilitation, and communication skills: able to turn complex release details into clear status, risks, and decisions for different audiences, juggle concurrent releases, and be both hands-on and responsible for cross-team coordination.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience coordinating releases across multiple engineering/Scrum teams, using Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and release-planning workflows.
  • Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Background in SaaS products and distributed systems, including databases, storage, or messaging.
  • Experience automating release notes, quality gates, deployment validation, and rollbacks; building engineering dashboards and release-status reporting; familiarity with Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch and DORA metrics.
  • Preferred certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, SAFe® Release Train Engineer (RTE).


About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

name: DevSecOps Engineer
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000418

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

Information Security at Traveloka protects one of Southeast Asia's largest travel platforms — millions of travellers, their payments, and their trust across 11 markets. We are the team that lets hundreds of engineers ship fast without shipping risk: building secure-by-default infrastructure, hunting threats in real time, and setting the standards every product team is held to. As we scale and as AI becomes native to how we build, the attack surface grows and our work only gets more critical.

Here you defend at genuine scale and own outcomes, not tickets. Whether you are hardening systems through security engineering or running detection and response in security operations, you will make decisions that move the whole company. If you want your security work to matter to real people across the region, you will fit right in.

As a DevSecOps Engineer, you are the technical authority for security within the software development lifecycle, driving the most complex security-in-pipeline programs, setting the standards your function operates by, and shaping how secure development is practiced across Traveloka as an individual contributor.

Job Scope

  • Own and drive the most complex, highest-impact SDLC security programs end-to-end, from scoping and embedding controls into CI/CD workflows through to remediation validation and organisational learning
  • Define and enforce the technical standards, scanning methodologies, and tooling frameworks your function operates by — covering vulnerability detection in code and 3rd-party libraries — ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous improvement across all security work in the build pipeline
  • Identify systemic gaps in secure coding practice and pipeline security coverage across the engineering organisation, and lead cross-functional improvement programs that produce lasting structural change in how Traveloka builds software securely
  • Act as the senior technical authority in security discussions with engineering, product, and business leadership, providing the depth of reasoning and credibility that helps the organisation make sound, defensible decisions on security rules and build-time controls
  • Influence engineering teams toward secure coding and design practices through deep technical credibility, shaping how security is embedded into Traveloka’s development workflows as an individual contributor
  • Define how AI tools are adopted within secure development workflows, establishing the standards for responsible use and modeling the judgment that separates genuine security acceleration from risk amplification
  • Define and own Traveloka’s CI/CD pipeline security architecture, setting the standards for how security controls are embedded across build workflows and ensuring coverage is consistent, reliable, and trusted by the engineering organisation
  • Lead the design and delivery of the most complex security automation and tooling programs, producing capabilities that scale security feedback across hundreds of engineers and measurably improve secure development practices
  • Shape Traveloka’s secure development culture at an organisational level, defining the security awareness strategy and developer guidance frameworks that make security a natural part of how engineering teams build

Requirements

  • You have at least 6 years of relevant experience in DevSecOps, application security, or secure SDLC engineering
  • Designs and builds production-grade security tooling and automation (e.g. CI/CD security scanners, SCA/SAST integrations, policy-as-code) in Python or equivalent
  • You have defined security standards or built security capabilities — such as vulnerability scanning, dependency/3rd-party library checks, or security rule validation — adopted across an entire engineering organisation
  • You have driven the change management required to make them stick, including getting developer teams to adopt secure coding guidance during the build process
  • You can weigh security, operational, and business trade-offs in your decisions and defend them with data, communicating clearly to both technical and business leadership
  • You influence senior engineers and cross-functional leaders through credibility rather than authority
  • You use AI security tools with sophistication, understanding their failure modes and shaping how they are adopted responsibly within developer workflows
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
  • You are the security engineer that engineering directors want in the room for the most consequential CI/CD and secure development architecture decisions
  • You have defined pipeline security architecture at organizational scale and built security automation that measurably improved secure coding practices across hundreds of engineers

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

name: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
description_html:
The Role


Help Rabbit build and ship faster with AI — safely, securely and reliably.

Rabbit runs automated cost optimization across enterprise Google Cloud environments. When we change a customer's BigQuery reservations or rightsize their GKE clusters, those changes need to be correct and dependable. Reliability is central to the trust customers place in our product.


Our foundation is already in place: logging, alerting, automated deployment and Terraform-managed infrastructure. Your mission is to evolve that foundation for an AI-accelerated engineering team: turn faster implementation into faster, dependable delivery through automated validation, safe releases and rapid feedback.


You'll apply proven SRE practices — SLOs, observability, incident response and deployment safety — to AI-assisted development and agent-driven workflows. The goal is to increase how quickly the team can deliver verified improvements, while controlling production risk and reducing manual operational work.


What You'll Do

  • Make AI-assisted delivery faster and safer. Build automated validation, progressive rollout and recovery mechanisms that let engineers and agents move quickly with clear checks before and after changes reach production.
  • Make reliability measurable. Define and operationalize SLOs, SLIs and error budgets, and use them to guide practical decisions about delivery speed, stability and reliability work.
  • Automate workflows with AI agents. Identify repetitive operational work and build reusable agent-driven workflows for alert triage, incident investigation, routine maintenance and reporting. Add verification and human approval where needed, and measure the reduction in manual effort.
  • Improve observability and feedback. Evolve logging, metrics, tracing and alerting so failures are detected early and changes can be traced, investigated and verified.
  • Turn incidents into lasting improvements. Improve runbooks, investigation and blameless postmortems, and translate recurring problems into tests, safeguards and automation.
  • Keep infrastructure reproducible. Extend our Terraform and delivery tooling so environments remain consistent and changes stay reviewable as the platform grows.
  • Improve GCP reliability and efficiency. Strengthen our cloud infrastructure, networking, access controls and capacity management, balancing performance, reliability and cost.
  • Use AI to accelerate reliability engineering itself. Build maintainable tooling in Go, Python or a comparable language, and use agents to accelerate investigation, implementation, testing and documentation while verifying their outputs.


How We Work — AI-First, Agentic by Default

AI-assisted engineering is an expectation of this role, not an optional experiment. Claude Code, Cursor and agent-driven workflows are part of how we work, including infrastructure and reliability engineering.


We want someone who actively looks for ways to increase engineering speed with AI and makes those improvements safe to repeat. That means shorter feedback loops, automated checks, traceable changes and recovery paths — not simply generating more code.

You remain accountable for engineering judgment: what to automate, how to verify it, when human approval is needed and when a change should be stopped or rolled back. Success means faster delivery of reliable improvements, less repetitive work and a platform the team can trust.


What You'll Bring

Must-have

  • 6+ years in SRE, production engineering or infrastructure-heavy backend roles, with hands-on ownership of production systems.
  • Strong production GCP experience, including Cloud Run, networking and IAM. Hands-on Google Cloud experience is required and will be assessed during the interview process.
  • Infrastructure-as-code fluency with Terraform, plus solid experience in CI/CD and deployment safety.
  • Strong observability and troubleshooting skills: you can make systems debuggable, identify root causes and verify that a fix works.
  • Coding ability in Go, Python or a comparable language, with experience building maintainable operational tooling.
  • Experience leading production incident investigation and driving follow-up improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Practical fluency with AI coding agents and the ability to critically review, test and validate their work. You are motivated to make AI-assisted engineering faster and more dependable.
  • Strong written English and the discipline to collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team.


Nice to have

  • Kubernetes / GKE experience, including deploying, operating, debugging and scaling containerized services.
  • Hands-on Datadog experience, including dashboards, monitors, logs, APM and distributed tracing.
  • Experience improving delivery speed and safety through progressive delivery, policy-as-code and automated rollback.
  • GCP cost management or FinOps experience.
  • Security experience is a plus.


Why This Role

  • Shape how an AI-first engineering team scales. Build the reliability practices and automation that let Rabbit turn faster development into dependable customer outcomes.
  • Work on systems with real customer impact. Rabbit operates inside enterprise GCP environments, where reliability and security directly affect customer trust.
  • Own meaningful improvements. Work in a small team with short decision paths and end-to-end ownership, supported by appropriate review and production safeguards.
  • Use AI as an engineering multiplier. Apply agentic tools to infrastructure, delivery and operations, and help define how we measure and improve their impact.

name: Release Engineer - Bandung, Indonesia
description_html:
Description

About the Role

We are looking for a Release Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build, operate, coordinate, and continuously improve the processes used to reliably deliver software into production.

This role combines hands-on Release Engineering operations with program management. You will build and improve release planning and operations while coordinating releases across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SiteOps, Product, and Production Support.

You will help ensure that release scope, dependencies, risks, readiness, and timelines are visible across teams, while progressively automating the underlying release process.

The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and cross-functional release coordination — troubleshooting a failed pipeline one moment and facilitating a release-readiness discussion the next.

Location – Hybrid, Indonesia (2 days per week in the office)

What You’ll Be Doing

Release Program Management

  • Coordinate the end-to-end release program across Engineering, QA, Product, DevOps/SiteOps, and Production Support.
  • Set and communicate milestones, timelines, dependencies, readiness criteria, and decision points, while keeping visibility of release scope (Jira tickets, PRs, services, repos).
  • Track cross-team dependencies, risks, actions, decisions, exceptions, and blockers through to closure, escalating material risks early to Engineering leadership.
  • Facilitate release planning, readiness reviews, go/no-go discussions, and post-release reviews, and make sure release owners and teams understand their responsibilities and timelines.
  • Coordinate communication on scope, timeline, or production plan changes, and provide concise status reporting drawn from engineering systems rather than manual updates.

Release Operations

  • Coordinate releases across Sandbox, Sanity/Staging, and Production: work with QA on testing and certification, validate release branches (correct PRs and Jira tickets), and keep release notes accurate (changes, dependencies, deployment steps, config/DB changes, known issues, rollback).
  • Drive production readiness across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SiteOps, Product, and Support, support deployments and post-deployment verification, and handle hotfixes, emergency releases, rollbacks, and release-related production issues.
  • Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) and hotfix governance: manage approvals, risks, dependencies, go/no-go decisions, change calendar, deployment tracking, and post-release validation.
  • Run RCAs after failed releases and post-release improvement discussions, driving agreed actions to completion.
  • Act as a central coordination point without becoming a bottleneck: write tested release automation, join code/design reviews, maintain runbooks and release calendars, build dashboards and metrics (deployment success, rollbacks, change failure rate, release duration, manual interventions), and move toward exception-based release management.

About You

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in Release Engineering, DevOps, Build Engineering, Technical Program Management, or related role.
  • Hands-on CI/CD automation (Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or similar) and strong Git workflow knowledge: branches, PRs, merges, tags, versioning, cherry-picks, release branches.
  • Scripting or programming in Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell, or similar, with a solid grasp of build, test, packaging, deployment, and rollback processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting build, pipeline, deployment, configuration, and environment issues, with familiarity in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Coordinating technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders, managing dependencies, risks, milestones, actions, and decisions without unnecessary process overhead.
  • Strong organizational, ownership, problem-solving, facilitation, and communication skills: able to turn complex release details into clear status, risks, and decisions for different audiences, juggle concurrent releases, and be both hands-on and responsible for cross-team coordination.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience coordinating releases across multiple engineering/Scrum teams, using Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and release-planning workflows.
  • Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Background in SaaS products and distributed systems, including databases, storage, or messaging.
  • Experience automating release notes, quality gates, deployment validation, and rollbacks; building engineering dashboards and release-status reporting; familiarity with Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch and DORA metrics.
  • Preferred certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, SAFe® Release Train Engineer (RTE).

name: Site Reliability Engineer - Service Assurance Systems
description_html:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

The Service Assurance Systems (SAS) Group, part of Global Operations, develop and maintain many software systems and applications which support the operation of Viasat services.

The team collects assurance and operational data from a wide range of systems across the Viasat estate. This data is shared between internal platforms and distributed through Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where it underpins observability and monitoring capabilities that give operations teams real-time insight into service health and performance. To ensure the data is accurate and fit for purpose, the team builds and maintains data pipelines that cleanse, transform and enrich raw data, making it readily consumable by our stakeholders across operations, engineering and management.

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will play a key role in bridging the gap between software development and operational reliability. You will be responsible for supporting the applications built and maintained by the SAS group, managing deployments, investigating operational issues, and driving the team’s transition toward a modern DevOps culture. You will act as a first point of contact for service issues raised through the ServiceNow ticketing system, working to diagnose, triage and resolve incidents efficiently while collaborating closely with developers and operations teams.

The day-to-day

You will be working as part of a small team of developers and operations engineers, supporting the evolution of Viasat’s network and service monitoring capabilities, ensuring it remains world class in support of existing and future services.

Day-to-day the role will involve:

  • Investigate and resolve incidents, service requests and problems raised through the ServiceNow ticketing system, ensuring timely and thorough resolution within agreed SLAs.
  • Manage and oversee application deployments across development, staging and production environments, ensuring smooth and reliable release processes.
  • Monitor application and infrastructure health using observability tools such as Prometheus and AWS CloudWatch; proactively identify and respond to anomalies and performance degradation.
  • Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines, working to improve build, test and deployment automation to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
  • Champion and drive the adoption of DevOps practices and culture within the SAS group, working towards greater automation, infrastructure-as-code, and operational maturity.
  • Manage and maintain containerised workloads using Docker, and support the operation of services hosted on AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Write and maintain operational scripts (primarily Python) to automate routine tasks, support incident investigations and improve team efficiency.
  • Collaborate with software developers to identify recurring operational issues and feed findings back into the development process to improve application resilience.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date operational documentation including runbooks, deployment guides and incident post-mortems.
  • Provide written and verbal progress updates on open incidents, deployments and operational improvements to the SAS group and wider stakeholders.
  • Support on-call and out-of-hours incident response as required.
  • Liaise with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure system changes are communicated and operationally risk-assessed before deployment.


What You'll Need

  • Familiarity with both Windows and Linux operating systems, including command-line administration and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrable experience with SQL or data pipeline technologies.
  • Experience with data processing frameworks such as Apache Airflow, Apache Flink or Google Dataflow, with a practical understanding of ETL pipeline design and the ability to diagnose issues across data transformation and scheduling workflows.
  • Demonstrable CI/CD experience — building, maintaining and improving pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g. EC2, S3, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch) and containerisation using Docker.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, including Prometheus and AWS CloudWatch, for metrics collection, alerting and dashboarding.
  • Proficiency in scripting with Python for automation, tooling and operational support tasks.
  • Strong communication skills — able to clearly articulate technical issues and their impact to both technical and non-technical audiences, and to provide timely updates on incident progress.
  • Experience using an ITSM/ticketing system (e.g. ServiceNow) for incident management, request fulfilment and problem tracking.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach with strong attention to detail and a commitment to operational excellence.
  • A reasonable understanding and appreciation of IT and security standard methodologies in an operational environment.


What Will Help You On The Job

  • Understanding of TCP/IP networking principles, including the ability to diagnose connectivity issues and interpret network traffic.
  • Familiarity with event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, including an understanding of producer/consumer patterns and how message queues are used to move data reliably between systems at scale.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Experience with log aggregation and analysis platforms such as the OTEL Stack or AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
  • Experience working in an Agile or DevOps team environment.


EEO Statement

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

name: DevOps Engineer (Contract Basis)
description_html:
Description

📌 EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

  • Employment type: through 3rd party/ vendor
  • Duration: 24 months fixed term (subject to change based on business needs)
  • Work setup: Full onsite with dedicated full office hours based in BSD, Tangerang.

THE ROLE

Senior

  • Lead the design, provisioning, and scaling of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) across multiple product lines.
  • Strategize the DevOps roadmap in partnership with Engineering leadership by defining standards, tooling choices, and long-term infrastructure direction.
  • Authorize technical decisions on infrastructure architecture, CI/CD pipeline design, and automation frameworks.
  • Synergize efforts across development, security, and platform teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable deployments.
  • Negotiate trade-offs between reliability, cost, security, and delivery speed, providing clear recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Lead incident response and root-cause analysis for critical production issues, driving long-term remediation.
  • Enable safe AI-assisted engineering workflows by improving test execution, environment reproducibility, access controls, and documentation.
  • Evaluate emerging DevOps tools and platforms; recommend adoption where they meaningfully improve reliability, security, or velocity.
  • Formulate and enforce security best practices, compliance standards, and disaster recovery strategies across infrastructure.
  • Lead the strategy for infrastructure-as-code governance, versioning, and configuration management.
  • Mentor and grow mid and junior engineers through structured feedback, pairing, and technical guidance.

  • Evaluate and implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar) for provisioning and configuration management.

  • Contribute to security hardening tasks including patching, access reviews, and basic vulnerability remediation.
  • Stay current with DevOps trends and evaluate new tools or techniques relevant to the team's work.

Requirements

Senior
