  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including multi-account and multi-region architecture.
  • Proven mastery of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) and configuration management at scale.
  • Extensive experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD, or equivalent).
  • Strong command of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) in production environments.
  • Deep experience with observability i.e monitoring, logging, and tracing (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar).
  • Proven ability to design and maintain highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure infrastructure.
  • Experience leading security governance: vulnerability management, access control, and compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and the security considerations around code, logs, secrets, and automation access.
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Bash, Python, or Go) for automation and tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with incident management, on-call leadership, and post-mortem processes.
  • Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

Mid

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure roles.
  • Solid proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and core services (compute, networking, storage).
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Working knowledge of scripting languages (Bash, Python, or Go).
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar).
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for scripting, debugging, documentation, or workflow automation is an advantage.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, system security, and performance optimization.

name: Infra Engineer (AI Agents) | IDR 30-45m p/m
description_html:
Kulu builds an AI agent that joins live meetings — it listens, speaks, sees the user's shared screen, and takes actions in real time. Everything runs on realtime infrastructure: WebRTC media, streaming LLM sessions, a Python backend, and the cloud underneath.


We're hiring an infrastructure engineer to run it with us. You'll join our Foundation team, reporting directly to the CTO, and your work will centre on three things in the first half year: migrating us from AWS to GCP, building our monitoring from the ground up, and keeping production healthy when things break.


We're a small, high-bandwidth team, deliberately building toward a more in-person culture in Bali.


Tasks



  • Design, build, and maintain the realtime platform Kulu's AI assistant runs on — WebRTC media infrastructure, streaming multimodal LLM sessions, and the Python backend behind them: the foundation every user conversation rides on.

  • Own reliability, performance, and observability of Kulu's core services: the realtime pipeline end to end — rooms, agents, audio in/out, and the recording pipeline — and the telemetry that turns “the agent felt slow” into a number with a cause.

  • Own the LLM streaming session layer as an engineering system — connection lifecycle, streaming, reconnection and resumption, tool-call plumbing, timeouts and watchdogs — so that behaviour changes designed by the AI product lead land on a reliable substrate.

  • Own deployment and infrastructure across our AWS environment and CI/CD pipelines, and drive our infrastructure-as-code programme (OpenTofu).

  • Maintain the platform in production and respond to incidents: triage, root-cause, and fix live issues across the stack, then feed every incident back into telemetry, runbooks, and infrastructure as code so it can't happen silently twice.

  • Build services that handle sensitive meeting data with the privacy, correctness, and auditability our customers expect.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions as Kulu scales, with a particular focus on system correctness, data integrity, and security.

  • Bring strong engineering fundamentals to every problem: well-tested, maintainable code, clear data models, and systems that degrade gracefully under pressure.

  • Maintain strong documentation and champion operational excellence across the engineering culture.

  • Ship end to end: you write the migration, deploy the service, and watch the dashboards after.



Requirements



  • 3+ years of production experience in a DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, or backend infrastructure role.

  • Production experience writing and owning infrastructure as code (Terraform/OpenTofu).

  • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tooling (Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, ELK, or equivalent).

  • Strong programming skills in Python (asyncio, FastAPI or similar) and solid shell scripting (Bash).

  • Solid operational experience with AWS or GCP — ideally some of both, since your first project is migrating us from one to the other — including IAM, secrets management, VPC and networking.

  • Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar); proficiency with Git and branching strategies.

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and fault-tolerant service design.

  • Solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL, schema migrations); Redis in production.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure and application security best practices.

  • Strong AI-tool skills: AI is part of how you read, write, and debug code.

  • Clear communicator; fluent spoken and written English — our company language is exclusively English.



Nice to Have



  • AWS or GCP certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).

  • Security compliance experience — supporting a certification programme (SOC 2 / ISO 42001), access management, or audit preparation.

  • Experience supporting eval or model-quality infrastructure.



Our Stack


Python (FastAPI, asyncio) · WebRTC media infrastructure · streaming multimodal LLM APIs · PostgreSQL · Redis · React + TypeScript · AWS · GitHub Actions · OpenTofu · Datadog


Benefits


IDR 25–40m/month gross


What Success Looks Like



  • First month: you can deploy, configure, and debug our infrastructure on your own, and the GCP migration plan is ready — target architecture chosen, quotas requested, steps written down.

  • Three months: the migration is finished — our environments run on GCP, fully managed as code — the first dashboards and alerts are live, and when something breaks in production, you're the person who handles it.

  • Six months: AWS is fully shut down; "is production healthy" is one look at a dashboard you built; incidents are diagnosed in minutes instead of hours; the team ships every week without worrying about infrastructure.



Our Operating Principles:



  • Always Be Hustlin' – Move fast, outwork the competition, stay scrappy.

  • Relentlessly Curious – Reason from first principles, question assumptions and explore better ways.

  • Super Pumped – Show relentless enthusiasm and drive.

  • Make Magic – Create experiences that delight customers.

  • Obsess Over the Details – Perfect the product experience, no matter how small.

  • Big Bold Bets – Think big, take risks and go after huge, transformative opportunities.

  • Ownership is Key – Own the outcome, not just the task.



As Kulu grows, this role naturally expands with the Foundation team — a full-stack engineer will join on Simu, and there is a clear path to owning our infrastructure and reliability function outright.

description_html:
Role Overview

As a Senior AI/MLOps Engineer specializing in ML Pipeline & Platform Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in scaling Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison's AI and data intelligence capabilities across our digital ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, automation, and operational management of high-throughput machine learning pipelines and cloud platform environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will empower data scientists and AI engineers by building robust CI/CD deployment automation, optimizing high-scale BigQuery workflows, enforcing zero-trust platform security guardrails, and supporting emerging Agentic AI platform integrations to accelerate Indonesia's digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and Operate ML Pipelines: Design, build, compile, and maintain enterprise-grade Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) and Vertex AI Pipelines for automated training, evaluation, continuous batch inference, and automated retraining.
  • Optimize High-Scale Data Workflows: Engineer and optimize large-scale BigQuery data extraction, partitioned and clustered dataset transformations, and automated data pipelines handling multi-million row operational datasets.
  • Drive Platform Provisioning & Governance: Review Architectural Requirement Specifications (ARS) and execute infrastructure provisioning across GCP services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Spanner, Cloud Storage, and GKE).
  • Enforce Platform Security & Guardrails: Implement least-privileged Identity & Access Management (IAM), per-pipeline service account bindings, and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters to prevent unauthorized data access and egress leaks.
  • Champion Blast Radius Governance: Conduct comprehensive pre-deployment verification checklists for IAM policies, dependencies, and external partner integrations to guarantee zero service disruption.
  • Standardize CI/CD Automation: Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD runner pipelines for pipeline compilation, automated testing, container image packaging, and progressive environment promotion.
  • Secure AI Tooling & Developer Harnesses: Establish security guardrails and governance policies for internal AI tooling, CLI assistants, and IDE developer harnesses, ensuring secret isolation, token sanitization, and auditability.
  • Support Emerging Agentic AI Integrations: Enable operational runtime configurations and backend service connectivity for Agentic AI frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and conversational agent deployments.
  • Lead Technical Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot complex container dependency builds, private package repository configurations (Google Artifact Registry), and runtime environment discrepancies across Workbench and Cloud Build runners.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Governance, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Security, and external technology partners to ensure platform compliance, high availability, and rapid time-to-market.

Qualification

Professional Experience & Technical Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of total experience in software, data, or ML engineering, with at least 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in MLOps, DataOps, or DevOps within enterprise production environments.
  • Cloud & Big Data Mastery:
    • Deep operational expertise with Google Cloud Platform, specifically Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, and VPC Service Controls.
    • Strong experience in BigQuery performance tuning, partitioning, clustering, and stored procedures.
  • ML Pipeline & Orchestration:
    • Proven track record of designing, building, compiling, and monitoring production Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) or Vertex AI Pipelines.
    • Deep familiarity with model registry workflows, artifact versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Programming & Automation:
    • Expert-level proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, packaging, data structures, and cloud SDK integrations.
    • Strong foundation in Linux environments and shell scripting.
  • DevOps & CI/CD Tooling:
    • Hands-on expertise building enterprise CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Docker containerization, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
    • Experience managing private package repositories using Google Artifact Registry.
  • Security & Governance Acumen:
    • Practical experience securing day-to-day engineering AI harnesses, managing service account tokens, and implementing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) best practices.
  • Certifications:
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect (Preferred / Nice to have).
  • Value-Add / Bonus Qualifications:
    • Experience with Agentic AI engineering frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP servers).
    • Familiarity with RAG evaluation frameworks (such as Ragas or DeepEval) and vector databases.
    • Exposure to Cloud Spanner, Redis/Memorystore, or GraphDB integrations.
Behavioral Competencies

  • Problem-Solving Agility: Exceptional analytical and diagnostic skills with the ability to resolve complex infrastructure, pipeline, and security challenges under fast-paced operational conditions.
  • Proactive Ownership Mindset: High sense of accountability, initiative, and drive to transform operational lessons into scalable, automated standards.
  • Collaborative Communication: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary squads, data science teams, and vendor partners.
  • Continuous Learning & Adaptability: Eagerness to stay ahead of the curve in emerging MLOps practices, GenAI platform engineering, and modern cloud technologies.

name: AI Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
description_html:
Responsibilities

THIS JOB OPPORTUNITY IS FOR OUR PARTNERING COMPANY, SERTIS INDONESIA

[About Sertis Teknologi Indonesia]

Sertis Teknologi Indonesia builds AI and data solutions for enterprises in Indonesia. We apply leading-edge research and practices to push the boundaries of what AI can do, turning them into practical, innovative solutions for our clients. We also run our own on-premise AI platform, so clients, including those in regulated industries, can use advanced AI while their data stays private and under their control.

[About the Role]

We are looking for an AI Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to build, operate, and maintain our on-premise AI platform, powered by high-performance GPU servers in a data centre.

In this role, you will take ownership of the platform end to end, from preparing physical servers and configuring system environments to deploying AI systems and applications, maintaining infrastructure security, optimizing performance, and supporting clients in production.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about hardware, understands how software runs on physical systems, has a solid foundation in networking, and enjoys solving technical challenges while delivering reliable services to clients.

[Key Responsibilities]

  • GPU Server Setup & Management: Prepare and configure servers after hardware installation, including operating systems, user permissions, secure access, firewalls, storage, software RAID, and disk encryption. Maintain GPU drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, and related system components.
  • System & Application Deployment: Deploy, configure, and maintain systems and applications, primarily AI-related workloads, on the on-premise platform. Manage containerized deployments, application updates, versioning, and rollbacks while ensuring secure connectivity and appropriate firewall configurations.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Build and maintain monitoring systems, dashboards, and alerts for GPU utilization, server health, network performance, and application services. Establish performance baselines and identify potential issues before they affect clients.
  • Performance Optimization: Conduct load and performance testing, assess platform capacity, and improve system reliability, application responsiveness, and GPU utilization within data centre power and cooling constraints.
  • Troubleshooting & Incident Management: Diagnose and resolve issues across hardware, operating systems, storage, networks, and applications. Identify root causes, document solutions, and maintain clear operational procedures.
  • Client Onboarding & Technical Support: Support client onboarding, access provisioning, API key management, data separation, and usage limits. Act as a technical point of contact, provide technical consultations and usage reports, and help resolve incidents in line with agreed service levels.
  • Security & Infrastructure Operations: Maintain access controls, logging, encryption, backups, and security documentation. Coordinate with hardware vendors and data centre providers on maintenance, repairs, warranties, and infrastructure requirements.

Requirements

[Main Requirements]

  • Are enthusiastic and passionate about computer hardware, particularly GPUs, CPUs, and server infrastructure.
  • Understand how to install, configure, and run software on physical hardware, from operating systems and system services to applications.
  • Have experience managing Linux servers in production, with a solid understanding of SSH, storage, networking, and security hardening.
  • Have hands-on experience with GPU servers, including drivers, CUDA, and troubleshooting. Experience with AI workloads or large language model deployment is a plus.
  • Understand the fundamentals of networking, connectivity, firewalls, and network security.
  • Are familiar with containers and scripting using Bash or Python.
  • Can build or maintain monitoring and alerting systems, such as Prometheus and Grafana, and understand how to identify meaningful metrics.
  • Enjoy troubleshooting issues across hardware, operating systems, networks, and applications using logs, metrics, and system tools.
  • Use innovative tools, including AI tools, to work efficiently while carefully reviewing and validating their output before production use.
  • Have strong client-facing and service-oriented skills, with the ability to support onboarding, prepare technical reports, explain technical issues, and provide practical consultations.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of technical responsibilities in a dynamic environment.

[Nice to Have]

  • Experience with multi-GPU servers, GPU interconnects, or AI inference engines such as vLLM.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools, high-speed networking (100 Gbps or above), or infrastructure performance testing.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure security, data privacy, or compliance standards such as ISO 27001 and financial-sector regulations.

name: Cloud Engineer
description_html:
About Terralogiq:

Pioneering Geospatial Intelligence and Cloud Innovation in Asia


Join Terralogiq, a leading Google Cloud Premier Partner in Asia, and be part of a team that is redefining what's possible with technology. Established in 2013, PT Terralogiq Integrasi Solusi is the market leader in Indonesia for location intelligence, geospatial solutions, and cloud services. As part of a global technology family with over 16 years of experience, we combine the agility and local expertise of a market leader with the resources and stability of a global enterprise.


Our mission is to empower businesses to thrive in the digital age. We are the first and only Google Maps Premier Partner in Indonesia, and our expertise in Google Cloud has enabled over 250 clients—from innovative startups to major state-owned enterprises—to transform their operations. We build solutions that matter, powering everything from nationwide logistics to smart city applications and disaster management platforms. At Terralogiq, you won’t just be building infrastructure; you'll be engineering the future of digital Indonesia.


The Opportunity: Contribute to a Landmark Cloud Transformation

We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Cloud Engineer to join one of our most significant current engagements: the end-to-end migration of a major enterprise client's entire on-premises infrastructure to the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is not just a "lift and shift" project; it is a complete modernization initiative that will set a new standard for performance, scalability, and security.


As the ideal candidate, you are a hands-on professional who thrives on complex challenges. You will be a key contributor to the migration lifecycle—from design and planning to implementation and post-migration optimization. This is a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on a high-visibility project and grow your expertise in large-scale cloud transformation.


Your Impact: Core Responsibilities


a. Migration & Implementation

  • Deploy and configure scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform.
  • Collaborate with customer teams to assess their existing environment, applications, and dependencies.
  • Manage data migration, ensuring integrity and minimal downtime.


b. Technical Support & Enablement

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues related to networking, virtual machines, databases, and containerization.

  • Monitor the health, performance, and security of the new cloud environment using tools like Google Cloud's operations suite.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for performance tuning, cost optimization, and automation.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for application deployments.
  • Ensure the infrastructure remains up-to-date and compliant with industry best practices.


Foundational Skills: Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)

  • Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (ACE) or Professional Cloud Architect Certification (PCA)
  • Level L2 IT Engineer with a minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in cloud operations
  • Hands-on experience contributing to a large-scale on-premises to cloud migration project.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Solid understanding and practical experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, preferably GKE).
  • Strong scripting skills for automation using Python or Bash.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, security principles, and identity access management (IAM).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a customer-facing role.

name: DevSecOps (Network & IoT/Embedded Security)
description_html:
Location : Open in Indonesia (Bali/Bandung Based)

Experience Level : 5 years

Employment Type : Full-time


About the Company

We’re a growing technology company focused on building reliable and scalable solutions that help businesses improve their operations. Our products connect software, hardware, and real-world workflows to create value across industries. We believe in teamwork, accountability, and a product mindset that blends creativity with strong technical execution.


About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Security Analyst Engineer to protect our network, cloud, and connected-device ecosystem. You will assess, monitor, and harden infrastructure and IoT/embedded devices (cameras, sensors, gateways, edge devices), and work closely with infrastructure, development, and product teams to build security into what we ship and operate.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and maintain security measures across system infrastructure, cloud environments, and embedded systems.

• Monitor, triage, and respond to security events across networks, servers, cloud, and IoT/edge environments.

• Run vulnerability assessments and penetration tests (internal, network, and devicelevel) and track remediation to closure.

• Review and harden network architecture: firewalls, segmentation/VLANs, VPNs, load balancers, WAF, and secure remote access.

• Assess IoT and embedded device security, including firmware and configuration review, default credentials, exposed services, and insecure protocols.

• Secure IoT communication layers such as MQTT brokers, device authentication, TLS/certificate management, and message-queue access.

• Write and maintain firewall rules, IPTables policies, IDS/IPS rules, and log-analysis queries to detect and block attacks (e.g., brute force, scanning, abnormal device behavior).

• Support hybrid (cloud + on-premises) security: IAM, security groups, firewalls, and log collection and analysis.

• Automate security tasks and configuration using scripts and tools such as Ansible, Bash, or Python.

• Deploy, configure, and maintain Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions to continuously monitor, detect, and respond to security events.

• Establish and maintain security monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management processes across IT infrastructure and embedded environments.

• Develop, implement, and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and security best practices across the organization.

• Support internal and external cybersecurity audits and ensure compliance with customer security requirements and international security standards.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate security-by-design principles into product development.

• Produce clear incident reports, risk assessments, and security documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with relevant cybersecurity standards and regulations.

• Support secure system architecture design for both software and embedded solutions.


Requirements

1. Education and Experience

• Experience: Usually requires 5+ years of experience in software development, system and network administration, IT operations, and or cybersecurity.

• Education: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field is commonly preferred, though practical project experience and selftaught portfolios often weigh more heavily.


2. Technical Skills & Tech Stack

• Operating Systems & Networking: Strong grasp of Linux/Unix administration, TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and network security concepts.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Experience building and securing pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket CI, Jenkins, or TeamCity.

• Containers & Orchestration: Knowledge of Docker for containerization and Kubernetes (K8s) for cluster security and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation, alongside IaC security scanning tools.

• Cloud Platforms: Knowledges and or experience with major cloud providers like AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), or Microsoft Azure and Privilege IAM policies.

• Nice to have : Understanding in at least one or more languages such as Python, Bash, or Shell scripting for automation


3. Security-Specific Competencies

• Application Security Testing: Integrating SAST (Static Application Security Testing) and DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing), plus Software Composition Analysis (SCA).

• Vulnerability & Secret Scanning: Using tools like Blackduck, Snyk, SonarQube, TruffleHog, GitLeaks or similar to catch exposed secrets and package flaws early.

• Frameworks & Threat Modeling: Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10, threat modeling methodologies, and compliance standards (such as GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI-DSS).


4. Soft Skills & Collaboration

• Cross-functional bridge: Ability to translate complex security risks into actionable engineering priorities for developers.

• Problem-solving: Strong troubleshooting skills for live production environments and incident response. 


Nice to have qualification

• Familiarity with international cybersecurity standards such as EU-RED (Radio Equipment Directive), CRA (Cyber Resilience Act), or similar frameworks.

• Experience working with embedded or IoT device security.

• Knowledge of secure coding practices and DevSecOps concepts.

• Experience leading or participating in ISO 27001 certification or surveillance audits.

• Familiarity with SOC 2 Type I/Type II readiness or compliance projects.

• Experience implementing security controls for embedded systems, IoT devices, and cloud infrastructure.

• Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or equivalent are a plus.


What We Offer

• Opportunity to work on complex and impactful system platforms.

• Collaborative environment with a supportive and experienced cross-functional team.

• Be part of an environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.

• Supportive team environment with Flat hierarchy.

name: AI Solutions Engineer (Engineering Infrastructure) - Sea Labs
description_html:
About The Team

The Engineering and Technology team is at the core of the Shopee platform development. The team is made up of a group of passionate engineers from all over the world, striving to build the best systems with the most suitable technologies. Our engineers do not merely solve problems at hand; We build foundations for a long-lasting future. We don't limit ourselves on what we can or can't do; we take matters into our own hands even if it means drilling down to the bottom layer of the computing platform. Shopee's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience it first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do.

About Team

The AI Solutions team builds and pioneers the future of AI-driven automation at Sea. We are the developers of Smart (Sea Multi-Agent Realization Platform) - the company's flagship AI agents platform that enables teams across the company to automate their workflows using large language model (LLM) agents. But Smart is just the beginning.

Our team is also spearheading a wide range of AI initiatives, especially within the engineering infrastructure domain, from internal developer tooling to intelligent operations. We believe that the future of infrastructure lies in intelligent automation, and we’re committed to building it from the ground up.

We thrive in a fast-paced, sharing-first culture, with a strong emphasis on learning, creativity, and experimentation. We work hard and play hard, explore ideas on the cutting edge, and aim to pioneer bold, practical solutions to complex real-world problems. If you want to shape how AI changes engineering at scale - this is the place.

Job Description

  • Design and develop the Smart platform and other AI systems, covering all essential agent platform components - agent runtimes, toolchains, memory, orchestration, logging, planning, and sandboxing.
  • Collaborate with teams across departments - both tech and non-tech - to land and scale real-world AI use cases.
  • Drive internal agent adoption in engineering infra by replacing traditional operations with intelligent agent workflows.
  • Work on platform reliability and observability to ensure our systems are performant, debuggable, and production-ready.
  • Support operations and development work in a healthy balance - you’ll gain experience in shipping features and running real services.
  • Manage and operate supporting infrastructure, including vector stores, retrieval systems (RAG), and middleware components.
  • Continuously experiment, learn, and bring in the latest advancements from the AI/agent ecosystem into production.
  • Continuously optimize system performance through tuning, profiling, and root-cause analysis.
  • Design and develop an automated technical operations platform to reduce manual work and improve reliability.
  • Drive capacity and resource management, ensuring systems scale efficiently under varying workloads.
  • Plan and execute stress tests and load tests to identify bottlenecks, improve throughput, and eliminate redundancy.
  • Improve system reliability, availability, and observability through better monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response practices.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, middleware, and infrastructure layers.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in software development - or fresh graduates with strong fundamentals and hunger to learn.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (primary) - familiarity with Golang is a plus.
  • Solid CS fundamentals - algorithms, data structures, networking, systems, and architecture.
  • Backend experience designing cloud-ready services using databases, queues, caching, etc.
  • Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or strong interest in learning them.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to navigate ambiguity with curiosity and creativity.
  • Willingness to work full stack - we prioritize backend but value well-rounded engineers.
  • General understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native principles (e.g. the twelve-factor app), including how services are deployed, scaled, and load-balanced in a containerized environment.
  • Passion for building AI systems that people actually use.

Skills Below Are Optional But Preferred

  • Experience building AI-powered platforms, assistants, or automation tools.
  • Familiarity with agent patterns like ReAct (Reasoning and Action), tool chaining, or multi-agent orchestration.
  • Knowledge of RAG systems, vector databases, or prompt tuning.
  • Prior experience in developer tools, internal platforms, or large-scale systems.
  • Exposure to observability, debugging, incident workflows, or service reliability.

name: System Administrator Manager | Web Hosting Team
description_html:
Join the team building an AI-first company.

Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Your role at Hostinger

Join Hostinger's Product team as SysAdmins Manager and lead the Web Hosting SysAdmin team in Indonesia. The team keeps more than 1,600 bare-metal hosting servers across 16+ data centres healthy and covers the Asia-Pacific daytime window of our 24/7 global rotation, working hand in hand with the Lithuanian and Brazilian SysAdmin teams.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. About half of your time stays technical: you operate, debug and ship alongside your engineers. The other half goes into your people: hiring, coaching, protecting the team's health and setting them up to succeed.

You own the team's shift coverage and incident response, but you are not personally on rotation or on-call. You will work closely with engineering, developer, Customer Success and product managers.

Curious to learn more? Meet your future Team Lead: Teodoras Celencevičius

Your day-to-day

  • Lead the Indonesian Web Hosting SysAdmin team and own its shift coverage: you design the rotation, you are not on it;
  • Own incident response in your window: acknowledgement, customer communication, postmortems and follow-up within SLA;
  • Act as the sysadmin escalation point for Customer Success on complex hosting and security cases;
  • Stay hands-on across a fleet running CloudLinux, LiteSpeed, cPanel/WHM and MariaDB: diagnose, optimise and fix;
  • Deliver long-term engineering and automation with Ansible/AWX, Prometheus and Grafana that removes repetitive shift work;
  • Drive AI adoption in operations: automated ticket resolution, AI-assisted diagnosis and faster runbooks;
  • Hire, onboard and coach; run weekly reporting, team KPIs and quarterly performance reviews;
  • Coordinate daily with the Lithuanian and Brazilian SysAdmin teams, WH engineering and product, and make the final technical call when the team needs one.

What will help you succeed

  • You have 3+ years supporting enterprise-scale Linux environments, including database and web-server performance tuning;
  • You have 1+ years leading or mentoring an engineering or sysadmin team, ideally one that runs shifts or on-call;
  • You have hands-on experience with the web hosting stack: cPanel/WHM, LiteSpeed, Apache or Nginx, MariaDB/MySQL, CloudLinux (LVE, CageFS);
  • You understand on-premises / bare-metal infrastructure;
  • You are comfortable with security hardening and malware response on shared hosting (Imunify360, Monarx or similar);
  • You script and automate: Bash or Python, Ansible;
  • You have hired before and know what a strong sysadmin looks like in an interview;
  • Your English skills are C1 - C2;
  • You are a constant learner who loves Linux and cares about uptime, people and clean processes.

Meet your team

The Web Hosting SysAdmin team keeps the infrastructure behind Hostinger's hosting services healthy, stable, and ready to support millions of customers worldwide. We are distributed across Indonesia, Lithuania and Brazil, which gives us round-the-clock coverage and expertise from three markets.

Each location has its own team and manager, but we work as one: shared runbooks, shared incidents, shared goals. In Indonesia, you will lead an experienced sysadmin team who care deeply about Linux and about making our hosting environment better every week.

Benefits you'll love

🚀 360° Growth: You'll never stop learning here. Get access to Reforge and CoachHub, go to global conferences, and borrow from our physical and digital libraries. Depending on your location, you can mentor or be mentored through TesoXchange. People give each other open feedback, share what they know, and take on new projects as their skills grow.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work where you do your best work: our offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, Jakarta, or Luxembourg, your home, or anywhere in the world. You plan your own day and own your results, and good ideas go live fast.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your wellbeing comes first. You get time off to recharge, a Headspace subscription, and events focused on wellbeing. Depending on your location, you also get health insurance from day one, a gym membership, regular health checks, and clubs for sports, arts, and hobbies.

🎉 Work hard – play hard: We celebrate wins together at Summerfest & Winterfest, Town Halls, team-buildings, and workations. Meet the Client sessions connect you directly with the people you build for. Milestones outside work matter too, so we celebrate weddings, new parenthood, and graduations with you.

Compensation

We’re always looking for exceptional talent to raise the bar, with compensation reflecting your experience and the impact and value you bring.

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

Three. Two. Onboard.

Apply LLMs and AI agents to automate triage, summarization, root-cause hints and report generation, and continuously evaluate and improve their accuracy.

name: Cybersecurity Engineer (Infrastructure Security)
description_html:
Blibli is on a journey to become Indonesia’s #1 e-commerce platform — built on trust, innovation, and care. We’re creating better experiences for customers, merchants, brands, and sellers through technology, collaboration, and a deep commitment to quality. Here, every idea matters and every action helps us grow stronger together.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer (Infrastructure Security) , you will play a critical role in securing and enabling our e-commerce platform by designing, implementing, and continuously improving cloud and infrastructure security controls. This role focuses on protecting customer trust, ensuring business continuity, supporting compliance requirements such as PCI DSS and ISO 27001, and embedding security into engineering processes so that teams can ship products quickly and securely without compromising risk management.

What You'll Work On Together

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud security architectures across AWS, GCP, or Azure environments.

Qualifications

At our company, cybersecurity is not a gatekeeper function, it's a business enabler. You'll work directly with engineering teams to protect revenue, customer trust, payment operations, and platform availability while helping the business scale securely. If you're passionate about cloud security, automation, infrastructure engineering, and solving complex challenges in a fast-moving e-commerce environment, we'd love to hear from you.

name: System Administrator Manager | Web Hosting Team
description_html:
Join the team building an AI-first company.

Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Your role at Hostinger

Join Hostinger's Product team as SysAdmins Manager and lead the Web Hosting SysAdmin team in Indonesia. The team keeps more than 1,600 bare-metal hosting servers across 16+ data centres healthy and covers the Asia-Pacific daytime window of our 24/7 global rotation, working hand in hand with the Lithuanian and Brazilian SysAdmin teams.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. About half of your time stays technical: you operate, debug and ship alongside your engineers. The other half goes into your people: hiring, coaching, protecting the team's health and setting them up to succeed.

You own the team's shift coverage and incident response, but you are not personally on rotation or on-call. You will work closely with engineering, developer, Customer Success and product managers.

Curious to learn more? Meet your future Team Lead: Teodoras Celencevičius

Your day-to-day

  • Lead the Indonesian Web Hosting SysAdmin team and own its shift coverage: you design the rotation, you are not on it;
  • Own incident response in your window: acknowledgement, customer communication, postmortems and follow-up within SLA;
  • Act as the sysadmin escalation point for Customer Success on complex hosting and security cases;
  • Stay hands-on across a fleet running CloudLinux, LiteSpeed, cPanel/WHM and MariaDB: diagnose, optimise and fix;
  • Deliver long-term engineering and automation with Ansible/AWX, Prometheus and Grafana that removes repetitive shift work;
  • Drive AI adoption in operations: automated ticket resolution, AI-assisted diagnosis and faster runbooks;
  • Hire, onboard and coach; run weekly reporting, team KPIs and quarterly performance reviews;
  • Coordinate daily with the Lithuanian and Brazilian SysAdmin teams, WH engineering and product, and make the final technical call when the team needs one.

What will help you succeed

  • You have 3+ years supporting enterprise-scale Linux environments, including database and web-server performance tuning;
  • You have 1+ years leading or mentoring an engineering or sysadmin team, ideally one that runs shifts or on-call;
  • You have hands-on experience with the web hosting stack: cPanel/WHM, LiteSpeed, Apache or Nginx, MariaDB/MySQL, CloudLinux (LVE, CageFS);
  • You understand on-premises / bare-metal infrastructure;
  • You are comfortable with security hardening and malware response on shared hosting (Imunify360, Monarx or similar);
  • You script and automate: Bash or Python, Ansible;
  • You have hired before and know what a strong sysadmin looks like in an interview;
  • Your English skills are C1 - C2;
  • You are a constant learner who loves Linux and cares about uptime, people and clean processes.

Meet your team

The Web Hosting SysAdmin team keeps the infrastructure behind Hostinger's hosting services healthy, stable, and ready to support millions of customers worldwide. We are distributed across Indonesia, Lithuania and Brazil, which gives us round-the-clock coverage and expertise from three markets.

Each location has its own team and manager, but we work as one: shared runbooks, shared incidents, shared goals. In Indonesia, you will lead an experienced sysadmin team who care deeply about Linux and about making our hosting environment better every week.

Benefits you'll love

🚀 360° Growth: You'll never stop learning here. Get access to Reforge and CoachHub, go to global conferences, and borrow from our physical and digital libraries. Depending on your location, you can mentor or be mentored through TesoXchange. People give each other open feedback, share what they know, and take on new projects as their skills grow.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work where you do your best work: our offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, Jakarta, or Luxembourg, your home, or anywhere in the world. You plan your own day and own your results, and good ideas go live fast.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your wellbeing comes first. You get time off to recharge, a Headspace subscription, and events focused on wellbeing. Depending on your location, you also get health insurance from day one, a gym membership, regular health checks, and clubs for sports, arts, and hobbies.

🎉 Work hard – play hard: We celebrate wins together at Summerfest & Winterfest, Town Halls, team-buildings, and workations. Meet the Client sessions connect you directly with the people you build for. Milestones outside work matter too, so we celebrate weddings, new parenthood, and graduations with you.

Compensation

We’re always looking for exceptional talent to raise the bar, with compensation reflecting your experience and the impact and value you bring.

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

Three. Two. Onboard.

name: Hybrid Healthcare System Architect & Analyst (On Premise + Cloud)
description_html:
Requirements

  • Kualifikasi

Wajib

  • Pengalaman 2+ tahun sebagai System Architect, Technical Analyst, atau Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) untuk produk SaaS/on-prem hybrid.
  • Pernah menangani minimal 30+ instansi/deployment yang tersebar (bukan satu aplikasi besar).

Diutamakan

  • Pernah melakukan post-mortem analysis untuk sistem kesehatan skala nasional.
  • Familiar dengan cost allocation tags dan showback/chargeback untuk multi-tenant.
  • Pengalaman dengan edge computing atau distributed database (CockroachDB, Yugabyte, atau Cassandra).
  • Output yang Diharapkan (Dalam 3-6 Bulan Pertama)

Bulan Output Utama

1 Laporan post-deployment review dari 66 RS: top 5 masalah, variasi biaya antar RS, dan rekomendasi quick wins.

2 Model biaya per RS dan simulasi untuk group 5, 10, 20 RS (termasuk grafik break-even).

3 Playbook improvement untuk 3 masalah prioritas tertinggi (misal: reduksi biaya sync cloud 40%).

4-6 Implementasi dashboard cost & performa per RS/group + pilot untuk 2 rumah sakit group pertama.

  • Indikator Keberhasilan (KPI)
  • Penurunan biaya cloud rata-rata per RS sebesar 20% dalam 6 bulan (setelah rekomendasi diimplementasikan).
  • Peningkatan uptime sync hybrid dari baseline ke 99.5%.
    • Akurasi model cost effectiveness (prediksi vs aktual untuk group baru) dengan error
  • Adopsi rekomendasi oleh tim engineering & product minimal 80% dalam 3 bulan setelah disetujui.
  • Kepuasan klien group (NPS meningkat 15 poin karena transparansi biaya).
  • Tools yang Akan Digunakan

    • Kategori Tools

    Observability Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor

    Cost Analysis CloudHealth, Vantage, atau custom script + BigQuery

    Data Analysis SQL (PostgreSQL/BigQuery), Python (Pandas), Metabase

    Documentation Miro (arsitektur), Notion (rekomendasi), Google Slides (presentasi ke klien group)

    Version Control Git (untuk infrastruktur as code dan script analisis)

    Responsibilities

    • Tanggung Jawab Utama
    • Analisis post-deployment dari rumah sakit group
    • Mengumpulkan dan menganalisis data performa aktual dari implementasi group RS: latency sync hybrid, uptime, error rate, utilisasi resource on-prem (CPU/RAM/storage), konsumsi bandwidth, dan biaya cloud per RS.
    • Mengidentifikasi pola kegagalan umum (misal: sync gagal karena koneksi RS tidak stabil, database lock pada jam sibuk, konflik data).
    • Membuat heatmap masalah berdasarkan tipe RS (tipe A, B, C, D) dan lokasi (kota besar vs kabupaten).
    • Rekomendasi Improvement Sistem
    • Menyusun prioritas perbaikan berdasarkan dampak ke rumah sakit (misal: modul billing lambat, backup gagal, integrasi SATUSEHAT sering timeout).
    • Memberikan rekomendasi konkret:
    • Arsitektur: Perubahan pola sinkronasi (dari batch ke CDC real-time), redisain queue mechanism, atau penambahan edge node di RS.
    • Konfigurasi: Optimalisasi parameter DB, connection pooling, kompresi data.
    • Proses: Standarisasi instalasi on-prem untuk RS baru.
    • Membuat playbook upgrade untuk 66 RS secara bertahap tanpa downtime panjang.
    • Cost Effectiveness untuk Rumah Sakit Group
    • Membangun model biaya per RS dan per RS group dengan mempertimbangkan:
    • On-prem cost: Server, storage, listrik, IT lokal RS (jika ada).
    • Cloud cost: Compute, storage, data transfer (sync inbound/outbound), API calls ke BPJS/Kemenkes.
    • Support cost: Remote troubleshooting, on-site visit, training.
    • Menghitung ekonomi skala untuk group:
    • Jika satu group (misal 10 RS) menggunakan shared cloud environment (satu tenant cloud untuk semua RS) vs isolated per RS.
    • Berapa penghematan dari shared gateway integrasi (satu koneksi ke SATUSEHAT untuk 10 RS).
    • Analisis break-even point: kapan jumlah RS dalam group membuat shared infrastructure lebih murah daripada terpisah.
    • Memberikan rekomendasi pricing model untuk klien group: apakah subscription flat, per transaksi, atau hybrid.
    • Continuous Improvement Framework
    • Menyusun dashboard monitoring cost & performa per RS dan per group (menggunakan data dari observability tools).
    • Membuat alert system ketika biaya cloud suatu RS melebihi ambang batas normal (misal +30% dari rata-rata RS sejenis).
    • Melakukan review bulanan dengan tim product & finance untuk mengevaluasi rekomendasi yang telah diimplementasikan.
    • Dukungan untuk Deployment Group Baru
    • Saat ada rumah sakit group baru (misal 5 RS sekaligus), Anda menghitung optimal architecture:
    • Apakah lebih murah pakai on-prem di setiap RS + cloud terpusat atau thin client + cloud full (tergantung koneksi internet RS di group tersebut).
    • Menyusun TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) untuk 3 tahun ke depan sebagai bahan negosiasi dengan manajemen group.

Beyond deployment, you will evaluate conversational reliability, monitor latency and AI quality in production, and co-design with users to drive adoption and continuous improvement.


Job Description

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

Define representative customer-journey and workflow evaluations, investigate failure modes, and implement appropriate access controls, confirmation, human escalation, fallback, and recovery behavior.   • Drive adoption and improve experience. Work with Product and Design on customer usability and task completion. For internal workflows, co-design with users, demonstrate progress, train users, and address adoption barriers.

name: AI Builder
description_html:
We are building the shared inference platform that every product in the company reaches AI through: one governed path to external model providers and to the models we host ourselves, with smart routing on top of it. Through those products it reaches thousands of businesses and millions of users.

The scope is deliberately hybrid. The platform side governs predictable behaviour: APIs, authentication, tenant policy, quotas, metering, routing execution, capacity, reliability, security, observability, and deployment. The AI side governs variable behaviour: task understanding, model selection, prompts, retrieval, tool use, small specialised models, output quality, guardrails, evaluation, and feedback. Routing is where the two meet. A request has to be allowed under its tenant policy, and the option chosen has to meet the task's quality, latency, and cost requirements. A response that succeeds technically but fails the user's task does not count.

This is a full stack role with an LLM engineering core. You will own the API and the backend services behind it, the web control surfaces people operate the platform through, the models and drivers it serves, and how all of it behaves in production under real load.

How The Role Ships End To End

  • Platform shipping. Reliable, secure, observable inference APIs, routing policies, provider and self-hosted model connections, tenant controls, metering, and the control surfaces teams use to see and manage them.
  • Intelligence supply. Task-specific small models, model configurations, and agent drivers that teams can invoke through the platform. An agent driver combines a model with instructions, retrieval, tools, and validation behind a versioned interface.
  • Evaluation and feedback. Task datasets, benchmarks, production monitoring, and release gates, using observed failures and economics to improve models, drivers, and routing decisions.

Core Reponsibilities

  • Stay close to the tasks, acceptance criteria, quality risks, traffic patterns, customer feedback, and incidents of the products that use the platform
  • Own the request path: API contracts, authentication (OAuth2), role-based access control, tenant isolation, policy, routing execution, fallback, streaming, and metering
  • Design and build secure REST APIs and streaming endpoints, and backend services that stay correct under concurrency, partial failure, and traffic spikes
  • Build the web control surfaces that make a complex system legible, so an operator can see state and act on it without reading source code
  • Integrate and operate external model providers and self-hosted inference endpoints, and maintain a versioned catalogue of approved models, drivers, capabilities, limits, and prices
  • Measure serving performance under realistic prompt lengths, output lengths, concurrency, and traffic mixes, then plan capacity and optimise configuration and cost
  • Build small task-specific models, prompts, retrieval flows, and agent drivers for well-defined product or customer tasks, then expose them through the platform
  • Define task-level quality and unacceptable behaviour with product teams and domain experts, and assemble representative evaluation and holdout datasets
  • Compare candidate models and drivers against the current baseline on task success, safety, latency, and cost before shifting traffic
  • Implement policy-aware routing, confidence or uncertainty escalation, safe fallbacks, and customer-specific controls where the evidence justifies them
  • Use shadow traffic, staged releases, regression evaluations, monitoring, and rollback to introduce new serving or intelligence behaviour safely
  • Track production failures and feedback, then improve the whole system: data, prompts, models, tools, policies, capacity, and operational controls
  • Model data carefully in PostgreSQL, and measure usage and cost accurately enough to report and bill from
  • Protect tenant data throughout the request path, respecting privacy, residency, and model-use boundaries
  • Maintain dashboards, alerts, runbooks, incident response, and clear ownership for the platform and the capabilities it serves
  • Work with product teams, AI engineers, domain experts, infrastructure, and security to make capabilities reusable across products
  • Keep team knowledge written down: technical requirements, API contracts, design notes explaining model choice and routing policy, deployment notes, and post-mortems
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar on design and code quality through review

About The Role

Amartha is an Indonesian fintech group that provides financial services to micro-entrepreneurs through several licensed entities in lending, payments, and related services. Our production platform runs on Google Cloud and Kubernetes, and our security team is building the controls, detection, and automation that a regulated lender needs at that scale.

We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own cloud and platform security engineering. You will run the controls that detect and prevent misconfiguration and intrusion across our cloud and container estate, respond to what our detection stack surfaces, and turn manual security infrastructure into code. You will work alongside DevOps and platform engineering, and your work feeds directly into our ISO 27001 and regulator audit evidence.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a wide mandate. You will be the senior voice on cloud security in the team, and we expect you to set the technical direction for it rather than wait for a backlog.

What You Will Do

  • Own container and cloud runtime security: workload isolation, Kubernetes hardening, and runtime threat detection
  • Run and extend automated benchmark and configuration scanning across our cloud platform and productivity suite, and act on what it finds
  • Build shift-left security into CI/CD: infrastructure-as-code scanning and misconfiguration gates before deployment
  • Bring the security team's own cloud estate under infrastructure as code. Provisioning is manual and drift-prone today, and ending that is a named deliverable of this role
  • Build and run the deployment pipeline for our security tooling, so security infrastructure ships the same way the product does
  • Own the SIEM platform end to end: network isolation, version currency, configuration management, and detection coverage across critical workloads
  • Respond to and review security alerts, tune detection rules, and cut false positives
  • Manage edge and perimeter security: web application firewall rules, DNS and traffic visibility, and security event retention
  • Manage the platform and console access paths that sit with security engineering

name: QA Engineer (SaaS Platform)
description_html:
Company Summary:

Since 2002, DVI Solutions has been a leading provider of audio-visual setups to help our clients communicate and collaborate better--whether it's with colleagues across the office, or partners on the other side of the world. We have presence across Japan, Singapore, Thailand, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Philippines, Vietnam, India, Malaysia and Indonesia. Our satisfied clients include corporations, government agencies, schools, retail stores, hotels and many more.


Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our team and ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our SaaS platform.


In this role, you will be responsible for both manual and automated testing, API testing, defect management, and supporting System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

You will work closely with Senior QA Engineers, Software Developers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders in an Agile environment to identify issues, improve test coverage, and ensure high-quality software releases.


Key Responsibilities

Manual & Automation Testing

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases for web-based applications.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • Identify opportunities to improve test automation coverage and testing efficiency.
  • Investigate test failures and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.

API Testing

  • Perform API testing using Postman or similar tools to validate functionality, reliability, and system integrations.
  • Verify API responses, authentication, error handling, and data accuracy.
  • Develop and maintain API test collections and document testing results.
  • Identify, report, and track API-related defects.

SIT/UAT & Defect Management

  • Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure applications meet business and functional requirements.
  • Prepare test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and relevant testing documentation.
  • Identify, document, track, and retest defects throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to investigate issues and verify resolutions.
  • Conduct regression testing to ensure fixes do not impact existing functionality.

Agile Collaboration & Quality Improvement

  • Participate in Agile/Scrum activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Developers, and Senior QA Engineers to review requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Identify potential quality risks and edge cases early in the development lifecycle, supporting a Shift-Left testing approach.
  • Provide regular updates on testing progress, defect status, and release readiness.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, testing standards, and automation practices.


Requirements

  • API Testing: Hands-on experience in API testing using Postman or similar tools, including validating API responses, authentication, and error handling.
  • Test Automation: Practical experience developing, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts using Playwright, Selenium, or similar automation frameworks.
  • SIT/UAT & Defect Management: Experience supporting SIT/UAT, managing defects, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, covering both manual and automated testing.
  • Good understanding of software testing methodologies, the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
  • Ability to develop and execute test cases independently, investigate defects, and document findings clearly.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced development environment.


Why Join us

  • Opportunities to work on regional projects with global brands.
  • Exposure to multinational clients, cross-border teams, and cutting-edge technology.
  • Exposure to solutions that include immersive video walls, hybrid meeting tech, collaboration tech, digital transformation, smart workspace integration and much more.
  • Team-oriented culture that encourages collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Involved in custom projects for high-profile clients, DVI offers opportunities to expand your portfolio and build a specialized skill set.
  • A booming industry with the rise of hybrid workspaces and smart office solutions.

name: Quality Assurance Engineer
description_html:
Responsibilities

About the Role

Quality Assurance Engineers are responsible for assessing the quality of specifications and technical designs to ensure timely, relevant, and meaningful feedback. We look for QA professionals who lead with honesty in reporting, empathy for the end-user’s experience, and the agility to adapt to fast-paced release cycles. You will be involved in end-to-end testing processes—from planning to execution—to improve system functionality, performance, reliability, and stability.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

  • Identify testing gaps and risks early in the development cycle with honesty and transparency, proposing effective mitigation strategies.
  • Drive quality improvement initiatives, including process improvements and tooling, with the agility to pivot as technology evolves.
  • Participate in requirement grooming and design reviews to catch issues before development starts, using empathy to advocate for a seamless user journey.
  • Own end-to-end testing for critical/complex features, ensuring high-quality sign-offs through rigorous and honest evaluation.
  • Analyze production incidents and create test cases to prevent recurrence, demonstrating an agile response to real-world challenges.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 1-3 years of experience in software testing, with the agility to handle both automated and manual testing environments.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills to root out complex issues.
  • Deep understanding of testing methodologies (functional, regression, and UAT) through an empathetic lens of how users interact with software.
  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured, etc.).
  • Honest Advocacy: A demonstrated ability to push back on poor requirements and advocate for quality even under pressure.
  • Agility in Ambiguity: Comfortable working with incomplete requirements and possessing the communication skills to ask the right questions.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a passion for ensuring high-quality, reliable software products.
  • Ability to write clear and concise test plans, test cases, and bug reports that communicate issues honestly and effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for collaborating across multiple departments with empathy and professionalism.

Bonus Points If You Have The Following Skills

About the Role

As a Senior QA Engineer at SleekFlow, you will drive quality across our web applications, omnichannel workflows, and AI-powered conversational tools. You will be responsible for designing robust automation frameworks, assessing risks, and shaping our QA practices around non-deterministic AI features (LLMs, chatbots, and RAG systems).


Responsibilities

End-to-End Quality Ownership: Review user stories and requirements to design comprehensive test strategies across web applications, APIs, and background services.

AI & LLM Quality Assurance:

  • Evaluation Frameworks: Design, run, and maintain evaluation frameworks for LLM-based features, covering accuracy, hallucination, relevance, prompt robustness, and consistency under non-deterministic behavior.
  • Dataset Ownership: Own the eval datasets—write test cases with golden answers and must/must-not rules, grow them from failure analysis and production incidents, version them, and keep tuning data separate from release-gating data.
  • LLM Judge Calibration: Calibrate automated LLM judges against human grading and re-check them when judge models or prompts change.
  • Release Gating & Triage: Gate releases on eval results; triage failures to root cause (model, retrieval, prompt, test, or infrastructure) and route to the right owner.
  • Guardrails & Security: Design and enforce guardrail tests (prompt injection, data leakage, out-of-scope behavior) with zero tolerance for breaches.

Automation Frameworks: Build, maintain, and expand automated test coverage across unit, integration, and E2E layers (web and API).

Risk & Impact Analysis: Conduct technical impact analysis to identify edge cases, performance bottlenecks, and architectural risks before release.

CI/CD & Environment Health: Partner with DevOps and Engineering to integrate LLM eval suites and automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Product, AI/LLM Engineers, and Software Engineers to embed quality standards early in the SDLC and troubleshoot production incidents quickly.


Requirement

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Software Quality Assurance, test automation, and release management.
  • AI / LLM Testing: Hands-on experience testing LLM applications (chatbots, RAG systems, agents) with a deep understanding of non-deterministic behavior, prompt evaluation, and guardrail testing.

  • Automation Expertise: Proven experience with modern E2E and API testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Jest, Supertest, Postman).
  • API & System Architecture: Strong experience with RESTful APIs, webhooks, microservices architecture, and API mocking tools.
  • CI/CD Processes: Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to automate regression and evaluation suites.
  • Problem Solving & Mindset: Sharp analytical skills with strict attention to edge cases, data integrity, and system safety.
  • Communication: Fluent in English (Mandarin/Cantonese is a plus).


Our Culture Code

  • Collaboration – We have each other's back, share knowledge freely, and treat every teammate with equal respect.
  • Growth – We pursue continuous improvement, embrace new challenges, and treat mistakes as chances to learn.

name: QA - Test Analyst
description_html:
The Opportunity

About The Digital Team

Beca Digital is moving into a significant stage of growth, working with our internal teams and clients to solve real-world problems. Our stakeholders work with us to develop creative platforms, products and solutions that leverage cloud-based infrastructure. We are developing a platform-based approach to delivering exciting and cost-effective software solutions that overcome some of the challenges of purely bespoke software.

You will be working across our key digital offerings, including our cutting-edge digital twin platform (BEYON) for asset intensive organizations to have one lens across their asset data, our earthquake risk analysis and early alert system (Beacon) and a capital portfolio management software product (CAPEXinsights) that is used globally by some of the world’s largest FMCG companies. There are also several new initiatives and opportunities that have just been launched so you could help to define and architect the testing frameworks used there.

About You

You are a proponent of shift left test driven development and believe that Quality Assurance must be a fully integrated function of the software delivery lifecycle.  You have a proven technical testing background and a desire to influence and shape how testing must evolve to meet the demands of the future.  You are dynamic and innovative and enjoy coming up with new ways to deliver. You are passionate about growing your knowledge and experience and looking for an organization that will support those aspirations.

Qualifications

At Beca Digital, we believe in innovation and encourage diversity of thought.  We invite applicants from a range of backgrounds with the following experience, skills, and attributes:

  • 4+ years of software testing experience with a foundation in Playwright, API testing and Azure DevOps test automation
  • Experience using source control in Git repositories and managing test environment configurations
  • Experience developing, using and maintaining test automation frameworks and planning for automated test maintenance. Ensuring the automations run effectively within CI/CD build and release pipelines
  • Hands-on experience testing RESTful APIs using tools such as Bruno or Postman, Playwright API testing, Swagger, or equivalent frameworks, including validation of requests, responses, authentication, and error handling.
  • Thorough knowledge of the principles of functional and non-functional testing, test planning and reporting, test design, test case writing and maintenance and manual exploratory testing
  • Experience in reporting, investigating, triage and tracking bugs
  • An Agile and open mindset, able to consider new ideas and approaches to complex situations
  • Be a quick learner and detail orientated
  • A focus on outcomes and a proven problem-solving ability
  • Proactive, flexible, and comfortable with ambiguity
  • Great communication skills with the ability to build meaningful and collaborative relationships across various levels of a business

In addition, knowledge and experience across the following is not critical, however would be beneficial:

  • Microsoft Azure platform, Microsoft .NET, SQL, React and JavaScript, Power BI
  • Using AI to help with test plans and test cases

What We Offer

A career with Beca will provide you with:

  • Professional development opportunities.
  • A supportive and caring work environment where you can bring your whole self to work.
  • Opportunities to learn from our industry experts and technical gurus across the Asia Pacific.

Apply now

Belong at Beca and make everyday better. Apply now!

name: Senior Software QA - 2 Openings
description_html:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

We are seeking 2 Senior Software QA to support quality assurance activities across Enterprise Business applications, with primary focus on Oracle, SAP, Billing, and related enterprise platforms.

In this role, you will be responsible for test planning, test execution, defect management, automation opportunities, AI-assisted testing practices, and end-to-end validation across integrated business processes.

You will partner with Business Analysts, Developers, Project Managers, and Business stakeholders to ensure high-quality delivery of Global IT solutions. The role will also leverage modern AI-powered tools to improve testing efficiency, test coverage, defect detection, and overall quality outcomes.

The day-to-day

  • Analyze business and functional requirements and develop test plan and test cases.
  • Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing across Oracle, SAP, Billing, and other enterprise applications.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify software defects through resolution.
  • Collaborate with project teams to validate system changes and assess cross-system impacts.
  • Support release validation and production readiness activities.
  • Develop and maintain test documentation, test evidence, and execution reports.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and contribute to automation development and maintenance.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools and technologies to improve test design, test execution, defect analysis, and QA productivity.
  • Participate in requirement reviews and provide quality-focused feedback early in the delivery lifecycle.
  • Support root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Share knowledge and contribute to expanding QA capabilities across the broader team.


What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • Experience testing enterprise applications such as ERP, CRM, Finance, Billing, Procurement, or Supply Chain systems.
  • Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies.
  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, qTest, or similar.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Willingness to adopt and utilize AI-powered tools to improve testing efficiency and productivity.


What Will Help You On The Job

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience testing Oracle ERP, Oracle Cloud, SAP ECC, or SAP S/4HANA.
  • Knowledge of financial, procurement, order management, or supply chain business processes.
  • Strong SQL and database validation skills.
  • Experience with enterprise automation frameworks and reusable component design
  • Experience with test automation tools such as Tricentis Tosca, Selenium, or similar platforms.
  • Familiar with AI-powered development, testing, or productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or AI-assisted test generation.


Nice to have:

  • Programming experience using Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies for test automation.
  • Experience with source code management and version control tools such as GitHub.
  • Familiar with Agile delivery methodologies, CI/CD, and automated deployment practices.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve software quality, automation, defect analysis, or testing productivity.

name: Website Quality Assurance (QA)
description_html:
Responsibilities

  • Perform functional, regression, responsive, cross-browser, and cross-device testing across website and e-commerce projects.
  • Validate website features, user flows, and e-commerce functionalities against project requirements, acceptance criteria, and approved Figma designs.
  • Create and execute test scenarios, test cases, UAT checklists, and clear, reproducible bug reports.
  • Verify bug fixes and perform regression and smoke testing before and after deployment.
  • Test websites from both frontend and CMS admin perspectives across platforms such as Shopify, WordPress/WooCommerce, or similar platforms.
  • Perform basic API and third-party integration testing using Postman and browser Developer Tools, including payment, shipping, webhooks, analytics tracking, and other external services.
  • Conduct basic website performance checks using Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights.
  • Support the UAT process by validating reported issues and distinguishing bugs from content issues, design revisions, change requests, and environment-related issues.
  • Collaborate with Developers, Designers, and Project Managers to ensure issues are resolved and projects meet agreed quality standards.
  • Manage testing activities across multiple website projects based on project priorities and timelines.

Requirements

  • Familiar with e-commerce platforms and ecosystems such as Shopify, WordPress/WooCommerce, Magento, or similar platforms.
  • Experience testing third-party integrations, such as payment gateways, shipping providers, webhooks, analytics tracking, Meta Pixel, email notifications, or other external services.
  • Familiar with basic website performance testing using Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights.
  • Familiar with UI or end-to-end automation testing tools such as Playwright or Cypress.
  • Previous experience working in a digital agency or handling multiple website projects simultaneously.
