name: QA Engineer (Outgoing)
description_html:
About Company

At Ennovi we harness the power of two megatrends - electrification and AI - to help industries innovate at speed, operate smarter, and achieve sustainable growth. By combining these transformative forces with our global reach and best talent, we empower our customers to lead their markets and drive sustainable progress.

From automotive to aerospace, consumer electronics, data storage, industrial, and medical markets, we help our customers achieve these megatrends by creating smarter, safer, and more sustainable solutions.

We excel in developing high-performance, custom solutions that meet diverse technical needs, solve unique challenges, optimize performance, and adapt to evolving market demands.

Our mission is to get customers to the future faster, from anywhere. Headquartered in Singapore, ENNOVI has a global presence across North America, Europe, SEA and China, where all its activities are socially responsible, with minimal environmental impact. Learn more at www.ennovi.com



Why Join Us

At Ennovi, we envision a future of electrification and innovation and strive to create an inspiring workplace where our employees are integral to shaping that future. We offer a dynamic, collaborative and inclusive culture that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and a sense of purpose. As a part of the Ennovi team, employees experience the excitement of being at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies and contributing to a sustainable future.

Our commitment to the transformation is epitomized by our five pillars: Speed, Innovation, Best Talent, Global Reach, and Sustainability. This entails navigating exponential market changes through agile structures, fostering innovation across all aspects of our business, strategically expanding our global footprint, championing sustainability initiatives and nurturing a winning team.



Privacy Policy

Ennovi is an equal opportunity employer in conformance with all applicable laws and regulations to individuals who are qualified to perform job requirements. The Company administers its personnel policies, programs, and practices in a non-discriminatory manner in all aspects of the employment relationship, including recruitment, hiring, work assignment, promotion, transfer, termination, wage and salary administration, and selection for training.


By applying to this job posting, you agree with and acknowledge our privacy policy.


Job Summary

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to join our team in the Industrial Business Segment.

This role will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring product quality during the manufacturing outgoing process.


About the Business Segment

Ennovi’s Industrial segment powers automation, robotics, and energy storage systems enabling OEMs to achieve AI-powered manufacturing for Industry 4.0.



Main Responsibilities

  • Running the Outgoing Quality Assurance to ensure the products are meeting customer requirements before delivering to customers.
  • Ensure the OQA buy-off operation is meeting the Production needs to support requirements made by Planning Dept and work together with Production and Logistic dept to achieve common cross function dept KPI target (productivity, quality, delivery, etc).
  • Responsible to all of measuring machines, equipment, and other supporting measuring tools and ensure all are working and maintain properly.
  • Responsible for managing the feedback from internal and external customers and working with related process owners for part quality resolution.
  • Responsible for tracking and driving field returns units with process owners related to customer return and or secondary process quality issues.
  • Responsible for conducting internal regular PIA and SCA (Internal Process and Contamination Audit) follow the audit schedule and follow up closure items.
  • Responsible for Daily support to run operational and support for delivery preparation and ensure reporting to customers meets the requirements.
  • Responsible for providing Weekly and Monthly report submission to management and drive for corrective action of Top 3 defects for quality issues and work with process owner for continuous improvement.
  • Responsible for managing the buy-off final PP parts of Plating and drive for improvement together with process owners.
  • Support for Customer regular visit / audit preparation following the customer window’s information


Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Equivalent.
  • At least 3 years of relevant working experience in quality roles with overseeing the big groups and experience in QMS responsibility is added advantage.
  • Knowledge and certification as an Auditor for IATF 16949/ISO 9001/14001 is added advantage.
  • Experience on how to manage Quality System and internal Process Audit.
  • Experience in Plating/Coating industrial company is added advantage.
  • Possess strong analytical and report writing skills.
  • Knowledge of 8D methodology; statistical tools such as cause-and-effect analysis, SPC, MSA/GRR, FMEA & QC tools and six sigma trained will be added advantage.
  • Able to interpret technical drawings and knowledge in GDT is added advantage.
  • Possess good interpersonal and communication skills.

name: Test & Validation Engineer (Automotive Infotainment)
description_html:
You will be responsible for

Maintaining and troubleshooting infotainment test benches and development environments, including hardware, connectivity, permissions and vehicle-signal simulation issues.

Performing ECU reflashing, software updates and variant coding, and keeping test setups operational and aligned with current software releases.

Performing system, integration, regression, robustness and in-vehicle testing, and validating software deliveries before their integration.

Reproducing reported defects, collecting logs and supporting root-cause analysis and quality-improvement activities.

Creating and maintaining test specifications, test plans and test reports.

Developing test automation and support scripts, including CANoe-based test scenarios and vehicle-signal simulation.

Supporting automated Android Automotive application testing using tools such as CatBox, gRPC and VHAL simulation.

Collaborating with local and international development and verification teams to resolve setup issues, share best practices and continuously improve testing processes.

We are looking for

A university degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a comparable qualification.

Experience in software testing and validation, together with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Understanding of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet and SOME/IP.

Experience with scripting, automation or software development.

Practical experience with ECU flashing and variant coding.

Good written and spoken English.

A proactive, ownership-driven approach, with clear communication across teams and locations.

Curiosity, adaptability and a constructive, professional attitude, including the willingness to seek support and improve repetitive activities.

We consider as advantage

Knowledge of CANoe, PROVEtech or similar vehicle-simulation and test tools.

Experience with Automotive Infotainment systems and Android Automotive testing.

Experience with test automation frameworks.

Practical use of AI/LLM tools to improve troubleshooting, scripting and engineering productivity.

We offer

Possibility to expand your ideas and apply them.

Sharing, recognition and transparent collaboration built on integrity.

Freedom to take decisions.

name: Assistant Engineer, QA
description_html:
Job Summary

Job Summary

Responsible for coordinating and monitoring project quality activities to ensure all inspection, testing, welding, and documentation are carried out in accordance with project specifications, applicable codes, standards, and Classification Society requirements. The role works closely with Clients, Class, third-party inspectors, Ship Superintendents, and internal teams to ensure quality requirements are properly implemented and documented.

The position is also responsible for managing the Project Quality Plan, ITP, NCR/CAR follow-up, welding documentation, audit support, and quality records, while ensuring compliance with the company's Quality Management System, ISO 9001 requirements, and applicable safety and environmental policies.

Key Responsibilities

Task and Responsibilities :

  • Coordinate and liaise with Classification societies, Third party inspection agencies, Ship Superintendents and other Trades, to ensure adherence to related Standards.
  • Collecting, updating and filing all relevant inspections records.
  • To prepare Project Quality Plan and Inspection and Test Plan in accordance with Project Specification and Class requirements.
  • To ensure ITP is strictly followed and that inspection and testing are carried-out in a timely manner.
  • Responsible in maintaining NCR/OR and CAR/PAR are log and followed-up for immediate close-up.
  • To ensure that all inspection and testing result is carried-out reference with Codes and Standard.
  • To ensure that welding is properly covered with WPS/PQR.
  • To ensure proper documentation of Project Quality related activities, confirmed and approved signed by Client and Class.

Help take our first motorcycle from development into consistent production. You will own supplier quality and manufacturing readiness across our suppliers and assembly partner, working closely with R&D to solve problems and ensure every motorcycle meets our safety, reliability and finish standards.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with broad ownership. Our assembly partner runs factory operations and routine QC; you verify that its processes and results meet Aerion’s requirements.

name: Supplier Quality System Engineer
description_html:
Overview

For over 35 years, OSI Electronics has provided manufacturing solutions of the highest quality, reliability, and customer support. We specialize in customized manufacturing solutions with the portfolio of services, capabilities, and factory locations needed to provide our customers with a competitive advantage in the global marketplace. OSI Electronics offers turnkey solutions for the full range of assembly complexity. We partner with customers on product development, new product introduction, mass production, sustaining engineering and product lifecycle management. Our cutting edge technology, manufacturing proficiency and responsive technical services deliver the Tier One capabilities customers require.

OSI Electronics is seeking a Supplier Quality Systems Engineer to join the team. This individual will be responsible for providing supplier quality system administration, documentation control, and supplier quality process support across multiple manufacturing sites. They will ensure supplier quality records, qualification files, audit records, quality agreements, approved supplier lists, scorecards, corrective actions, and supplier performance documentation are maintained in accordance with company, customer, regulatory, and quality management system requirements. Additionally, they will serve as a centralized supplier quality resource supporting site quality teams, procurement, engineering, operations, and regulatory affairs by managing supplier quality documentation and driving consistency across all facilities. They will support supplier onboarding, performance monitoring, audit administration, and cross-site quality system standardization.

Responsibilities

  • Manage supplier qualification files and records for all company locations.
  • Manage supplier quality documentation within the D365 ERP system.
  • Maintain quality agreements, certifications, audit reports, and supplier qualification records.
  • Ensure supplier records remain up-to-date and compliant with internal procedures and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate periodic reviews of supplier documentation.
  • Archive and store supplier records in accordance with company retention policies.
  • Support the Approved Supplier List (ASL) for various locations.
  • Coordinate supplier approval, conditional approval, suspension, and disqualification activities.
  • Update supplier approval status based on audit results, performance reviews, and management decisions.
  • Compile supplier approval reports for site and corporate management.
  • Verify that supplier certifications and regulatory registrations remain valid (current).
  • Coordinate supplier onboarding and qualification activities.
  • Manage supplier surveys, risk assessments, capability assessments, and qualification packages.
  • Monitor qualification progress and obtain necessary approvals.
  • Support periodic supplier re-qualification and re-evaluation activities.
  • Ensure qualification documentation is complete prior to granting supplier approval.
  • Manage supplier quality scorecards and KPI dashboards.
  • Collect quality and delivery performance data from various locations.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly supplier performance reports.
  • Support supplier review meetings by providing performance metrics and data analysis.
  • Monitor supplier quality trends and escalation activities.
  • Support the implementation of standardized supplier quality processes across locations.
  • Manage standardized templates, forms, procedures, and work instructions.
  • Coordinate supplier quality documentation harmonization projects.
  • Assist the site during internal, customer, and certification audits.
  • Support the "One Company, One Quality System" approach to supplier management.
  • Ensure supplier quality records support compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, and IATF 16949 standards.
  • Support audit preparation and requests for supplier documentation.
  • Uphold the company's core values: Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
  • Demonstrate behavior aligned with the company's Code of Ethics and Conduct.
  • It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem.
  • Every employee is responsible for reporting any quality issues or defects to a manager or senior management member so that corrective actions can be implemented and the issues prevented from recurring.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management or related field required.
  • Must have at least three (3) years of experience in supplier quality, quality systems, document control, quality assurance administration, and regulatory compliance support.
  • Experience working within a multi-site manufacturing environment desired.
  • Experience in electronics manufacturing services (EMS) or a related electronics manufacturing environment desired.
  • Ability to support supplier quality, quality systems, or compliance activities in aerospace, medical device, defense, or other regulated industries, is a plus.
  • Knowledge of document control management, including maintaining controlled records, procedures, templates, and compliance documentation required.
  • Experience with supplier qualification processes, including supplier onboarding, risk assessments, capability reviews, approvals, and periodic reevaluations needed.
  • Must have experience administering supplier audits, including audit scheduling, documentation requests, audit records, corrective action follow-up, and status tracking.
  • Experience managing supplier scorecards, supplier performance metrics, KPI reporting, and related performance review documentation is required.
  • Must have ability to collect, analyze, and report quality data and key performance indicators to support supplier performance monitoring and continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook are essential.
  • Experience using ERP and electronic quality management systems (eQMS) to maintain supplier quality records, documentation, workflows, and reporting needed.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule to support teams across the UK, US, and Mexico locations.
  • Must be able to read, write, and communicate effectively in the business language (English).

name: Qualification Engineer
description_html:
Use Your Power for Purpose

Your work will help ensure that manufacturing equipment, utilities, facilities, environmental-control systems, and other systems remain qualified, compliant, safe, and ready to support the reliable supply of medicines. By working closely with Quality, Validation, Production, Maintenance, Utility, Engineering, EHS, and external partners, you will turn technical requirements into disciplined execution and complete, audit-ready qualification records.

What You Will Achieve

  • Plan, coordinate, execute, document, review, and close commissioning, qualification, requalification, and decommissioning activities for equipment, utilities, facilities, HVAC, cleanrooms, automation, and environmental-control systems.
  • Prepare, review, execute, and maintain lifecycle documents including user requirements, design reviews, impact and risk assessments, qualification plans, commissioning protocols and reports, IQ/OQ protocols and reports, traceability records, and qualification summary reports.
  • Execute Installation Qualification and Operational Qualification, and support Performance Qualification with System Owners, Production, Quality, Validation, and relevant technical functions.
  • Initiate and coordinate qualification-related Change Controls, define required deliverables, and assess qualification impacts arising from repairs, maintenance, component replacement, relocation, software or automation changes, upgrades, and modifications.
  • Coordinate field verification, challenge testing, commissioning testing, system acceptance testing, and timely resolution of discrepancies, observations, punch-list items, deviations, and corrective actions.
  • Support engineering and capital projects from concept and design through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and closeout.
  • Participate in design reviews, vendor site surveys, FAT, SAT, construction walkthroughs, system inspections, pre-installation assessments, and qualification-readiness reviews.
  • Review and verify technical specifications, certificates, test records, drawings, P&IDs, layouts, as-built drawings, FAT/SAT records, and turnover packages against approved requirements, GMP expectations, and safety controls.
  • Maintain qualification-status tracking, support periodic review and requalification planning, monitor due dates, and escalate overdue or at-risk activities.
  • Support technical investigations, deviations, root-cause analysis, CAPA development and implementation, and effectiveness verification when qualification or engineering expertise is required.
  • Develop and update qualification-related SOPs, work instructions, job aids, forms, and technical procedures.
  • Confirm operational-readiness prerequisites, including maintenance, calibration, training, spare parts, operating procedures, drawings, and documentation, before system release.
  • Prepare supporting information and participate in GEMBAs, internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, quality assessments, and compliance reviews.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, traceable, retrievable, and audit-ready records in accordance with Good Documentation Practices, ALCOA+ principles, and record-retention requirements.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

  • Diploma 3 (D3) or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in qualification, validation, commissioning, engineering compliance, or related technical activities.
  • Working knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity, Change Control, deviations, CAPA, and inspection readiness.
  • Ability to prepare and execute commissioning, IQ, and OQ protocols and reports, and to support PQ activities.
  • Ability to read and understand technical specifications, drawings, P&IDs, layouts, operating principles, and system boundaries.
  • Ability to prepare clear technical documents, maintain traceability, and organize qualification records for review and approval.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to work with electronic document, change-control, or maintenance systems as assigned.
  • Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on qualification experience with manufacturing equipment, utilities, HVAC, cleanrooms, water systems, compressed gases, automation, or facility systems.
  • Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning, project handover, requalification, periodic review, and qualification lifecycle management.
  • Experience coordinating contractors, consultants, original equipment manufacturers, testing laboratories, calibration providers, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Experience supporting audits, regulatory inspections, quality assessments, technical investigations, or CAPA effectiveness verification.
  • Additional training or certification in qualification/validation, risk management, project management, GMP, data integrity, or EHS.
  • Curiosity and responsible use of common AI tools, including generative technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving, document quality, and productivity while protecting confidential and regulated information.
  • How You Will Work Decisive: Make timely, risk-based decisions and promptly escalate qualification, quality, safety, technical, documentation, or schedule concerns. Focused: Prioritize critical deliverables, maintain accurate records, and complete agreed actions on time. Connected: Collaborate effectively across Quality, Validation, Production, Maintenance, Utility, Facility, Engineering, EHS, and external partners. Courageous: Raise compliance, data-integrity, technical, and safety concerns directly and act consistently with approved procedures.

Work Location Assignment: On Premise

name: IT Technician
description_html:
Description

The IT Technician is tasked with maintaining the IT infrastructure and ensuring the continuous, smooth operation of all IT systems, networks, and hardware essential to business operations. This involves implementing security protocols, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining minimal system downtime. Success in this fast-paced, customer-focused environment requires strong technical expertise and effective problem-solving skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support to end-users, including diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues.
  • Assist with troubleshooting desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral issues.
  • Handle IT service requests and incidents, ensuring timely resolution within Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Perform regular maintenance, updates, and patching of operating systems, software applications, and security tools.
  • Monitor system and network performance, proactively addressing potential issues to minimize downtime.
  • Ensure uptime for essential business systems, including VoIP, monitoring systems.
  • Assist in the configuration and maintenance of LAN/WAN networks, routers, switches, and firewalls.
  • Set up and maintain VPNs and remote access configurations to support BPO operations.
  • Perform routine network checks to ensure connectivity and proper configuration.
  • Implement and monitor cybersecurity measures, such as firewalls, antivirus software, and data encryption.
  • Follow organizational security protocols and industry compliance standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA) to protect sensitive customer data.
  • Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and risk assessments to identify and resolve security threats.
  • Manage the inventory of hardware, software, and other IT assets, ensuring proper documentation, tracking, and disposal.
  • Assist in the setup and deployment of workstations, including installing necessary software and configuring systems.
  • Ensure that IT hardware (laptops, desktops, servers) is functioning optimally and address issues such as hardware malfunctions or replacements.
  • Provide technical support for specialized software and tools used in BPO operations.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of technical procedures, configurations, and solutions in the knowledge base for future reference.
  • Provide regular reports on system performance, incidents, and resolutions to management.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of IT policies and procedures.

Key Skills & Experience

  • A diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant IT certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)) are a plus.
  • 2-3 years of experience as an IT Technician, preferably in a BPO, contact center, or fast-paced corporate environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows, Mac, and Linux operating systems.
  • Experience with troubleshooting network, hardware, and software issues.
  • Familiarity with VoIP, CRM, and workforce management systems used in BPO environments.
  • Experience with network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, VPNs, firewalls, and switches.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues quickly and efficiently under pressure.
  • Proactive in identifying and mitigating potential system problems before they escalate.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with end-users, management, and technical teams. (English - B1 required)
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders clearly.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with other IT professionals and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality technical support.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively, handle multiple requests simultaneously, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver excellent customer service, understanding the urgency of minimizing disruptions in a BPO operation.
  • A positive, can-do attitude when assisting staff with technical issues.

name: Service Delivery Specialist - Tier 1
description_html:
Service Delivery Specialist - Tier 1

Position Summary

The Service Delivery Specialist (Tier 1) provides front-line technical support to Apex IT Consulting clients ensuring quick resolution of IT issues and delivering excellent customer service. This role involves troubleshooting diverse IT environments, handling a variety of client needs, and escalating complex issues to higher-tier technicians as necessary. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, multi-client environment and has a strong desire to learn and grow in the IT field.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Support:
    • Provide remote and on-site IT support to supported client environments.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues for desktops, laptops, printers, servers, and other IT infrastructure.
    • Assist with common applications such as Microsoft 365, Google, email clients, and remote desktop solutions.
  • Ticket Management:
    • Monitor, update, and resolve tickets in the MSP’s ticketing system, adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
    • Document issue resolutions and escalate unresolved issues to Tier 2 or Tier 3 technicians as needed.
  • User Assistance:
    • Support end users with password resets, account management, and access to systems.
    • Educate clients on best practices for IT security, software usage, and troubleshooting.
  • System Monitoring and Maintenance:
    • Utilize Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools to proactively identify and resolve potential issues.
    • Deploy patches, updates, and security software to client systems as part of routine maintenance.
    • Assist in setting up new client environments, including installing hardware and software.
  • Network Support:
    • Diagnose and troubleshoot basic network issues, including connectivity, VPN, and firewall problems.
    • Coordinate with vendors or escalate complex networking issues as necessary.
  • Client Interaction:
    • Communicate effectively with clients to gather details, set expectations, and provide updates.
    • Maintain a professional demeanor and deliver excellent customer service, even in high-pressure situations.
Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent (associate’s degree or certifications preferred).
  • 1+ year of experience in IT support, helpdesk, or related roles, preferably in an MSP environment.
  • Familiarity with RMM tools (e.g., ConnectWise, Kaseya, SolarWinds).
  • Basic knowledge of Windows Server environments, Active Directory, and Office 365 administration.
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic network troubleshooting.

Preferred Skills And Certifications

description_html:
About Us

We've got an incredible brand — now we're busy creating the legend behind it. At hosting.com, we've set out to redefine the new standard for what web hosting should be — one that is authentically human, deeply trusted, and built on shared success.

Our aim and promise is bold: to become the world's most trusted hosting company. If you're eager to contribute your time and talent to something bigger that people will talk about long after your work is done — hosting.com is your place. At hosting.com, we're not just hosting websites. Although we do a great job of that for millions of websites. We're helping our customers tell their stories and connect with their people. Creating product experiences that helps them do that. Being there when they need us. And earning trust, day by day, by showing up and giving our best.

All because we care about each other's success. Our team is 750+ strong and growing, spread across the globe. We can't do this alone. Come join the journey. And help us build something better, together.

Requirements

About the Role

What You'll Do

In this role, you should be a keen problem solver and have a good level of written and spoken English. The role primarily involves helping clients and prospective clients use our hosting service, answering technical queries mainly through support tickets and live chat.

We use a standard hosting stack comprising cPanel, Linux, Apache, MySQL, and PHP so experience with these technologies is crucial. The majority of the sites we host will run a CMS like WordPress, so experience from a user or management perspective of WordPress is also desirable.

  • Identifying and diagnosing server performance problems (CPU, iowait, swap)

name: IT Support - Infrastructure
description_html:
Kredivo Group is seeking an IT Support Specialist - Infrastructure to support the growing demands of our office network and infrastructure operations. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day health of office infrastructure devices across our sites, including network switches, access points, and firewalls. You will work closely with the infrastructure team to troubleshoot connectivity issues, perform root cause analysis, and maintain reliable network services for our users. This is a hands-on role suited for individuals who are eager to develop deep technical skills in enterprise network infrastructure within a fast-scaling fintech environment.

About The Job

  • Maintain the operational health of office infrastructure devices, including but not limited to:
    • Network switches (such as: Unifi, Cisco, and generic brands)
    • Wireless access points and their optimization strategies
    • Firewall devices and basic firewall rule management
  • Perform first-line troubleshooting and direct root cause analysis for infrastructure-related issues reported by users, such as: connectivity drops, network performance degradation, and access failures.
  • Maintain healthy escalation lines to the L2 Infrastructure team when issues exceed first-line resolution scope or require configuration changes beyond the approved baseline.
  • Maintain the integrity of infrastructure-related IT Ops procedures and policies, such as:
    • Device lifecycle and asset tracking for all infrastructure hardware in scope
    • Incident registration, resolution, and escalation through proper ticketing channels
    • Change documentation for any configuration applied to managed devices
  • Maintain asset data integrity at all times, for all infrastructure hardware types in scope.
  • Maintain a regular update line to the IT team, especially Leads and Managers, on the status of open infrastructure issues and ongoing tasks.
  • As the on-site representative for infrastructure matters, maintain good working relationships and professional communication with all site stakeholders.
About You

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Networks, Telecommunications, or related fields.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience working with office network infrastructure, such as: configuring or troubleshooting switches, access points, or firewall devices.
  • Basic working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including: IP addressing and subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, and Wi-Fi connectivity concepts.
  • Exposure to or familiarity with infrastructure platforms used in enterprise office environments, such as: Unifi (UniFi Controller / Network Application), Cisco IOS CLI, or similar.
  • Aptitude towards structured troubleshooting — able to identify symptoms, isolate root causes, and document findings clearly.
  • High sense of ownership of assigned tasks and devices; able to operate with clear direction and escalate proactively when blockers arise.
  • Possess awareness of organizational escalation mechanisms, such as when to engage L2 support versus resolving independently.
  • Willing to perform on-site work and occasional after-hours tasks when infrastructure maintenance requires minimal business disruption.

name: Security Managed Services Engineer (L1)

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA

As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will step into an entry-level role focused on maintaining our clients' firewall infrastructures. Your main objective will be to ensure our Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met with zero missed conditions. You'll be front-line support, handling standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests, as well as contributing to project work when needed.

Daily, you'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, quickly identifying and investigating problems and errors before or as they occur. You'll provide telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to clients, ensuring efficient and comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. By scheduling maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, you contribute to a proactive approach in managing and optimizing workflows.

You'll follow necessary handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity and update existing knowledge articles—or create new ones. A key part of your role will be identifying opportunities for work optimization, including automation of work, request fulfilment, incident resolution, and other process improvements. You may also be involved in implementing and delivering disaster recovery functions and tests.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

  • Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and providing support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage administration and monitoring services within a medium to large ICT organization.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL processes.
  • Skills in active listening techniques such as paraphrasing, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
  • Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
  • Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
  • Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
  • Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
  • Capacity to plan activities and projects well in advance, adapting to changing circumstances as needed.
  • Positive outlook and ability to perform well under pressure.
  • Eagerness to work diligently and extend hours when necessary.
  • Client-centric approach, always putting clients at the forefront of interactions.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing or demonstrated equivalent work experience.

Workplace type:

On-site Working

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. description_html:
Description

Main Duties:

Project IT coordination and governance

  • Provide practical IT support across all projects locations.
  • Act as the Project Managers’ focal point for requirements, priorities and readiness.
  • Follow Group IT standards, approved access rights and change procedures; refer architecture, privileged administration and security decisions to Group IT.

Laptop preparation and user support

  • Prepare, reformat and image laptops using approved builds and secure data handling.
  • Install and test operating systems, drivers, project software and Microsoft 365; coordinate account setup, endpoint protection, encryption and updates with Group IT.
  • Record configurations and complete handover checks.
  • Provide Level 1 support for hardware, software, accounts and peripherals, remotely and on site.
  • Log, prioritise and track tickets; escalate Level 2/3 issues with diagnostic information to Group IT or approved providers and follow through to closure.

SharePoint and collaboration tools

  • Standardise and maintain project SharePoint structures, libraries, metadata, templates, versioning and archiving under approved rules.
  • Apply only authorised permissions and sharing settings, with owner approval; support Teams and OneDrive use, synchronisation and user guidance.
  • Coordinate retention and project closure with document owners and Group IT.

Mobilisation and demobilisation

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding checklists with PMs, HR and Group IT.
  • Arrange equipment and approved access before mobilisation; obtain signed issue and return records.
  • Recover devices and accessories, coordinate timely access revocation and data handover, and arrange approved wiping, redeployment or disposal.

Assets and project purchasing

  • Maintain traceable inventories of devices, serial numbers, asset tags, users, locations and project allocation; track licences, warranties, maintenance, repairs and stock.

Site connectivity and local suppliers

  • Coordinate internet, network, Wi-Fi, printers and meeting-room equipment with approved local providers.
  • Support surveys, installation, basic setup and acceptance tests; document connections and escalate faults.
  • Obtain Group IT approval for network or security changes and monitor supplier delivery and service quality.

Security and service improvement

  • Apply approved MFA, confidentiality, least-privilege and data-protection procedures.
  • Check backup status and support restore tests under Group IT direction; escalate failures.
  • Report suspected cyber incidents promptly, preserve evidence and follow the incident process.
  • Never bypass controls or use unapproved tools.
  • Maintain SOPs, checklists, ticket and supplier records.
  • Report agreed KPIs to Operations and Group IT: readiness, open and ageing tickets, resolution times, asset reconciliation, costs and supplier issues.

Education:

Diploma or certificate in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical training and demonstrable skills.

0–3 years of relevant experience; motivated graduates with practical IT projects or internships are welcome.

Knowledge:

Practical IT foundations

Basic Windows installation, imaging, troubleshooting, hardware and peripheral support; working familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive.

Basic understanding of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, Wi-Fi and connectivity checks, with guidance for complex issues.

Coordination and security awareness

Able to maintain accurate asset registers, tickets, purchase trackers and Excel reports.

Understand access approvals, MFA, endpoint protection, backups, confidential information and escalation procedures.

Willing to learn Group IT standards and project workflows.

Personal qualities and languages

Resourceful, curious and technically enthusiastic, with a hands-on approach and willingness to learn.

Organised, service-minded and reliable; able to prioritise, explain issues clearly and recognise when to escalate.

Working English is required; Bahasa Indonesia is an advantage.

Comfortable coordinating users and vendors across sites.

name: Technical Assistance Center Engineer
description_html:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

As a Technical Assistance Center(TAC) team member, you will serve as the critical bridge between customer operations and DevOps teams supporting Viasat’s global networks. In this role, you will contribute to global incident response operations by supporting service restoration efforts and helping maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). You will also develop technical expertise in Viasat networking and satellite technologies while expanding your operational and incident management skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Incident Management: Coordinate communication, documentation, and escalation activities during critical outage and customer-impacting events.
  • Multi-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with DevOps and hardware infrastructure teams to assist in the diagnosis and resolution of complex technical issues.
  • Communication: Provide timely, detailed status updates to internal customer-facing teams and external partners, including global onsite vendors, fiber providers, and third-party support teams.
  • Technical Support & Coordination: Collaborate with engineering teams using a diverse suite of networking, RF, and proprietary Viasat technologies to maintain global connectivity.


The day-to-day

  • Triage alerts to identify and isolate customer-impacting issues, escalating critical events to senior teams as required.
  • Participate in incident response activities, supporting bridge calls and engaging appropriate engineering teams for rapid fault isolation.
  • Communicate real-time updates regarding system status to internal customer-facing teams and external global partners.
  • Coordinate field logistics, managing the dispatch of onsite vendors and fiber providers to resolve physical site issues.
  • Fix and help isolate problems related to Tier 2 customer escalations, employing growing knowledge of Viasat's global network environment.
  • Manage ticket queues actively, tracking documentation to ensure strict alignment to established SLAs and SLOs.


What You'll Need

  • Experience in a technical operations environment, such as a Network Operations Center (NOC), Technical Assistance Center (TAC), Enterprise IT, or Technical Call Center.
  • Hands-on experience managing network incidents, including outage event handling, circuit-impacting events, or service degradations.
  • Proven capability to escalate and coordinate effectively with external vendors and providers to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Introductory experience with AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically using AI assistants for fixing, documentation, or workflow optimization.
  • Basic familiarity with query languages or data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, KQL, or similar) to parse logs and system alerts.


What Will Help You On The Job

  • Radio Frequency (RF) and Satellite communication knowledge.
  • Understanding of the OSI model and networking concepts, including common routing protocols.
  • Experience using enterprise ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Salesforce.


EEO Statement

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

  • Complete assigned work according to established processes and procedures while maintaining accurate documentation and records.
  • Deliver work by following clearly defined tasks and instructions under guidance from senior team members.

What You'll Need

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in data center operations, ICT infrastructure support, or technical field services is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of server hardware, network infrastructure, structured cabling, and data center environments.
  • Familiarity with rack and stack activities, patch management, and remote hands services.
  • Knowledge of data center operational procedures, change management, and maintenance practices.
  • Ability to read technical documentation, rack layouts, and basic network diagrams.

  • Ability to communicate and exchange straightforward information with internal teams and external vendors.

name: Data & Infrastructure Support Engineer
description_html:
Are you someone who enjoys troubleshooting technical issues, investigating what’s happening behind the scenes, and finding the root cause of unfamiliar problems? Do you feel comfortable working with logs, dashboards, alerts, and monitoring tools to turn incidents into clear diagnoses and solutions?

We’re looking for a Data & Infrastructure Support Engineer to join our team at ATI Business Group. In this role, you’ll be the first point of contact for data and infrastructure incidents, investigating issues, reviewing logs and monitoring tools, forming an initial diagnosis, and either resolving the issue or escalating it with clear supporting context. As our technology environment continues to evolve, you’ll also have opportunities to develop your skills in RPA and AI/LLM support, working alongside the relevant engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as the first point of contact for data and infrastructure support incidents, investigating issues and either resolving or escalating them appropriately.
  • Review logs, dashboards, alerts, and monitoring tools to identify probable causes and distinguish between temporary and systemic issues.
  • Support the health and availability of servers, cloud services, networking, storage, and data platforms, including troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and availability issues.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, ETL/ELT jobs, data warehouses, and scheduled processes, including job failures, data quality issues, latency, and throughput problems.
  • Manage support tickets and queues within agreed SLA, keeping stakeholders informed and documenting investigation and resolution steps.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Level 2/3 or specialist teams with clear diagnostic information.
  • Follow existing troubleshooting runbooks and contribute to improving documentation and procedures based on newly identified issues.
  • As you develop in the role, gain exposure to RPA support, including UiPath environments, robot health, queues, transactions, and basic automation exception triage.
  • Build longer-term exposure to AI/LLM-powered solutions, supporting basic monitoring and incident triage alongside the relevant engineering teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, alerting, documentation, and support processes to reduce recurring incidents and manual effort.


Is this you?
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in technical support, service desk, infrastructure support, data operations, or a similar technical environment.
  • A strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to investigate unfamiliar issues methodically and reach an initial diagnosis.
  • Comfortable working with logs, dashboards, alerts, and observability/monitoring tools such as Grafana, Datadog, Azure Monitor, Splunk, or similar.
  • Familiarity with SQL, basic data querying, and data pipeline/ETL concepts.
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across Azure, AWS, or GCP, including VMs, storage, and basic networking.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or similar languages for troubleshooting and routine operational checks.
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent, including incident management, escalation, and SLA processes.
  • Able to follow and contribute to technical runbooks and documentation, with clear communication skills for handovers and escalations.
  • Exposure to UiPath or other RPA platforms, including UiPath Orchestrator, robots, queues, or transactions, is a plus.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Power Automate, AI/LLM-powered applications, or related automation technologies is also a plus.


Be Part of ATI's Journey
At ATI Business Group, we bring unparalleled knowledge of the travel and hospitality industry to every aspect of our clients' businesses. Through operational expertise, innovative technology, and exceptional talent, we deliver solutions that optimize operations, elevate customer experiences, and accelerate business growth.

Since 2002, we've grown into a global team of 2,000+ professionals, partnering with leading travel and hospitality organizations worldwide. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping businesses scale, adapt, and grow while creating meaningful career opportunities along the way.

name: Tech Ops
description_html:
About the Role:

As a Tech Ops Specialist, you will serve as the frontline technical support function for Krom’s production systems, helping ensure operational stability and a seamless customer experience. You will be the first technical point of contact for Customer Service, performing initial issue assessments, reproducing reported problems, analyzing logs, gathering technical evidence, and providing investigation updates under the guidance of the Tech Ops Lead or Incident Owner.

This role focuses on operational support, technical investigation, issue management, monitoring, documentation, and cross-functional coordination rather than software development.

Operational Issue Handling & Customer Service Support

  • Receive and investigate issues reported by the Customer Service team.
  • Perform initial assessments based on information provided by customers or internal stakeholders.
  • Identify issue symptoms, customer impact, and potentially affected system components.
  • Reproduce reported issues to validate and understand root causes.
  • Gather critical information such as user IDs, transaction IDs, timestamps, screenshots, and error messages.
  • Provide investigation updates and communicate findings to Customer Service teams.
  • Ensure issue reports contain sufficient information before escalation to relevant teams.

Technical Investigation & Log Analysis

  • Analyze logs using observability and monitoring tools such as Scalyr, Kibana, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms.
  • Identify error patterns, failed requests, timeouts, integration issues, and system anomalies.
  • Trace transaction and request flows when necessary.
  • Collect technical evidence to support engineering teams during root cause analysis.
  • Document investigation findings clearly and systematically.

Issue Follow-up & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Follow up with engineering and related teams to ensure timely issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with Backend, Mobile, QA, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Product, and other stakeholders.
  • Work with QA teams to reproduce issues when required.
  • Communicate technical updates to internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure incidents and ongoing issues are properly tracked and followed through.

Third-Party Operational Support

  • Coordinate issue investigations involving third-party providers, payment gateways, switchers, vendors, and technology partners.
  • Gather and provide technical information required by external parties.
  • Monitor progress and resolution status of third-party issues.
  • Communicate updates and risks to internal stakeholders.

Monitoring & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor alerts, error trends, and overall system health.
  • Identify recurring issues and potential operational risks.
  • Escalate anomalies and incidents appropriately.
  • Participate in on-call rotations or shift coverage as required.
  • Ensure incidents and operational issues are properly documented and tracked.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
  • Document known issues, workarounds, escalation paths, and investigation outcomes.
  • Contribute to the team's knowledge base to improve operational efficiency and response times.
  • Maintain clear and accessible operational documentation.


About You:

We're looking for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and passionate about solving production issues in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy troubleshooting complex systems, collaborating across teams, and taking ownership of operational reliability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in Tech Operations, Production Support, Application Support, Incident Support, or a similar role.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical thinking skills.
  • Hands-on experience with log monitoring and observability tools such as Scalyr, Kibana, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent platforms.
  • Understanding of APIs, backend systems, mobile/web application flows, and basic database querying.
  • Experience using REST clients such as Postman, Bruno, or similar tools.
  • Ability to work effectively during incidents and under pressure.
  • Strong communication skills, particularly when translating technical issues for non-technical stakeholders.
  • High sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency in handling operational issues.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations or shift schedules.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, banking, digital banking, payment systems, or other high-availability environments.
  • Familiarity with incident management processes, service-level agreements (SLAs), and operational best practices.
  • Experience investigating issues involving third-party integrations.
  • Understanding of payment transaction flows and troubleshooting within payment ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Slack, cloud platforms, and web-based operational tools.

name: Data & Infrastructure Support Engineer
description_html:
Are you someone who enjoys troubleshooting technical issues, investigating what’s happening behind the scenes, and finding the root cause of unfamiliar problems? Do you feel comfortable working with logs, dashboards, alerts, and monitoring tools to turn incidents into clear diagnoses and solutions?

We’re looking for a Data & Infrastructure Support Engineer to join our team at ATI Business Group. In this role, you’ll be the first point of contact for data and infrastructure incidents, investigating issues, reviewing logs and monitoring tools, forming an initial diagnosis, and either resolving the issue or escalating it with clear supporting context. As our technology environment continues to evolve, you’ll also have opportunities to develop your skills in RPA and AI/LLM support, working alongside the relevant engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review logs, dashboards, alerts, and monitoring tools to identify probable causes and distinguish between temporary and systemic issues.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, ETL/ELT jobs, data warehouses, and scheduled processes, including job failures, data quality issues, latency, and throughput problems.
  • Manage support tickets and queues within agreed SLA, keeping stakeholders informed and documenting investigation and resolution steps.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Level 2/3 or specialist teams with clear diagnostic information.
  • Follow existing troubleshooting runbooks and contribute to improving documentation and procedures based on newly identified issues.
  • As you develop in the role, gain exposure to RPA support, including UiPath environments, robot health, queues, transactions, and basic automation exception triage.
  • Build longer-term exposure to AI/LLM-powered solutions, supporting basic monitoring and incident triage alongside the relevant engineering teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, alerting, documentation, and support processes to reduce recurring incidents and manual effort.


Is this you?
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in technical support, service desk, infrastructure support, data operations, or a similar technical environment.
  • A strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to investigate unfamiliar issues methodically and reach an initial diagnosis.
  • Comfortable working with logs, dashboards, alerts, and observability/monitoring tools such as Grafana, Datadog, Azure Monitor, Splunk, or similar.
  • Familiarity with SQL, basic data querying, and data pipeline/ETL concepts.
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across Azure, AWS, or GCP, including VMs, storage, and basic networking.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or similar languages for troubleshooting and routine operational checks.
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent, including incident management, escalation, and SLA processes.

name: Sr Officer-ERP System Support
description_html:
Role Purpose

To act as the primary Person In Charge (PIC) for the ERP platform on the IOH side, serving as the key functional and technical point of contact between business users, IT, and the Managed Services Partner (vendor/mitra). This role is responsible for day-to-day platform ownership — including business requirement coordination, master data and configuration integrity, and cross-module functional oversight — as well as governing the partner's delivery of L1, L2, and L3 Application Managed Services (AMS) across the ERP ecosystem, System Integration, on prem/cloud infrastructure related, middleware, ensuring operational stability, SLA compliance, effective Change Request (T&M) delivery, and adherence to IOH governance, reporting, security, and service acceptance (BAST) standards.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the single Point of Contact (PIC) for ERP system matters on the IOH side; gather and consolidate business requirements from process owners; prioritize and validate enhancement/CR proposals prior to partner execution; safeguard master data, Chart of Accounts, and configuration integrity across modules; provide functional guidance to business users on system usage and process alignment, system integration, and infrastructure utilization awareness.
  • Act as the primary IOH counterpart for the ERP Ecosystem Managed Services Partner; monitor day-to-day delivery of L1/L2/L3 support across ERP ecosystem, Surrounding system, system integration, infra utilization, license monitoring; ensure the partner operates within the agreed operating model, service window, and escalation matrix.
  • Monitor and validate the partner's compliance to SLA targets (response/resolution time per P1-P4, System and integration uptime, First Time Fix Rate); review incident trend and aging-ticket reports; drive corrective action for SLA breaches.
  • Oversee incident and problem management performance across L1/L2/L3 tiers; validate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA for P1/P2 incidents; review and endorse Change Request documentation (FDS/TDS), T&M consumption, and enhancement delivery against approved scope.
  • Coordinate impact assessment, regression testing, and stabilization activities for ERP system mandatory quarterly cloud updates; ensure partner readiness and risk mitigation prior to patch deployment.
  • Lead and/or participate in daily operational standups, weekly service reviews, the monthly Executive Steering Committee, and the quarterly Patch & Strategy Alignment forum with the partner; consolidate reporting for management visibility.
  • Ensure the partner adheres to IOH IAM/MFA access standards, data confidentiality requirements, and change governance (no production change without an approved CR and roll-back plan); maintain audit evidence of access and change activities.
  • Validate monthly service evidence (SLA summary, RCA/CAPA, ticket tracker, UAT sign-offs) submitted by the partner and process monthly BAST acceptance in line with IOH governance standards.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP/IT operations, including at least 2 years in ERP system (Oracle Fusion ERP & EPM) implementation, support, or vendor/managed services governance within a large enterprise environment. Experience overseeing L1/L2/L3 Application Managed Services and SLA-based vendor management is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP/EPM modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, PPM, Procurement, Tax, FCCS/TRCS/EDMCS), OCI infrastructure, and OIC integration concepts; understanding of ITSM/ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes; SLA and vendor performance management; strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills; proficient in MS Office and reporting tools; good command of English (written and verbal).

name: Data Center Technicians
description_html:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
  • Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
  • Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
  • Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
  • Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
  • Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embodies our culture and values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 1+ year(s) experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays

name: Technician - Data Center
description_html:
Job Description

As the Technician - Data Center, you will be responsible for effectively performing assigned tasks in a data center, including general datacenter, servers and network devices setup, maintenance and troubleshooting. You will be accountable for setup and operational functions, assembly, equipment operation, general maintenance and housekeeping at assigned project locations.

Responsibilities

  • Perform weekly sweeps of server and storage equipment in the data center, detecting hardware and network connectivity issues; collect and analyze ipmi-sel data and vendor-specific platform management logs
  • Diagnose server and storage equipment connectivity issues, including basic troubleshooting of network transceiver and optical fiber signal strength problems, using tools and procedures established in the data center
  • Use collected diagnostic information to engage vendor support organizations (HPE, Dell, IX, etc.) by opening support cases and following up on hardware fixes and investigations as requested
  • Collaborate with the data center operations team to manage the logistical aspects of the break-and-fix process, including escorting vendor contractors for repairs and ensuring alignment with established operational practices
  • Oversee the logistical aspects of Return Material Authorization (RMA) processes for components such as rPDUs, network switches, and field-replaceable units (PSU, fan modules, controller modules)
  • Provide hardware support for installations, moves, additions, and changes
  • Decommission IT equipment such as HDD/SSD, networks, servers, storage, and backup devices
  • Conduct regular physical and visual inspections of equipment and data center facilities
  • Manage inventory records and perform regular cycle counts to ensure asset accuracy
  • Update documentation for structured cabling and materials during new installations
  • Oversee capacity management in terms of space, power, cooling, and patch panel port availability
  • Understand and follow incident and change management processes
  • Submit regular reports on move, change, support requests, and other activities, maintaining continuous improvement efforts
  • Light traveling from site to site
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School Degree or Equivalent required; Bachelor's Degree - IT Business or related field preferred
  • Licenses/Certificates/Designations: CCNA and CCNP preferred
  • 2 years in an enterprise Data Center environment with strong knowledge of data center best practices
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting and diagnosing server hardware issues from major vendors
  • Experience troubleshooting Ethernet network connectivity issues, including RJ45 copper uplinks and LC/MPO fiber uplinks
  • Good understanding of data cabling and patching
  • Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities
  • Ability to respond promptly to issues, provide updates, and escalate when necessary
  • Fluent in English
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Ability to travel 0% - 25%
  • Basic computer skills preferred
  • Field Service or Data Center Technician experience preferred

Working Environment: Data Center - The data center work environment is a highly secure, physically demanding, and structured operation, characterized by its loud, controlled temperature conditions and 24/7/365 uptime. The environment demands a high attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills to manage and troubleshoot critical equipment during regular operation and in emergency situations. Lifting up to 50 lbs, regular bending, stooping, climbing and long periods of walking / standing will be required.

Physical Expectations

  • Work is physically strenuous, and workers are required to lift heavy packages up to 50 pounds.
  • Work may require excessive bending or stooping.
  • Employee required to walk long distances repeatedly throughout the day.
  • Employee required to climb ladders.

name: Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)
description_html:
AI時代の新しい産業体験をデザインする｜プロダクトデザイナー（UI/UX）

Description

なぜ、リアル産業にUXデザインが必要なのか？

建設業や製造業では今なお、

・電話

・メール

・Excel

・紙図面

を中心としたコミュニケーションが数多く残っています。

多くの業務は、人の経験や暗黙知によって支えられています。

しかしAI時代に求められるのは、単なるデジタル化ではありません。

複雑な業務を理解し、

情報の流れを整理し、

人とテクノロジーが自然に協働できる体験を設計することです。

BALLASのデザイナーは、単に画面をデザインするだけではありません。

設計・調達・製造・施工にまたがる業務を理解しながら、新しい産業体験そのものを設計していく存在です。

業務内容

BALLASのデザイナーは、プロダクトだけでなく事業やブランドも含めた体験設計を担います。

プロダクトデザイン

  • 顧客業務の観察・課題発見
  • ユーザー体験設計
  • 情報設計
  • UIデザイン
  • デザインシステム構築
  • PdMやエンジニアとのプロダクト開発

サービスデザイン

  • 設計、調達、施工など業務プロセスの可視化
  • 顧客接点全体の体験設計
  • 新規プロダクトのコンセプト設計

ブランドデザイン

  • サービスサイト
  • コーポレートサイト
  • 営業資料
  • ホワイトペーパー
  • イベントクリエイティブ など、プロダクトとブランドを横断した体験づくりを担います。

BALLASとは？

「建設業を最適化し、人々を幸せに。」をミッションに掲げ、建設サプライチェーンをアップグレードするテックカンパニーです。

プラットフォーム運営を通じて設計・調達・製造に携わりながら一次情報を蓄積し、業界の標準化・最適化を推進しています。

リアルなオペレーションをコード化し、AI Nativeな産業インフラの構築を目指しています。

BALLASのプロダクト

BALLASでは「BALLAS SCM」と「BALLAS LINKS」の2つのプロダクトがあります。

「BALLAS SCM」は、自社とパートナー工場様が使うサービスで、設計から製造までのオペレーションをAI Nativeに再設計するためのプロダクトです。

「BALLAS LINKS」は、お客様である建設工事会社様が使うプロダクトです。こちらは、建設工事会社様の内部にある設計・調達プロセスを統合するプロジェクト基盤になります。

今までお客様は、図面の管理にファイルサーバーやクラウド、仕様の協議はメールやチャット、やりとりは口頭と様々なツールを使い分ける状況でした。それを一つに統合することで、認識のズレや余計な工数を大幅に削減できます。さらに、蓄積された作図・購買プロセスデータをもとに、AIによる業務の自動化も進めています。

【参考：BALLASが取り組む課題】

BALLASが挑む建設サプライチェーンの復興──消えゆく町工場と日本の課題

https://youtrust.jp/studio/articles/ballas

代表・木村の起業への想い

なぜBALLASを立ち上げたのか

1400年以上にわたり日本の発展を支えてきた建設業界は、今なお社会インフラを支える巨大産業です。一方で、現場では深刻な職人不足や、アナログで不透明な調達プロセスによる過度な調整負担など、産業全体の生産性を阻害する課題が残されています。

多重請負構造の中で分断されてきた設計・調達・製造・施工のプロセスをデータでつなぎ直し、人とAIが協働できる業務構造へ再設計することで、人が創造的な仕事や本質的な意思決定に集中できる産業を実現したい。

その想いから、BALLASを創業しました。

name: Product Designer (Talent Pool)
description_html:
Please Note: This is an open application for our Talent Pool. While we may not have an immediate opening today, we are actively looking for exceptional Product Designers to join our talent network for upcoming project needs and future team expansion.

About DKatalis

DKatalis is a financial technology company with multiple offices in the APAC region. In our quest to build a better financial world, one of our key goals is to create an ecosystem-linked financial services business.

DKatalis is built and backed by experienced and successful entrepreneurs, bankers, and investors in Singapore and Indonesia who have more than 30 years of financial domain experience and are from top-tier schools like Stanford, Cambridge London Business School, JNU with more than 30 years of building financial services/banking experience from Bank BTPN, Danamon, Citibank, McKinsey & Co, Northstar, Farallon Capital, and HSBC.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll shape meaningful product experiences by combining user understanding, design excellence, and strategic thinking. You'll work closely with UX Writers, UX Researchers, Product Managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and build digital products that make banking simple, intuitive, and enjoyable for our users.

Great Design and User Experience

Create intuitive, engaging, and consistent product experiences that address user needs and deliver meaningful value.

  • Design end-to-end user experiences across apps, websites, and other digital touchpoints, translating complex problems into simple, intuitive, and accessible solutions.
  • Develop user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and high-quality interfaces that support user goals and business objectives.
  • Apply strong visual design and interaction principles to create polished, cohesive, and engaging experiences across platforms and devices.
  • Use and continuously improve our design system, contributing reusable components, interaction patterns, and design standards that enable consistency and scalability.
  • Identify and solve usability issues, interaction friction, inconsistent patterns, and conflicting product experiences across user journeys.
  • Collaborate with UX Writers to integrate content and interaction design, ensuring language, information, and visual elements work together to guide users effectively.
  • Explore and validate different design approaches, using creativity, established design principles, and emerging technologies to develop effective solutions.
  • Consider accessibility, usability, technical feasibility, and diverse user needs throughout the design process to create inclusive experiences.

Design Strategy and Process

Translate user insights, business needs, and technical constraints into effective product solutions, ensuring design decisions are grounded in evidence and aligned with measurable outcomes.

  • Identify user problems, business opportunities, assumptions, and knowledge gaps to establish clear design objectives before developing solutions.
  • Work with UX Researchers, UX Writers, data teams, and other stakeholders to understand user needs, evaluate concepts, and validate design decisions.
  • Translate research findings, behavioral data, and business requirements into actionable design opportunities and practical product solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, engineers, and business teams to shape product features, define requirements, explore trade-offs, and align on intended outcomes.
  • Take ownership of design problems from discovery through delivery, ensuring solutions address underlying user needs rather than simply fulfilling predefined requirements.
  • Apply and continuously improve our design process, adapting methods and activities to the complexity, uncertainty, and needs of each project.
  • Clearly articulate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations through compelling narratives that help stakeholders understand the problem, proposed solution, and expected impact.

What You Need to Have

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in product design, UI/UX design, or a related field working on digital products. Fintech or banking experience is a plus.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design, user-centered problem-solving, visual excellence, interaction design, and cross-platform experiences.
  • Proven ability to translate user research, business requirements, and complex problems into practical, intuitive, and effective product solutions.
  • Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, usability principles, visual design, accessibility, and design systems.
  • Experience collaborating with researchers, writers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Ability to use research insights, product data, and usability findings to inform design decisions, evaluate solutions, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain design rationale and project context to audiences unfamiliar with the work.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and balance user needs with business and technical constraints.
  • Experience providing constructive feedback, mentoring other designers, and contributing to design standards and team practices.
  • A proactive, collaborative mindset with the ability to take ownership, influence decisions, and continuously improve both design quality and product outcomes.
