Kami membuka kesempatan bagi profesional UI/UX Designer yang kreatif, berorientasi pada pengguna untuk bergabung dalam tim kami. Posisi ini memegang peranan penting dalam merancang antarmuka digital (web & mobile) yang tidak hanya estetik, tetapi juga intuitif, fungsional, dan memberikan pengalaman terbaik bagi pengguna.

Jika Anda memiliki passion dalam menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis dan riset pengguna menjadi desain visual serta prototipe yang solutif, kami mengundang Anda untuk menjadi bagian dari tim kami.

Informasi Posisi

  • Posisi: UI/UX Designer
  • Lokasi Kerja: Hybrid - Jakarta
  • Status Kerja: Full-time
  • Level Posisi: Middle Level

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Sebagai UI/UX Designer, Anda akan berkontribusi langsung pada pengalaman pengguna dan tampilan visual produk digital, dengan tanggung jawab utama meliputi:

  • Melakukan riset pengguna (user research), analisis kompetitor, dan pemetaan alur pengguna (user journey / user flow).
  • Menyusun wireframe, information architecture, serta prototipe interaktif (low-fidelity hingga high-fidelity) untuk aplikasi web dan mobile.
  • Merancang antarmuka visual (UI) yang estetik, konsisten, dan sesuai dengan panduan brand.
  • Menyusun, memelihara, dan mengembangkan Design System serta UI Kit agar proses pengembangan produk lebih efisien.
  • Melakukan usability testing dan mengumpulkan masukan dari pengguna untuk iterasi perbaikan desain.
  • Bekerja sama secara erat dengan Project Manager, Product Owner, dan Developer dalam tahap handoff desain hingga implementasi teknis.

Target utama posisi ini adalah menciptakan pengalaman pengguna yang mulus (seamless user experience), meningkatkan engagement serta kemudahan penggunaan aplikasi, dan memastikan rancangan desain dapat diimplementasikan secara akurat oleh tim pengembang.

Requirement

  • Kualifikasi

Pendidikan S1/D3 Di Bidang

  • Desain Komunikasi Visual (DKV)
  • Sistem Informasi / Teknik Informatika

Desain Produk atau bidang terkait yang relevan

Pengalaman

Minimal 1–2 Tahun Pengalaman Pada Posisi

  • UI/UX Designer / Product Designer
  • Interaction Designer / Visual Designer (diutamakan di industri software development)

Kemampuan Teknis

Kandidat Diharapkan Memiliki Penguasaan Terkait

  • Penguasaan mendalam atas design tools industri terkini, terutama Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Design System, Prototyping).
  • Pemahaman kuat mengenai prinsip-prinsip User-Centered Design (UCD), Information Architecture, dan Usability Heuristics.
  • Kemampuan membuat wireframe, user flow, dan prototipe interaktif berbasis mikro-interaksi.
  • Pemahaman dasar mengenai keterbatasan teknis pengembangan web/mobile (seperti HTML/CSS, responsive grid, serta pedoman desain iOS/Android).
  • Kemampuan menyusun dan mengelola Design System & UI Kit.

Soft Skill

  • Kemampuan memecahkan masalah (problem-solving) yang berorientasi pada kebutuhan pengguna dan tujuan bisnis.
  • Kemampuan komunikasi visual dan verbal yang baik untuk mempresentasikan serta mempertahankan konsep desain.
  • Sikap kolaboratif dan terbuka terhadap masukan (feedback-driven mindset).
  • Perhatian tinggi terhadap detail (eye for detail) baik dari segi tata letak, tipografi, hingga hirarki visual.

Target Kinerja

Dalam Posisi Ini Anda Diharapkan Mampu

  • Menghasilkan rancangan UI/UX yang siap di-handoff ke tim developer tanpa hambatan pemahaman komponen.
  • Menjaga konsistensi visual dan standar interaksi di seluruh produk digital yang dikembangkan.
  • Melakukan iterasi desain secara cepat berdasarkan hasil uji pengguna (usability test) maupun kebutuhan proyek.

Nilai Tambah

Kandidat Dengan Pengalaman Berikut Akan Menjadi Prioritas

  • Memiliki portofolio kuat yang menampilkan proses berpikir dari riset hingga hasil akhir desain (case study UI/UX).
  • Pengalaman merancang aplikasi berskala kompleks (B2B SaaS, E-Commerce, atau FinTech).
  • Memahami dasar-dasar mikro-animasi / motion design (seperti Lottie, Principle, atau fitur Smart Animate lanjutan di Figma).

Mengapa Bergabung Dengan Vascomm?

  • Kesempatan untuk merancang berbagai produk digital inovatif dari beragam industri.
  • Lingkungan kerja yang menghargai kreativitas, eksperimen desain, dan prinsip user-centric.
  • Ruang kolaborasi yang erat dengan tim engineering dan manajemen produk yang saling mendukung perkembangan karir Anda.

As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.

Innovative Financial Ecosystem: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services.

As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally.

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams.

Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way.

‍

What You'll Do

  • Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer
  • Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma
  • Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent
  • Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended
  • Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams.

In your first 6 months, you might

  • Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system
  • Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones
  • Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers
  • Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed.

‍

What We're Looking For

  • Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance
  • A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens
  • At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail
  • Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built
  • Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers
  • Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer.

Preferred (Nice To Have)

  • Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools
  • Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow
  • A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software
  • Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus

description_html:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Ludios

About Ludios

Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a talented and skilled UX Designer to join our team and help create engaging and intuitive experiences for our next big hit.

As a UX Designer, you will work closely with the Lead UX Designer and the wider game development team to design and improve features throughout the game. You will be responsible for translating feature requirements into clear user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction solutions.

The role will involve working primarily in Figma, creating Lo-Fi wireframes, user flows, flowcharts, and state machines when necessary. You will also research and analyze competitors' games to understand existing UX patterns and adapt relevant ideas to our game.

You will join the team at an important stage as we continue to build and evolve our UX team and processes. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on the player experience while developing their skills and taking ownership of features over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide engaging, intuitive, and functional UX solutions for new and existing game features.
  • Work closely with the Lead UX Designer to understand requirements, identify UX problems, and develop appropriate solutions.
  • Translate game and product requirements into clear user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction designs.
  • Create Lo-Fi and Mid-Fi wireframes in Figma to quickly explore and communicate UX solutions.
  • Create flowcharts and state machines when necessary to communicate complex feature logic, player states, and interactions.
  • Break down complex features into clear user journeys, states, interactions, and edge cases.
  • Analyze how new features interact with existing game systems and ensure a consistent player experience.
  • Research and analyze competitor games to understand how similar features and experiences are designed.
  • Identify useful UX patterns from competitor products and adapt them appropriately to our game's needs rather than simply replicating them.
  • Iterate on designs based on feedback from the Lead UX Designer, game designers, product team, playtesting, and other stakeholders.
  • Design and optimize gameplay and feature flows so that players can easily understand, navigate, and interact with the game.
  • Consider different player states, edge cases, and scenarios when designing features.
  • Collaborate closely with Game Design, Product, UI, Art, and Engineering teams to ensure UX solutions are practical and technically feasible.
  • Maintain organized and understandable UX documentation and Figma files.
  • Contribute to improving the team's UX processes, patterns, and best practices.

Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

  • Professional experience in UX Design within the Games industry, preferably mobile games.
  • A portfolio demonstrating completed UX projects and a strong understanding of interaction design.

  • Ability to break down complex features into clear flows, states, and interactions.
  • Good working knowledge of Figma, particularly for wireframing, prototyping, and creating user flows.
  • Experience creating Lo-Fi and Mid-Fi wireframes and interactive prototypes.

name: UX Designer - Developer Experience (DevEx)
description_html:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

Why this role exists

Designing for developers is a distinct craft. The interface is often the dashboard, the API reference, the sandbox, the error states, and the logs, information-dense surfaces for a technical audience with little patience for friction. This role makes the developer's experience clear, fast, and trustworthy across those surfaces.

What You'll Own

  • Product design for the developer dashboard and integration surfaces.
  • Information design for docs and API reference, in partnership with Engineering and content.
  • Error states, empty states, sandbox and testing flows, the moments where developers get stuck.
  • Discovery with developers, and close collaboration with the DevEx PM and Engineering.

How You Will Work

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and are embedded with the Developer Experience PM and Engineering as the design owner for developer-facing surfaces. You adopt and extend the domain design system rather than owning it, partnering with the senior design-system lead on shared patterns, so your time is weighted toward product work from the start. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What We're Looking For

  • Product-design craft with evidence of designing for technical, developer, or data-dense products. A portfolio is a must.
  • Comfort with information-dense UI, dashboards, tables, complex states.
  • The ability to partner closely with engineers. You work well alongside technical teams.

A strong plus: having designed docs, API reference, or developer tools; technical literacy; fintech experience.

name: Gamification Visual Designer
description_html:
About The Role

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Gamification Visual Designer to craft engaging visual experiences for our gamification initiatives across digital products. In this role, you will transform business objectives and product concepts into compelling game-inspired experiences that enhance user engagement, motivation, and retention.

This is a visual design-focused role within a digital product environment. You will work on gamification experiences rather than traditional game development.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Business teams, and Animators to design visual concepts, interactive assets, and lightweight prototypes that bring gamified features to life.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the visual direction, art style, and creative concepts for gamification features that align with product goals and user engagement strategies.
  • Design high-quality game assets, including characters, illustrations, environments, icons, rewards, badges, and UI elements.
  • Create engaging user interfaces and interactive visual components for gamified experiences across web and mobile platforms.
  • Produce wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and motion concepts to effectively communicate gameplay interactions and user flows.
  • Build lightweight animations and interactive prototypes to validate concepts before production.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Business teams, and Animators throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Translate product requirements into intuitive and visually appealing game experiences while maintaining consistency with the company's design system and brand identity.
  • Utilize AI-powered design tools to accelerate ideation, concept generation, and design iteration.
  • Participate in design reviews, brainstorming sessions, and user feedback discussions to continuously improve the player experience.
  • Stay updated with industry trends, gamification techniques, interaction design, and emerging AI-assisted creative workflows.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Information Engineering, Human–Computer Interaction, Visual Communication Design, Multimedia, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Game Design, Game UI Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or related creative roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe After Effects.
  • Practical experience utilizing AI tools to enhance creativity and accelerate design workflows.
  • Strong visual storytelling skills with the ability to transform abstract ideas into engaging user experiences.
  • Experience creating prototypes, motion mockups, or animations to communicate design concepts effectively.
  • Strong understanding of visual design principles, visual hierarchy, composition, typography, color theory, and interaction design.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with experience working in cross-functional product teams.
  • Professional proficiency in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing gamification features such as rewards, achievements, missions, leaderboards, loyalty programs, or incentive-based user journeys.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as insurance, financial services, banking, or payments.
  • Experience in IT consulting, creative agencies, or digital product companies.
  • Passion for gaming, digital products, and creating engaging user experiences.

We are looking for a Creative Experience Designer who combines strong visual design, creative thinking, web experience, AI-assisted production, and digital asset creation.

This role will work closely with our web developers to create visually distinctive, interactive, modern, and high-quality websites.   • Use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate:
  • Ideation
  • Concept development
  • Visual exploration
  • Layout creation
  • Asset generation
  • Image generation
  • Design iteration
  • Prototyping
  • The 3–5 website/day target is intended for an AI-assisted production workflow, where templates, systems, reusable components, and AI tools are used to significantly accelerate production.
  • The designer is still expected to provide human creative input and manual refinement so that websites do not feel identical, repetitive, or entirely AI-generated.
  • Balance speed, creativity, originality, and execution quality throughout the production process.
4. AI-Assisted Design
  • Use AI as an integral part of the creative and production workflow.
  • Explore and utilize AI tools for image generation, visual concepts, references, layout exploration, copy ideation, and other creative tasks.
  • Understand how to effectively prompt and direct AI tools toward a desired visual outcome.
  • Select, modify, combine, and refine AI-generated outputs rather than using them without further creative development.
  • Identify when AI-generated assets require manual correction or replacement.
  • Develop efficient workflows that allow AI to increase production speed without compromising creative quality.
  • Stay up to date with emerging AI design and creative technologies.
5. Custom Graphic & Visual Asset Creation
  • Create and customize visual assets for websites.
  • Add manually designed elements to AI-generated websites to create a more authentic and human-designed appearance.
  • Develop:
  • Illustrations
  • Icons
  • Background graphics
  • Decorative elements
  • Typography treatments
  • UI elements
  • Visual compositions
  • Brand assets
  • Combine AI-generated assets with manually created graphics and existing design resources.
  • Ensure visual assets are consistent with the overall creative direction.
6. 3D Design & Assets
  • Create or source 3D assets for websites when required.
  • Develop 3D objects, scenes, compositions, and visual elements.
  • Explore 3D as a way to enhance website identity and visual storytelling.
  • Prepare 3D assets for use on websites while considering performance and loading requirements.
  • Experience with tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Spline, or similar software is highly valuable.
7. Motion & Interactive Design
  • Develop concepts for website animations and interactive experiences.
  • Think about how elements should move, transition, react, and respond to user interaction.
  • Create motion concepts, micro-interactions, transitions, hover effects, scrolling effects, and other interactive elements.
  • Work with developers to ensure the intended interactions can be implemented effectively.
  • Understand the balance between visual impact and website performance.
8. Collaboration with Web Developers
  • Work directly with web developers throughout the website production process.
  • Communicate design concepts, interactions, animations, assets, and technical requirements clearly.
  • Provide developers with the necessary visual assets and design references.
  • Collaborate on creative solutions when a design concept needs to be adapted to technical limitations.
  • Review implemented websites and identify visual inconsistencies or areas that require refinement.
  • Help ensure the final website matches the intended creative direction.
9. Website Flow & User Experience
  • Think about the complete user journey rather than individual pages alone.
  • Develop logical and engaging website flows.
  • Consider how users discover information, navigate between sections, and interact with content.
  • Create experiences that are visually interesting while remaining intuitive and easy to use.
  • Work with developers to ensure transitions between pages and sections feel smooth.
10. Visual Quality & Creative Detail
  • Maintain a high standard of visual quality across all websites.
  • Pay close attention to:
  • Typography
  • Spacing
  • Alignment
  • Composition
  • Color
  • Contrast
  • Visual hierarchy
  • Image quality
  • Animation
  • Interaction
  • Consistency
  • Review AI-generated designs and manually refine areas that feel unnatural, repetitive, or unfinished.
  • Ensure every website has a clear creative identity despite the high production volume.
11. Design Systems & Production Efficiency
  • Develop and maintain reusable design systems, components, templates, and visual frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize repetitive production tasks.
  • Build workflows that allow the team to produce multiple websites efficiently without sacrificing quality.
  • Create reusable visual components that can be adapted to different projects.
  • Continuously improve the AI + design workflow to increase both speed and quality.
12. Website Performance Awareness
  • Understand that visual quality must be balanced with website performance.
  • Consider image sizes, animations, 3D assets, video, and interactive elements from a performance perspective.
  • Collaborate with developers to avoid unnecessary performance bottlenecks.
  • Ensure creative elements are optimized appropriately for web usage.
13. Research & Creative Trends
  • Stay up to date with current trends in:
  • Web design
  • Digital experiences
  • UI/UX
  • Motion design
  • 3D design
  • AI-generated design
  • Creative technology
  • Interactive websites
  • Regularly research interesting websites, studios, designers, technologies, and emerging creative techniques.
  • Bring new ideas and references into the team's creative process.
REQUIREMENTSMust Have
  • Strong visual and graphic design skills.
  • Strong understanding of website aesthetics and digital design.
  • Good sense of typography, composition, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to generate and develop creative concepts quickly.
  • Comfortable working with AI-assisted creative workflows.
  • Ability to manually refine and customize AI-generated outputs.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Able to work quickly in a high-volume production environment.
  • Comfortable collaborating with web developers.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness to work Monday–Saturday according to the production schedule.
Preferred Skills

Experience with some or all of the following is highly valuable:

  • Figma
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • After Effects
  • Blender
  • Cinema 4D
  • Spline
  • Framer
  • Webflow
  • Three.js / WebGL
  • Motion design
  • 3D design
  • UI/UX design
  • Creative coding
  • Interactive web design
  • AI image-generation tools
  • AI video-generation tools
  • AI design and prototyping tools
PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Success in this role will be measured through a combination of:

  • Website production volume
  • Ability to consistently work toward the 3–5 websites/day target
  • Visual quality
  • Creative originality
  • Website aesthetics
  • Effective use of AI
  • Quality of manual refinement
  • Custom asset contribution
  • Speed and turnaround time
  • Website flow and user experience
  • Collaboration with developers
  • Attention to detail
  • Low unnecessary revision requirements
  • Ability to maintain quality while working at high production volume

The goal is not simply to produce a large number of AI-generated websites, but to create a workflow where AI provides speed and scale while the designer provides taste, creativity, direction, and human-crafted detail.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

The ideal candidate is someone who thinks like a designer, creative director, and digital experience designer, while also being comfortable working with modern AI tools.

You should be able to look at an AI-generated website and immediately identify:

“What is missing?”

Then turn it into something that feels:

more intentional, more creative, more polished, and more human.

You should be comfortable moving quickly from:

Idea → AI Exploration → Design → Manual Refinement → Assets → Developer Collaboration → Final Website

while maintaining a high standard of visual quality across multiple projects every day.mary of the role, what success in the position looks like, and how this role fits into the organization overall.

name: プロダクトデザイナー｜東京
description_html:
飲食の未来を、テクノロジーで切り拓く。

友人と語り合った居酒屋の夜。家族で囲んだ食卓。初めてのデートで緊張しながら入ったレストラン。

「食べる」という体験には、いつも人生の大切な瞬間が寄り添っています。

日本の外食産業は25兆円規模。ミシュラン星付きレストランの数は世界一。

しかしその裏側では、高い倒産率、深刻な人手不足、薄い利益率——構造的な課題が山積しています。

「好きなことを仕事にしたのに、続けられない」。そんな声が溢れるこの業界を、私たちは変えたい。

All in One Restaurant Cloud.

ダイニーは「All in One Restaurant Cloud.」として、POSレジ・モバイルオーダー・CRM・シフト/勤怠管理・決済まで、飲食店経営に必要な機能をワンストップで提供しています。

「儲かるお店をつくる」 — 売上データの一元管理とCRMで、利益を最大化。

「働く人のやりがいを高める」 — 従業員の貢献度を可視化し、離職率を低減。

「金融アクセスを向上させる」 — 決済・与信で飲食店のキャッシュフローを改善。

解約率は0.5%未満。一度使ったお店が手放さないプロダクトで、急成長を実現しています。

AIエージェントで、経営そのものを自動化する。

2026年7月、ダイニーはAIエージェント事業を本格始動しました。

売上照合・日次PL・請求書管理・不正操作検知など、飲食企業のバックオフィスに残る人手依存の業務を、AIエージェントが自動化する新プロダクト群です。

POS・モバイルオーダーで蓄積したデータと、数多くの飲食企業との接点を持つダイニーだからこそ、実際の顧客課題を起点にAIを社会実装できる。

「All in One Restaurant Cloud」の先へ——AIエージェントとともに、飲食業の真のインフラを目指します。

現場に立つ。1次情報を、自分の目で。

ダイニーには「シフトイン」という文化があります。

プロダクトチームが実際に飲食店のシフトに入り、厨房やホールに立つ。オーダーを受け、料理を運び、お客様の表情を見る。

会議室では見えない現場のリアルを、自分の体で理解する。

この「1次情報を自分の足で取りに行く」顧客志向の徹底が、ダイニーの競争力の源泉です。

AI Native — 自分たち自身も、テクノロジーで進化する。

ダイニーは全社員がAIを日常業務に実装する「AI Nativeカンパニー」です。

毎週AI勉強会を開催し、エンジニアだけでなくHR・CS・セールス、全員がAIを使いこなします。

あらゆるプロセスにAIが組み込まれ、少数精鋭で圧倒的な生産性を実現。

飲食業界をテクノロジーで変えると言いながら、自分たちの働き方が旧態依然では説得力がない。

だから私たちは、自らが最も先進的な働き方を実践します。

Mission・Vision・Values

Mission：「"飲食"をもっと楽しくおもしろく。」

Vision：「全ての人の"飲食"インフラになる。」

"飲食"は、人々が心を通わすために欠かせないもの。

外食産業はGDPの5%を占める経済の屋台骨であり、世界に誇る日本の象徴的な文化です。

私たちはテクノロジーを活用し、この尊い産業を支え、よりやりがいがあり、おもしろいものに発展させていきます。

真心をこめる — 関わるすべての人に、真剣に尽くす心で。

事に向き合う — 固定観念にとらわれず、本質を見極めて。

魂を燃やす — 圧倒的な情熱と貪欲さで、物事に取り組む。

メガベンチャー、コンサルファーム、飲食業界出身者——多様なバックグラウンドを持つ125名が、東京・大阪・札幌・名古屋の4拠点で活躍中。

経営ボードミーティングは全て英語。日本発、世界で戦えるエクセレントカンパニーを目指しています。

参考資料

■ ダイニー採用情報

https://www.notion.so/diniinote/4f1f4687b47a48ee9de7abbe5a1f3814

■ カルチャーデック

https://speakerdeck.com/diniiofficial/dinii-company-deck-ver-dot-1-0-2024

■ ダイニーの道のりと今後のビジョンについて（PIVOT登壇）

https://t.co/5tjKbEClU5

■ ダイニー社員食堂（note記事）

https://note.com/dinii/m/m82d04c587a4c

募集背景

ダイニーは、「すべての人の“飲食”のインフラになる」というVisionのもと、BtoB、BtoC、そしてBtoE（Employee）までを対象に、注文・決済・POS・CRM・勤怠など、店舗運営に必要な機能をまとめたAll-in-One SaaS型のプロダクトで、飲食業界全体の構造課題に向き合っています。

ダイニーが挑戦しているのは、年間25兆円規模の外食産業。

その産業を支える事業者・スタッフ・顧客すべてが日々使う“インフラ”をつくることを目指しています。

現在、複数の新規プロダクトやブランディング案件が同時並行で進行中で、FinTechやデータ連携、グローバル展開など次の成長ステージを見据えた構想も動き出しています。まさに、「事業を伸ばすデザイン」が求められるフェーズです。

このポジションでは、単なるUIデザインにとどまらず、「何をつくるか」「なぜそれをつくるか」という上流の問いから関わり、事業・プロダクト・顧客への提供価値を横断して体験価値を設計していきます。

BtoBの構造的な課題の解決、BtoCの直感的でわかりやすく楽しい体験、BtoEの現場感をプロダクトに反映し、価値ある体験をユーザーに届けることで、事業成長につなげられるポジションです。

私たちは、そんな体験づくりをリードいただけるデザイナーを募集しています。

業務内容

プロダクトの上流設計から体験の具現化まで、プロダクトの中核に関わっていただきます。

  • ユーザー課題、提供価値を踏まえた情報設計、UI設計、プロトタイピング
  • ユーザー体験を起点としたプロダクトデザイン方針の策定
  • 新機能、新プロダクトの構想フェーズにおけるUX設計、検証
  • デザインシステムの設計、実装
  • ユーザーリサーチ設計、ユーザー行動の分析に基づく改善提案
  • ブランドや言語設計を含むプロダクト全体の体験設計
  • PdM、エンジニア、Bizチームとの共創による開発プロセスの推進

キャリアパス

ご本人の志向や強みに応じて、以下のように多様なキャリアパスを描くことができます。

成長の方向性（3つの軸）

  • プロダクト軸（UX/UIデザインの深化）
  • 複数のプロダクトに関わり、ユーザーフロー改善や複雑なUI設計に挑戦
  • 機能単位のデザインだけでなく、サービス全体の体験設計・ビジュアル設計まで担う
  • 一貫性ある体験を支えるデザインシステムの構築・運用
  • 事業・戦略軸（デザインリード / PMFへの貢献）
  • プロダクトの初期フェーズから企画・検証・ブランディングをリード
  • PdMやBizチームと連携し、事業成長に寄与する体験価値を設計
  • 実店舗やユーザーと共にPoC（概念実証）を通じて価値検証を実施
  • 組織・育成軸（マネジメント・チームづくり）
  • チームビルディング、評価制度や仕組み設計
  • 組織横断でのカルチャー浸透やインナーブランディングへの貢献
  • DesignOpsの整備・推進により、デザイン組織の生産性と再現性を向上

必須経験・スキル

  • BtoBプロダクトや業務システムのUX設計経験
  • Webまたはアプリケーション領域でのUI/UXデザイン実務経験（3年以上目安）
  • 顧客課題を理解した上での体験設計
  • Figma等を用いた設計〜プロトタイピングの経験
  • 定量、定性データを用いたデザインの意思決定経験
  • PdM、エンジニアと連携したプロダクト開発経験

歓迎経験・スキル

  • BtoB SaaSにおけるプロダクトデザインのリード経験
  • 新規事業、0→1フェーズでのUX構想・体験設計の経験
  • デザインシステム、ガイドライン、ポリシーの策定〜運用
  • UXリサーチ、インタビュー設計、ユーザビリティテストのリード経験
  • ブランドやメッセージングを含むトータルな体験設計経験
  • SQLやBIツールを用いた行動分析・効果検証の経験
  • チームマネジメントまたはメンター経験
  • グローバル展開、アクセシビリティ対応など、多様なユーザーを意識したデザイン経験

name: UX Researcher
description_html:
About the Role:

We're looking for a UX Researcher to join our growing research team. You'll work across multiple product areas, partnering with PMs, designers, and analysts to turn user behavior and feedback into decisions that shape our product direction.

  • Identify research opportunities and validate them through well-scoped research initiatives
  • Run end-to-end research projects, from writing the brief, executing the study, all the way to analysis and reporting
  • Work closely with product analysts to read behavioral patterns and interpret raw data, then turn those signals into research directions and potential solutions
  • Partner with product managers to support roadmap prioritization, making sure user insights are part of the decision-making process



About You:

  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in a UX Research role
  • Experience in the financial or fintech industry is preferred
  • If any, please attach a portfolio link in your CV (preferable)
  • Solid grasp of both quantitative and qualitative methods, with stronger fluency on the quantitative side (survey design, segmentation, statistical analysis, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate research findings into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Strong problem-solving mindset, with a good sense of how to balance user needs and business priorities when proposing UX solutions
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field such as Information Systems, Informatics, Psychology, HCI, or equivalent

name: UI/UX Product Design Intern
description_html:
We are looking for a UI/UX Product Design Intern to join our Loyalty Department and support our design team in creating user-friendly digital product experiences. In this role, you will work on wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and UI designs while supporting UX research activities and design requests from internal teams and clients. You will collaborate with the designer, product, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality designs and contribute to improving the overall user experience.


Job Description

  • Create wireframes, user flows, and low-to-mid-fidelity prototypes using Figma.
  • Design UI screens and components that follow the existing design system and maintain high visual standards.
  • Support design requests from internal teams and clients, ensuring timely delivery.
  • Assist with UX research activities, including competitor analysis, user flows, surveys, and usability testing.
  • Gather and incorporate feedback from the designer, product, and engineering teams.
  • Prepare design assets and handoff specifications for developers.
  • Maintain organised design files, versions, and documentation.
  • Track design requests and progress, and report blockers to the designer.
  • Participate in design reviews, team meetings, and brainstorming sessions.
  • Stay up to date with design trends, tools, and best practices, including AI-assisted design tools.


Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Design (DKV), Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Less than one year of professional experience.
  • Proficient in Figma, particularly Auto Layout, Components, and Prototyping.
  • Strong visual design skills, with a good eye for layout, typography, colour, and visual polish.
  • Basic understanding of UX research methods, including user flows, personas, usability testing, and competitor analysis.
  • A portfolio showcasing UI/UX or product design projects. Academic and personal projects are welcome.
  • Able to manage multiple requests and deadlines effectively.
  • Good communication skills in both Indonesian and English.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude and Cursor for prototyping is a plus.

name: Intern Product Designer (UI/UX)
description_html:
Back to Careers

Design

Intern Product Designer

UI/UX.

  • Internship
  • Jakarta, Indonesia
  • Hybrid
  • 3–6 months
  • Hot Role

Design and build the next era of conversational commerce.

Join our product team to design and build the next era of conversational commerce. At bitbybit, product designers are full-cycle creators — we don't just hand off static Figma files, we operate a cutting-edge AI-assisted Design-to-Code workflow. You'll work closely with our product and engineering teams to design intuitive, high-polish interfaces, write product specs (PRDs), and learn to leverage AI tools to translate designs into front-end code assets. If you have an obsessive eye for user experience, love diving deep to solve complex problems, and are eager to work at the intersection of AI, design, and product — this role is for you.

How we work.

  • Design in Agile sprints — learn how design aligns with engineering sprints to deliver features continuously
  • AI-assisted development — use LLMs and design-to-code tools to translate your Figma UI components into clean front-end assets
  • Collaborative handoff — work side-by-side with engineers to hand over code assets and learn real-world developer workflows using Git/GitHub

Key Responsibilities.

  • Design & spec ownership — write lean PRDs, map user journeys, and create high-fidelity UI/UX layouts in Figma for our product ecosystem
  • AI-powered prototyping — leverage AI coding assistants to convert your Figma designs into responsive layout assets
  • Collaborative handoff — work with engineering to commit code assets and open Pull Requests (PRs) on GitHub directly linked to tasks
  • Obsess over polish — review live builds, run QA checks, and work with the team to eliminate design debt so our products feel premium
  • Active scrum participation — join backlog grooming sessions to present mockups and discuss technical constraints

Requirements.

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, Visual Communication, or a related field
  • High intellectual curiosity — a natural self-starter who loves exploring new tools and digging under the hood of how things work (user behavior, AI prompting, or code)
  • Problem obsession — you fall in love with the user's problem, not just your first design; you want to understand the why before drawing a single line
  • Hyper-learning mindset — a proven ability to learn new tools, technologies, and workflows rapidly, and comfort using AI tools to tackle technical tasks
  • Figma proficiency — solid understanding of Figma structure (components, Auto Layout, variants, and responsive layout principles)
  • Technical curiosity — basic understanding of HTML/CSS and a zero-fear attitude toward learning Git, GitHub, and frontend frameworks
  • Autonomy & speed — ability to navigate ambiguity, ask questions early, and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment
  • Communication — clear, structured communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia

Nice to have.

  • Experience building or designing for Shopify, WhatsApp APIs, or conversational UI/chatbots
  • Prior experience prompting LLMs (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) for web development or UI layouts
  • A portfolio showing a project you took all the way from research/PRD to a high-fidelity prototype

What you'll learn & gain.

  • AI-native design skills — master the workflow of pairing AI agents with design tools to design and iterate at speed
  • End-to-end product ownership — hands-on experience in both Product Management (writing specs, alignment) and Product Design
  • Real-world impact — your designs and front-end assets ship to staging and production, serving 1,000+ merchants globally

Key skills.

  • Figma
  • UI/UX Design
  • Prototyping
  • AI-Assisted Design
  • PRD Writing
  • Design Systems
  • Git/GitHub

name: Human Centered Design Engineer
description_html:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Engineer to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods
Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting
 A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics
  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas
 Job Details
  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

name: AI Image Designer
description_html:
Own AI image generation for a $1Billion+ brand. Produce hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery that meets brand standard consistently, at production volume.


Total Annual Package: Up to USD $88,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)


Location: Remote (Global)


Growth path from here is Senior AI Image Specialist → AI Creative Lead. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.


We've been AI-first since December 2023: GPT Image and Nano Banana Pro are part of the working creative stack, and AI-generated imagery is used in live production work rather than kept to internal tests. You'd be building on a foundation, not evangelising one.


This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).


Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring an AI Image Specialist to own AI image generation for Puffy.com, covering photorealistic hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery across ecommerce and marketing, owning the prompting approaches, reference workflows and production standards behind it, and applying UI/UX design to the layouts that imagery lands in, reporting directly to the UX/UI Design Lead.


This role exists to make AI generation dependable enough to be the production route, building the prompting approaches, reference libraries and quality standards that produce brand-standard imagery at volume, to a predictable result.


The Problems You'll Own:

  • Primary: Consistency at brand standard: Producing one strong AI image is straightforward; producing them consistently is not. You'll be responsible for hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery that meets brand standard every time, with an actual Puffy mattress rendered accurately inside a fully generated environment. Every image is judged on whether it delivers the brief's objective, not on how it looks alone. The work is making AI dependable enough to be the production route.
  • Secondary: Raise what the whole team can produce: The second outcome of this role is what the wider Design team can do. You'll develop the best practices, prompting techniques, reusable reference workflows and quality standards that let existing designers produce to a comparable standard, raising the whole team's output alongside your own.


The Career Accelerator

This is not a role where you run prompts written by someone else and hand the output on. The scope is scarce: very few AI image specialists own the prompting approaches, the reference workflows, the production standards, and the adoption of all three across the design team at once, with a direct line to the UX/UI Design Lead and no layers in between.


Your first 12 months: build the AI-assisted workflows behind Puffy product, hero and lifestyle imagery, with photorealism and product accuracy as the bar. Develop reusable prompting approaches, reference-image workflows, and the production standards that keep output consistent at brand standard. Create and test AI advertising creative with the Growth team, and take outputs through compositing and retouching to final creative. Apply UI/UX design to ecommerce page layouts and image placement with Design and CRO, strengthening visual hierarchy and mobile usability. Evaluate new image-generation tools and models, and adopt what earns it. Shape the future of creative production at Puffy, where imagery carries the product on every commercial surface.


What Is In It For You

This isn't just another AI design role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.


Own the Production Standard, Not Only the Output

You set the prompting approaches, build the reference workflows, and decide when an image is ready to ship.

  • You determine how Puffy product, hero and lifestyle imagery is produced: the prompting techniques, the reference-image workflows, the compositional control, and the retouching route to final creative.
  • You hold the standard an image is measured against, on the objective in the brief, on brand consistency, and on how it performs in the live layout. You report to the UX/UI Design Lead, who sets creative direction and holds that bar with you.


Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1Billion USD in Sales

🌍 Great Place to Work Certified

💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.

Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand


Embrace Radical Flexibility

Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office or a co-working space. Your output is your credential, not your location.


Become the Specialist Whose AI Work Reaches Production

In most companies, AI imagery stays a proof of concept: shown internally, rarely trusted on a live site. Here, your output publishes to a $1Billion+ ecommerce site and into paid creative carrying real budget. When a page needs a hero image or a campaign needs creative, your work is what ships. You'll build the systematic control to reproduce a winning output on demand, and the commercial judgment to make an image serve its objective. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a stock library and a retouching backlog in front of you.


What You'll Need

Exceptional portfolio demonstrating commercial AI-generated imagery, particularly photorealistic product and lifestyle work, alongside UI/UX design examples showing effective page layouts and user experiences.


AI generation and editing

  • Advanced hands-on proficiency with ChatGPT Images / GPT Image models for image generation, editing, iteration and creative development.
  • Advanced hands-on proficiency with Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) for professional image generation and editing.
  • Strong proficiency across the wider generative-image landscape: Midjourney, FLUX/Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI, Adobe Firefly or equivalent platforms.
  • Advanced prompt engineering and visual prompting, including reference images and multimodal inputs, together with strong image-to-image, inpainting, outpainting, compositional-control and iterative-editing workflows.


Craft and production

  • Places an existing physical product into generated environments without losing product fidelity.
  • Works systematically enough to reproduce a winning output on demand, rather than regenerating until something lands.
  • Advanced Photoshop, compositing and retouching capability to take AI outputs through to production-ready final creative.
  • Fundamentals: composition, lighting, perspective, color, visual hierarchy, art direction.


UI/UX design

  • Hands-on UI/UX design experience, with judgement for how an image performs inside a live interface rather than as a standalone render.
  • Working knowledge of how imagery behaves in layout: crop and focal point across breakpoints, legibility of type and calls to action placed over it, and how an asset holds at thumbnail and ad-placement sizes.
  • Comfortable working inside an established design system and brand guidelines, and delivering finished assets in the formats the Design team and developers build from.
  • Commercial output
  • Delivers hero, lifestyle, ecommerce and paid creative to a brief with a stated marketing objective, not just attractive images.
  • Reads a creative brief commercially and makes the calls that serve the objective.


Good-to-Have

  • DTC / ecommerce experience — especially creating product and performance-marketing imagery for consumer brands.
  • Photography, CGI or 3D experience — strong understanding of lighting, composition, materials and photorealistic product visualization.
  • Experience building and sharing AI creative workflows — including reusable prompts, reference libraries, templates or training that helps other designers adopt AI more effectively.


The Puffy DNA:

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

  • Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
  • Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
  • Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
  • Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
  • Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

name: Jr UX Writer
description_html:
We're seeking a talented Junior UX Writer to join Kredivo! As a Junior UX Writer, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the user experience of our products. You'll collaborate closely with designers, researchers, product managers, and engineers to craft clear, concise, and compelling user interface text. You'll use your knack for understanding user needs and simplifying complex ideas to create a delightful user experience.

About the job:

  • User Experience Writing: Write clear, concise, and engaging user interface text, including microcopy, tooltips, error messages, and in-app messaging
  • Design Thinking: Apply design thinking methodologies to solve complex UX problems
  • Content Strategy: Implement an evolving content strategy that aligns with our product goals and user needs
  • Brand Voice and Tone: Ensure consistent brand voice and tone usage across all user-facing content
  • Copy Research: Work with UX researchers to track copy performance and inform content decisions to improve user experience
  • Collaboration: Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to understand user needs and product requirements

About you:

  • Writing portfolio showcasing your skill as a UX Writer, Content Designer, and/or other similar roles
  • Strong understanding of UX principles and best practices
  • Excellent technical writing and editing skills
  • Ability to translate complex information into simple, engaging language
  • Obsessive attention-to-detail
  • Proficiency in UX tools (e.g., Figma, Ditto, etc.) is a plus
  • Experience with UX design and/or UX research is a plus
  • A passion for crafting exceptional user experiences

If you're passionate about creating intuitive and user-friendly products, we encourage you to apply.

name: Graphic designer - Remote
description_html:
Creative & Design Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote, Worldwide

Schedule: Flexible

Role Overview

micro1 is engaging Creative & Design Specialists to support a customer project focused on graphic design, multimedia production, UI/UX, motion graphics, and creative workflows.

You'll use your professional design expertise to evaluate and improve AI-generated creative outputs and contribute high-quality human feedback for AI training. Prior paid experience in human-data work for AI models is required. Experience only using AI tools to create content does not meet this requirement.

Scope of Work

  • Complete structured creative tasks using tools such as Figma, Canva, Adobe After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CorelDRAW, CLO3D, Camtasia, Adobe Lightroom, Mural, Milanote, and Behance.
  • Evaluate AI-generated designs, images, videos, and multimedia outputs for quality, usability, accuracy, and realism.
  • Review creative outputs against professional design standards and established project criteria.
  • Provide detailed annotations, ratings, and constructive feedback on AI-generated content.
  • Document observations and recommend improvements to creative workflows and tool usage.
  • Assess elements such as composition, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, motion, editing, and overall user experience.
  • Follow project guidelines and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.

  • Motion Graphics

  • Figma
  • Canva

  • Camtasia
  • Adobe Lightroom
  • Mural / Milanote
  • AI Training / Human Data Evaluation
  • Attention to Detail

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills (B2 level or above).
  • No formal degree required; practical creative experience is valued.
  • Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and readiness to begin promptly.

description_html:
Who We Are

Feazer (www.feazer.com) is an on-demand design services studio, providing businesses with high-quality creative solutions. We support various business on their digital, print, branding, presentation, illustration, web design, and motion design assets.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Senior Creative Designer to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to hands-on to creative projects, mentor junior designers, and drive innovation in design workflows.

What You Will Do:

  • Manage and execute a variety of design assignments (Digital, Print, Presentation, Branding, and Web UI is a plus)
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering a culture of creativity and skill growth.
  • Collaborate with the team to develop effective design solutions across multiple industries.
  • Integrate AI tools into design workflows, enhancing efficiency and creative output.
  • Conduct training sessions and skill development initiatives for the design team.
  • Ensure all designs meet industry standards, brand guidelines, and project-specific requirements.


Experience & Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience (more than 5 years) in graphic design, branding, or art direction, with a proven ability to execute high-level creative projects.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating creative excellence across multiple platforms.
  • Experience mentoring and guiding junior designers, with a passion for developing creative talent.
  • Bachelors degree in Graphic Design or equivalent experience in a related field.


Required Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and AI-powered design tools, leveraging technology for efficiency and innovation.
  • Deep understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, and branding, with the ability to create compelling layouts and design systems.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple creative projects while maintaining quality and consistency.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, ensuring clear collaboration with internal teams and clients.
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced environment, able to handle feedback and evolving project priorities with a positive mindset.
  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken).


Benefits:

  • International Exposure: Work with global clients across various industries.
  • Skill Development: Expand your expertise across different design disciplines.

Preferred Start Date: As soon as possible

Join us and be part of a fast-growing company shaping the future of design! Learn more about Feazer at www.feazer.com

name: UX Writer – Product
description_html:
About The Team

As a UX Writer at Shopee Indonesia, you will play a vital role in creating user-focused, concise, and engaging content that enhances the overall user experience across our digital platforms. Using your writing sense and technical capabilities, you will work closely with the product, operations and business team to further improve on the functionality and digital experiences for our products

Job Description

  • Own and manage the creation of intuitive, clear microcopy to guide users seamlessly through the Shopee application.
  • Maintain and continuously improve comprehensive content guidelines and localized best practices to ensure consistency across all user touchpoints.
  • Deliver user-centric wording solutions that successfully balance immediate user needs with overarching business goals.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional partners, including product managers, designers, and regional stakeholders, to develop aligned content strategies.
  • Communicate complex, interactive product concepts clearly and persuasively to ensure alignment among various business and functional stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Hold a minimum Bachelor's degree in Communication, Linguistics, or a related field relevant to the applied role.
  • Has a minimum of 1 year of prior working experience in a UX writing role with a strong portfolio showing interactive copywriting examples.
  • Solid understanding of UX writing principles and proven capability working within design systems, wireframes, and design tools.
  • Native or professional fluency in English with exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills and a keen eye for detail.
  • Experience writing for highly active B2C mobile applications, preferably in the e-commerce, fintech, or digital services sector.

name: Esport Graphic Designer
description_html:
As an Esports Graphic Designer, you will create high-impact visual assets across esports promotions, broadcasts, and branding. You will collaborate with the Esports team to bring creative ideas to life, combining strong design skills with passion, creativity, and a drive to create memorable experiences for the gaming community.

Job Description

  • Manage multiple creative requests from the Creative and Content teams, translating ideas into high-quality designs with a strong esports aesthetic and delivering them within timelines.
  • Collaborate with esports broadcast teams to create engaging broadcast assets; motion design skills are a plus.
  • Communicate and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders throughout the creative workflow.
  • Develop and present brand guidelines for various esports events to ensure consistent visual identity.
  • Contribute to the ideation and development of creative concepts across esports initiatives.
  • Support other creative projects and team initiatives as needed, based on business priorities and project requirements.

Job Requirements

  • 1–2 years of relevant experience in Multimedia, Film, Broadcasting, Graphic Design, or a related creative industry.
  • Proficient in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite or other relevant design tools; familiarity in motion graphic design tools such as Adobe After Effect and Premiere Pro, 3D design, and illustration design is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of design styles and trends, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong typography skills, including layout and kerning, with the ability to thoughtfully integrate typography as a key visual element rather than simply adding text.
  • Reliable and well-organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects effectively, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality creative work within agreed timelines

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive and team-oriented mindset.

name: プロダクトデザインマネージャー候補｜東京
description_html:
飲食の未来を、テクノロジーで切り拓く。

友人と語り合った居酒屋の夜。家族で囲んだ食卓。初めてのデートで緊張しながら入ったレストラン。

「食べる」という体験には、いつも人生の大切な瞬間が寄り添っています。

日本の外食産業は25兆円規模。ミシュラン星付きレストランの数は世界一。

しかしその裏側では、高い倒産率、深刻な人手不足、薄い利益率——構造的な課題が山積しています。

「好きなことを仕事にしたのに、続けられない」。そんな声が溢れるこの業界を、私たちは変えたい。

All in One Restaurant Cloud.

ダイニーは「All in One Restaurant Cloud.」として、POSレジ・モバイルオーダー・CRM・シフト/勤怠管理・決済まで、飲食店経営に必要な機能をワンストップで提供しています。

「儲かるお店をつくる」 — 売上データの一元管理とCRMで、利益を最大化。

「働く人のやりがいを高める」 — 従業員の貢献度を可視化し、離職率を低減。

「金融アクセスを向上させる」 — 決済・与信で飲食店のキャッシュフローを改善。

解約率は0.5%未満。一度使ったお店が手放さないプロダクトで、急成長を実現しています。

AIエージェントで、経営そのものを自動化する。

2026年7月、ダイニーはAIエージェント事業を本格始動しました。

売上照合・日次PL・請求書管理・不正操作検知など、飲食企業のバックオフィスに残る人手依存の業務を、AIエージェントが自動化する新プロダクト群です。

POS・モバイルオーダーで蓄積したデータと、数多くの飲食企業との接点を持つダイニーだからこそ、実際の顧客課題を起点にAIを社会実装できる。

「All in One Restaurant Cloud」の先へ——AIエージェントとともに、飲食業の真のインフラを目指します。

現場に立つ。1次情報を、自分の目で。

ダイニーには「シフトイン」という文化があります。

プロダクトチームが実際に飲食店のシフトに入り、厨房やホールに立つ。オーダーを受け、料理を運び、お客様の表情を見る。

会議室では見えない現場のリアルを、自分の体で理解する。

この「1次情報を自分の足で取りに行く」顧客志向の徹底が、ダイニーの競争力の源泉です。

AI Native — 自分たち自身も、テクノロジーで進化する。

ダイニーは全社員がAIを日常業務に実装する「AI Nativeカンパニー」です。

毎週AI勉強会を開催し、エンジニアだけでなくHR・CS・セールス、全員がAIを使いこなします。

あらゆるプロセスにAIが組み込まれ、少数精鋭で圧倒的な生産性を実現。

飲食業界をテクノロジーで変えると言いながら、自分たちの働き方が旧態依然では説得力がない。

だから私たちは、自らが最も先進的な働き方を実践します。

Mission・Vision・Values

Mission：「"飲食"をもっと楽しくおもしろく。」

Vision：「全ての人の"飲食"インフラになる。」

"飲食"は、人々が心を通わすために欠かせないもの。

外食産業はGDPの5%を占める経済の屋台骨であり、世界に誇る日本の象徴的な文化です。

私たちはテクノロジーを活用し、この尊い産業を支え、よりやりがいがあり、おもしろいものに発展させていきます。

真心をこめる — 関わるすべての人に、真剣に尽くす心で。

事に向き合う — 固定観念にとらわれず、本質を見極めて。

魂を燃やす — 圧倒的な情熱と貪欲さで、物事に取り組む。

メガベンチャー、コンサルファーム、飲食業界出身者——多様なバックグラウンドを持つ125名が、東京・大阪・札幌・名古屋の4拠点で活躍中。

経営ボードミーティングは全て英語。日本発、世界で戦えるエクセレントカンパニーを目指しています。

参考資料

■ ダイニー採用情報

https://www.notion.so/diniinote/4f1f4687b47a48ee9de7abbe5a1f3814

■ カルチャーデック

https://speakerdeck.com/diniiofficial/dinii-company-deck-ver-dot-1-0-2024

■ ダイニーの道のりと今後のビジョンについて（PIVOT登壇）

https://t.co/5tjKbEClU5

■ ダイニー社員食堂（note記事）

https://note.com/dinii/m/m82d04c587a4c

募集背景

ダイニーは、「すべての人の“飲食”のインフラになる」というVisionのもと、BtoB、BtoC、そしてBtoE（Employee）までを対象に、注文・決済・POS・CRM・勤怠など、店舗運営に必要な機能をまとめたAll-in-One SaaS型のプロダクトで、飲食業界全体の構造課題に向き合っています。

ダイニーが挑戦しているのは、年間25兆円規模の外食産業。

その産業を支える事業者・スタッフ・顧客すべてが日々使う“インフラ”をつくることを目指しています。

現在、複数の新規プロダクトやブランディング案件が同時並行で進行中で、FinTechやデータ連携、グローバル展開など次の成長ステージを見据えた構想も動き出しています。まさに、「事業を伸ばすデザイン」が求められるフェーズです。

このポジションでは、単なるUIデザインにとどまらず、「何をつくるか」「なぜそれをつくるか」という上流の問いから関わり、事業・プロダクト・顧客への提供価値を横断して体験価値を設計していきます。

BtoBの構造的な課題の解決、BtoCの直感的でわかりやすく楽しい体験、BtoEの現場感をプロダクトに反映し、価値ある体験をユーザーに届けることで、事業成長につなげられるポジションです。

私たちは、そんな体験づくりをリードいただけるデザイナーを募集しています。

業務内容

プロダクトデザインチームのマネジメントと、プロダクトの上流設計から体験の具現化まで、組織とプロダクトの中核に関わっていただきます。

マネジメント業務

  • プロダクトデザイナーの採用、育成、評価、キャリア支援
  • デザイン組織の体制設計、チームビルディング
  • メンバーの目標設定、1on1を通じた成長支援
  • デザイン組織の生産性向上のための仕組みづくり（DesignOps）
  • 組織横断でのデザインカルチャー浸透、インナーブランディング

プロダクトデザイン業務

  • ユーザー課題、提供価値を踏まえた情報設計、UI設計、プロトタイピングのリード
  • ユーザー体験を起点としたプロダクトデザイン方針
  • 戦略の策定 ・新機能、新プロダクトの構想フェーズにおけるUX設計、検証
  • デザインシステムの設計、運用、組織への浸透
  • ユーザーリサーチ設計、ユーザー行動の分析に基づく改善提案
  • ブランドや言語設計を含むプロダクト全体の体験設計
  • PdM、エンジニア、Bizチームとの共創による開発プロセスの推進・改善

必須経験・スキル

  • 複数名のプロダクトデザイナーのマネジメント経験（採用、育成、評価等）
  • BtoBプロダクトや業務システムのUX設計経験
  • Webまたはアプリケーション領域でのUI/UXデザイン実務経験（7年以上目安）
  • ユーザーのメンタルモデルを元にした情報設計/ナビゲーション設計
  • 顧客課題を理解した上での体験設計
  • UX要件の定義〜検証を一貫してリードした経験
  • Figma等を用いた設計〜プロトタイピング、およびデザインポリシーの運用経験
  • PdM、エンジニア、ビジネスメンバーと連携したプロダクト開発経験
  • チームやプロジェクトのリーダーシップ経験

歓迎経験・スキル

  • デザイン組織の立ち上げ、体制設計の経験
  • 採用ブランディング、組織カルチャー形成の経験
  • デザインシステム、ガイドライン、ポリシーの策定〜運用
  • DesignOps、デザインプロセスの標準化・仕組み化の経験
  • UXリサーチ、インタビュー設計、ユーザビリティテストのリード経験
  • 新規事業、0→1フェーズでのUX構想・体験設計の経験
  • BtoB SaaSにおけるプロダクトデザインのリード経験
  • ブランドやメッセージングを含むトータルな体験設計経験
  • 定量、定性データを用いたデザインの意思決定経験、SQLやBIツールを用いた検証
  • グローバル展開、アクセシビリティ対応など、多様なユーザーを意識したデザイン経験

デザイナーチーム参考資料

name: Product Management Intern
description_html:
Laku6 is the leading AI-first end-to-end electronics recommerce platform in Indonesia where our technology has helped over 500,000 users sell their gadgets directly for cash or via Trade-In with leading eCommerce Partners. Laku6 is part of Carousell Group, the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India).

Laku6 is the leading AI-first end-to-end Electronics Recommerce platform in Indonesia where our technology has helped over 500,000 users sell their gadgets directly for cash or via Trade-In with leading eCommerce Partners and in over 1,000 offline retail shops. We believe that making it easier for sellers to sell and safer for buyers to buy used-electronics and smartphones is a critical step to achieving that.

Visit www.laku6.com for more information.



Job Description

  • Requirements Gathering{{:}} Support the product team in collaborating with stakeholders, including users, internal teams, and external partners, to collect feedback and translate them into clear product requirements — with guidance on objectives, execution details, and acceptance criteria.

  • Operational and Administrative Support{{:}} Assist in handling inquiries from stakeholders, such as product operations and customer support teams. Help identify simple issues and opportunities for improvement in internal processes to expedite problem-handling based on findings.

  • Product Development{{:}} Support the PM team in driving the development sprint. Work closely with engineering and design to follow up on task progress throughout the product development lifecycle. Help prepare user stories, test cases, and release notes while ensuring smooth and timely delivery of features.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration{{:}} Work with various teams, including operations, marketing, engineering, and customer support, to support product launches, gather feedback, and help track any issues or challenges that arise.

  • User Experience{{:}} Assist in conducting usability tests, gathering user feedback, and compiling insights to contribute to improving platform usability and overall customer satisfaction.

  • Analysis and Insights{{:}} Help monitor key product metrics, perform basic data analysis, and prepare reports to support product decision-making. Assist in evaluating user behavior, experiments, and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Roadmap Support{{:}} Assist product managers in organizing and maintaining the product roadmap. Help document feature ideas, enhancements, and user feedback to support prioritization and planning activities.

  • Competitive Analysis{{:}} Conduct basic research on industry trends and competitor products. Summarize findings and identify potential areas of differentiation or improvement for the platform.



Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong interest in product management, technology, e-commerce, or user experience.

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills; familiarity with spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel).

  • Good communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken.

  • Curious, self-driven, proactive, and willing to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.

  • Basic understanding of product workflows (requirements, wireframes, QA) is a plus.

  • Experience with Figma, diagramming tools, or prototyping tools is a plus but not required.

  • Passion for the re-commerce and e-commerce industry is a strong advantage.



Additional Information

By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

description_html:
About FireRock

FireRock Holdings Limited (SEHK: 01909) is a listed gaming and interactive entertainment company headquartered in Singapore with a global footprint across Asia, Europe, Southeast Asia, and beyond. We develop, publish, and operate web and mobile games that reach millions of players worldwide, and we’re actively expanding in emerging markets with localized content and cutting-edge experiences.


At FireRock, innovation isn’t a buzzword—it’s how we build games that players love and communities that thrive. Our Singapore, Indonesia, and SEA teams are at the heart of this growth, bringing creative ideas to life and shaping the future of play in the region.


About the Role

As a Game Designer (LiveOps Specialist), you will own the planning and execution of live events, promotions, player engagement initiatives, and monetization activities across our game portfolio. This role combines Product Management, Game Design, Analytics, and Monetization to create meaningful experiences for players while achieving business goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute LiveOps strategies, event calendars, seasonal campaigns, and promotional activities.
  • Design and optimize in-game events, rewards, progression systems, and engagement mechanics.
  • Manage monetization initiatives including virtual item pricing, bundles, limited-time offers, and sales campaigns.
  • Analyze player behavior, game economy performance, retention, and revenue metrics to identify growth opportunities.

  • Monitor key KPIs including DAU, MAU, Retention (D1/D7/D30), ARPDAU, Conversion Rate, and Revenue.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the gaming industry.
  • Mandatory experience working for a game studio, game publisher, or live-service gaming company.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Game Designer, LiveOps, Product Management, Monetization, Game Economy, Product Analytics, or related fields.
  • Proven experience managing LiveOps for Free-to-Play (F2P) games.
  • Strong understanding of player retention, engagement, monetization, and virtual economies.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing, player segmentation, and data-driven decision making.
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and analytics platforms such as Firebase, Google Analytics, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar BI tools.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced live-service gaming environment.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing LiveOps for mobile games with large active player bases.
  • Experience with SQL and data querying tools.
  • Background in Product Management, Game Design, Economy Design, or Monetization.
  • Experience launching battle passes, seasonal events, and limited-time content.
  • Knowledge of Southeast Asian gaming markets.


What Success Looks Like

  • Improved player retention (D1, D7, D30)
  • Growth in DAU and player engagement
  • Increased event participation rates
  • Strong monetization performance and ARPDAU growth
  • Positive player experience and successful LiveOps execution

name: Senior Security Engineer (AppSec / DevSecOps)
description_html:
Responsibilities

  • Build and run Jubelio's security function as the first dedicated Security Engineer, reporting to the VP of Technology.
  • Perform threat modelling across applications, infrastructure, repositories and third-party integrations, and turn the results into a prioritised list of what to patch first.
  • Own security risk scoring and the risk register, so that severity reflects real business impact.
  • Triage and validate findings from vulnerability scanners, SIEM alerts, code scanning and external reports, and escalate only what matters.
  • Analyze monthly security reports and turn them into clear decisions and actions for engineering and management.
  • Handle security incidents end to end: detection, containment, investigation and post-incident improvements.
  • Review code and architecture for security risks, and work with developers to fix them.
  • Define security standards and frameworks (secure development, secrets, access, vulnerability management) that engineers can follow.
  • Decide which areas need penetration testing, scope the work with external vendors, challenge their reports and verify the fixes.
  • Work with GRC so that security controls and evidence meet compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and development squads, who own remediation under our agreed SLA.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in security engineering, AppSec, DevSecOps or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience in threat modelling (STRIDE, attack trees or similar) on real systems.
  • Able to read code and review pull requests for security issues in at least one of: Go, NodeJS, or TypeScript.
  • Experience with cloud and container security, preferably Kubernetes (RBAC, network policy, secrets management).
  • Experience handling real security incidents and writing post-incident reviews.
  • Experience with vulnerability management and security monitoring, including SIEM, vulnerability scanners and SAST/SCA tools.
  • Strong risk judgment: able to prioritise by real exploitability and business impact, not only CVSS scores.
  • Experience scoping and managing penetration tests with external vendors is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST Cybersecurity) is an advantage.
  • Good communicator who can influence engineers without formal authority. Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
  • Comfortable building from zero, with a strong sense of ownership. You will be the only security engineer at first.
  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, CKS or CISSP are a plus, but demonstrated experience matters more.
