name: Technology Manager (ERP)
description_html:
Responsibilities

About The Role:

At Tentang Anak, we move super fast because we work for the needs of 80 million Indonesian children & families that can’t wait. We seek people who are hungry to solve the problem, accountable & bring speed in everything they do.

As we scale our FMCG retail operations, we need a Technical Leader who can ensure our business systems run reliably while supporting our digital and physical products.

What You'll Own

Business Systems & ERP Operations

  • Lead technical integration, customization, and daily operations of Oracle NetSuite ERP
  • Ensure smooth data flow between sales channels (e-commerce, B2B, marketplaces) and NetSuite
  • Build and maintain internal operational tools: dashboards, reports, workflow automation for Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations teams
  • Provide Tier-2/3 technical support for business-critical systems: troubleshoot ERP issues, data sync failures, integration problems
  • Support multi-warehouse operations, inventory management, batch tracking, and 3PL integrations
  • Collaborate daily with Business Intelligence, Product Manager, Finance, Ops, and Supply Chain teams to understand and solve their technical pain points

Security, Compliance & Vendor Management

  • Lead data governance, ensuring compliance with audit requirements
  • Conduct vendor security assessments before API/system integration
  • Prepare technical documentation for external audits and ensure all compliance requirements are met

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead and mentor 2-4 engineers (backend, frontend, or full-stack) with a focus on business systems work
  • Translate technical issues into business language
  • Work cross-functionally with non-technical teams: Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Commerce
  • Help engineers understand business context and FMCG operations, not just code
  • Foster a culture where operational work (ERP, internal tools, support) is valued equally with product features

Day-to-Day Operations

  • Monitor all transactional data integrations and resolve issues before they impact business operations
  • Maintain documentation for all business systems and integrations

What Success Looks Like (6-12 Months)

Business Operations

ERP data integration runs smoothly with a <1% integration error rate
  • Sales data from all channels is reconciled in NetSuite consistently within 24-48 hours
  • Zero critical business disruptions due to ERP or integration failures

    • Security & Risk Management

    • Security baseline established with documented current state and improvement roadmap
    • The company is prepared for future audit requirements with organized documentation and processes

    Stakeholder Relations

    • Finance, Ops, and Supply Chain teams trust engineering as a reliable partner

    Team Development

    • Engineers understand FMCG business flows and can troubleshoot common ERP issues independently
    • The team handles operational support rotation without constant escalation to you

    Requirements

    You're a Fit If You...

    Business Systems Experience (Critical - Non-Negotiable)

    • 2+ years hands-on experience with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred; SAP, Oracle, Oddo acceptable)
    • Deep understanding of FMCG/retail business processes: inventory, fulfillment, invoicing, reconciliation
    • Experience integrating sales channels (e-commerce platforms, POS systems, marketplaces) with ERP
    • Comfortable with data reconciliation, debugging data sync issues, and working with Finance/Ops teams
    • Track record building internal operational tools (dashboards, reports, workflow automation)
    • Experience with SuiteScript or willingness to learn NetSuite customization

    Technical Foundation

    • 3+ years of software development experience (backend, full-stack, or business systems)
    • Proficient in at least one backend language: Go or Node.js
    • Strong SQL skills and database management experience
    • Understanding of API integrations, data pipelines, and ETL processes
    • Familiar with basic cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows
    • Not required to be an expert in cutting-edge tech stack. We value reliability over innovation here

    Stakeholder Communication

    • Proven ability to explain technical problems to non-technical executives
    • Experience working directly with Finance, Supply Chain, or Operations teams
    • Patient and clear when handling support requests from business users

    Operational Mindset

    • Comfortable with "boring" operational work: ERP troubleshooting, data fixes, help desk escalations, monitoring dashboards
    • View business systems stability as more important than shipping new features
    • Systematic approach to debugging: logs, data tracing, root cause analysis
    • Understanding that making Finance's job easier is a real engineering impact

    Leadership & Soft Skills

    • Have mentored or led 2-4 engineers in a team setting
    • Can guide engineers who may be more interested in app development also to value business systems work
    • Humble, service-oriented mindset toward internal business teams

    Nice to Have

    • Knowledge of WMS (Warehouse Management Systems) or 3PL integrations
    • Experience with batch tracking, expiry management, and multi-SKU operations

    What This Role Actually Is

    Be honest with yourself before applying:

    You'll Thrive Here If You

    • Prefer stability over innovation - our business systems need to work 99.9% of the time
    • Value business impact over technical prestige - making Finance close books faster is a win
    • Don't mind support work - helping users is part of the job, not beneath you
    • Understand FMCG operations - you know why batch numbers and expiry dates matter

    You'll Struggle Here If You

    • Want to work on cutting-edge tech or build the next viral feature
    • Find ERP work "boring" or beneath your skills
    • Need constant new technical challenges to stay motivated
    • Prefer minimal interaction with business stakeholders

    How We Work

    • Product Engineering Mindset: Every engineer understands the user and the business
    • Ownership and Clarity: We take responsibility for outcomes and communicate clearly
    • Collaboration: We work as one team, across engineering, product, design, and business
    • Continuous Improvement: We learn from failures, share feedback, and get better together
    • Business-first mindset - engineering serves the business, not the other way around
    • Pragmatic over perfect - we value solutions that work over elegant architecture
    • Operational excellence - uptime and reliability matter more than innovation

    Seniority & Scope

    • Technical Lead position reporting to the Engineering Manager - you'll lead the business systems function while staying hands-on
    • Manage and develop 2-4 engineers focused on business systems, internal tools, and operational support
    • Build business systems engineering practice - establish standards, processes, and team culture from the ground up
    • Work closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Manager, C-Level, Business Intelligence, Finance, and Supply Chain as the technical owner of business operations systems
    • Balance hands-on technical work (40%) with team leadership, coordination, and planning (60%)
    • Own the technical roadmap for all business systems and ERP integrations, with EM approval on major initiatives
    • Act as primary technical liaison between Engineering and Business Operations teams
    • Participate in technical discussions with C-level about business systems, vendor selection, and operational technology investments
    • Drive hiring and onboarding for business systems engineers in collaboration with EM
    • Expected to mentor, performance manage, and grow your team members toward senior roles
    • This is a technical leadership position with people management responsibilities. You'll be evaluated on both team outcomes and technical execution

name: D365 Solutions Architect
description_html:
Job Purpose

The D365 CoE Solution Architect Lead is responsible for the solution architecture and technical integrity of the D365 platform across CCEP. The role focuses on technology standards, architectural frameworks, and the governance of future features. By ensuring architectural discipline, validating financial estimations, and supporting strategic business planning, this role ensures the platform delivers maximum value while maintaining a sustainable Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

Main Responsibilities

  • Evaluate technical requirements regarding existing D365 solutions and identify technologies that add business value while adhering to "Standard-First" principles.
  • Ensure technical gatekeeping for all D365 enhancements by reviewing and approving solution design documents. Ensure solutions solve business problems through high-quality, sustainable architectural patterns.
  • Support the Annual Business Planning (ABP) cycle and the demand pipeline by providing technical roadmaps, feasibility assessments, and value realization opportunities.
  • Ensure the accuracy of technical costing and effort estimations. Challenge vendor-justified efforts to ensure project budgets are architecturally sound and optimized for resource utilization.
  • Oversee the technical lifecycle from demand qualification to deployment, ensuring that complex business requirements are translated into scalable functional and technical designs.
  • Guide implementation teams regarding architectural best practices, ensuring delivery quality meets CCEP engineering standards and SLAs.
  • Create and maintain the D365 Landscape Blueprint and Integration Map. Develop solution architecture for cloud components and their integrations.
  • Facilitate the upskilling of the CoE team by promoting a culture of continuous learning and regularly sharing technical insights and emerging D365 innovations.

Candidate Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Degree in computer science, Information Technology or equivalent degree.
  • Fluent in English (strong in business communication).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Solution Architect Expert is highly preferred.
  • Project delivery methodology certification is a plus.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in Technical/Solution Architecture within the D365 ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of ensuring internal design authority and reducing reliance on external vendor-led architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical costing, effort estimation, and budget validation within a large-scale IT environment.
  • Experience in supporting Annual Business Planning and managing the technical demand pipeline.
  • Management of technical resources of various implementation partners
  • Experience with waterfall/agile implementation methodologies
  • Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
  • Improving the governance framework

Technical and Behavioral Skills:

  • Advance understanding of D365 F&O modules and core ERP concepts.
  • Mastery of D365 F&O Architecture, Microsoft "One Version" service updates, and Lifecycle Services (LCS).
  • Advance technical aptitude in Dynamics 365 configuration, with related data and integration technologies (e.g., BYOD, Synapse Link, and supporting ecosystem tools).
  • Expert understanding of D365 integration patterns (OData, Dual-write, Logic Apps) and "Standard-First" engineering trade-offs.
  • Proficiency in the BPT toolchain, including the use of Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps.
  • Ability to work in a global team environment (virtual, onsite, offshore).

name: HR and Payroll Process Senior Expert
description_html:
Be An Essential Part Of Everyday Life

Position: HR and Payroll Process Senior Expert

Contract Type: Permanent

Location: APAC


  • This is a Global position, managed and recruited directly by the Global team, rather than by APAC Regional Office or local country team


At DHL our business is logistics, but people are our passion. With over 500,000 team members in 220 countries, we attract and retain great talent. We are one of the most innovative, most culturally diverse companies on the planet. We provide unmatched opportunities for personal and professional development. We really are a “Best Place to Work”.


  • Are you ready for a Human Resources transformation role with a strong focus on HR to Time and Payroll Process design and compliance?
  • Do you want to work for a very large global organisation, within a high-performing and supportive team?
  • Do you have experience or a strong interest in how HR data and processes flow between HR, Time and Payroll teams and systems?
  • Do you enjoy helping HR business users to turn requirements into process design decisions?
  • Do you have demonstrated experience with Senior Stakeholders?


If so, then let’s talk!

In this role, you will work with senior stakeholders and team members from across the globe supporting HR and Operational leaders within regions and countries by designing, documenting and implementing global Time and Pay processes with a strong focus on integrations to our external providers.

You will work closely with your IT colleagues in implementing these processes and integrations within and from the global HR system, as well as contributing towards the change management of this implementation through your network of stakeholders. You will continually look for opportunities to improve; utilizing skills in HR process re-engineering and business change management, ensuring we remain an essential part of everyday life.

Your key accountabilities include:


  • Provide expertise and analysis on Business Process Optimization issues regarding process design and documentation of the Time and Pay process globally
  • Interpret and test interface design to ensure robust delivery of Time and Payroll data to external vendor systems
  • Responsible for end-to-end processes, collection, assessment, documentation and standardization of existing processes
  • Identify and analyze risks, propose mitigation actions and suggest solutions for resolution of escalations
  • Perform end-to-end standardization of the Work Time and Pay processes in alignment with BPO peer group and assigned stakeholders outside the HR organization
  • Design and incorporate suggested and approved changes to the Work Time and Pay process; communicate changes to affected teams; keep all documentation regarding Work Time and Pay process up-to-date; design and implement approved changes in the local adaptions of the Target Operating Model (TOM)


What are we looking for from you?


  • Good understanding of payroll processes, design and compliance – Essential
  • Demonstrated Senior Stakeholder Management - Essential
  • Strong excel skills support data validation – Essential
  • Experience of Time & Pay processes within HR systems, such as Oracle Cloud, Workday, SAP – Essential
  • Very good business English - Essential
  • Experience in the design and implementation of payroll or time interfaces (not coding) – Preferred


What you'll need to do next?

If you have a proven track record of achievement to match the requirements for this role and you are looking for your next career move, simply apply online ensuring that a full up to date CV is attached with your application.

We will ensure that all our resourcing activities are fair, transparent, and consistent across the Globe. We want to ensure that the candidate experience is of the highest professional standard.

The Company is committed to providing equality of opportunity for all employees. Furthermore, we aim to ensure our workplaces are free from discrimination and that not only employees but also our potential future employees are treated fairly and with dignity and respect. We will ensure that equality of opportunity maintains a high profile in our organisation.

name: Technical and Integration Coordinator
description_html:
This role will responsible to ensure a seamless technical transition from legacy IFS to SAP S/4HANA by coordinating the rewiring of local applications and managing the integration touchpoints between the new ERP core and existing infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Dependency Mapping: Maintain a comprehensive inventory of all satellite applications and local tools that require reconfiguration or integration with the new SAP environment to prevent data silos.
  • Integration Coordination: Facilitate technical alignment between the SAP implementation team and local app owners to ensure data flows and APIs are correctly mapped and tested.
  • Cutover Support: Assist in the development and execution of the technical "runbook" to ensure all infrastructure and connectivity tasks are completed during the migration window.
  • UAT Liaison: Manage the technical testing phases for all integrated systems, documenting bugs and tracking their resolution before the final go-live.
  • Infrastructure Tracking: Monitor the progress of firewall requests, server provisioning, and user access requirements to ensure the technical environment is ready for each migration phase.
  • Documentation Management: Update and maintain technical documentation for all "rewired" local applications to ensure post-migration supportability for the IT team.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Previous exposure to IT project envrionments, ideally involving ERP systems (such as IFS or SAP), database migrations, or complex systems integration projects.
  • Foundational knowledge of API structure, middleware concepts, and IT infrastructure (networks/firewalls).
  • Proficiency in project tracking tools and documentation software to manage integration maps and runbooks.
  • Ability to identify technical bottlenecks in application connectivity and propose logical solutions.
  • Strong ability to bridge the communication gap between technical developers, infrastructure squads, and business stakeholders.
  • Rigorous approach to managing granular technical tasks within a large-scale project timeline.
  • Available for 12-months contract employment type.
  • Willing to be placed in BSD, South Tangerang.

name: Consultant - FP&A - Financial Planning & Analysis
description_html:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

We want you to think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! Anaplan is looking for a tenacious Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is a stellar opportunity to get involved in a highly visible, large scale SaaS cloud company. This role is an immediate full-time position. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and seek unique problems that no one else is solving, keep reading. 

Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like

Insight on your impact

We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.

What you'll be doing:

As an Anaplan Consultant, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan financial planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:

  • Understand, review and gather client requirements per Anaplan defined scoping & analysis
  • Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models
  • Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
  • Serve as the architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions
  • Exemplify The Anaplan Way
  • Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Business Partner and team
  • Develop Anaplan model documentation
  • Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  • Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment

Your qualifications, your influence

To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills

  • Background in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  • 6+ years experience in Financial Planning & Analysis space - Good to have experience in any EPM tool like Anaplan, SAP BPC, Oracle EPM, etc.
  • Subject matter expertise in planning and modeling in financial planning and analysis is required
  • Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  • Customer/client facing experience in Indonesia market
  • Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  • Superb written and oral communication skills
  • Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  • Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  • Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  • Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  • Results-oriented, motivated, self-starter
  • Coaching mentality
  • Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  • Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll-up your sleeves” approach
  • Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career

Please note that you will be expected to learn and grow in using Anaplan product in a technology consulting and Customer facing capacity. 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

name: AIDCS - Senior Technical Project Manager
description_html:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Role Summary Lenovo is a global leader in AI infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC) and data centre technology. The AI Cloud and Data Center Services team delivers complex, business-critical environments that enable customers to deploy and scale accelerated computing globally. The Senior Technical Project Manager leads Lenovo’s most complex AI infrastructure and data centre projects end to end. The role owns delivery from project mobilisation and detailed planning through manufacturing, procurement, logistics, site readiness, installation, integration, commissioning, customer acceptance and transition into operations. Operating across global, multi-vendor environments, the role converts technical and contractual commitments into a controlled project plan and maintains hands-on ownership of scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety and risk. It coordinates customers, partners, manufacturing, supply-chain and technical teams, resolves critical dependencies and drives delivery to agreed milestones and outcomes.

Responsibilities

The Senior Technical Project Manager owns one or more complex, high-value projects spanning countries, delivery teams, suppliers and technology domains. The role is accountable for project execution, commercial control, governance, risk, customer satisfaction and successful handover.

Typical Activities Include

Senior Project Leadership

  • Lead complex, high-value AI infrastructure and data centre projects from mobilisation through acceptance and operational handover.
  • Build and maintain the integrated project plan, work-breakdown structure, milestones, dependencies, resources and governance cadence.
  • Coordinate technical workstreams, suppliers and delivery teams; assign clear actions, remove blockers and hold owners to committed dates.
  • Maintain project controls, including RAID logs, decisions, change requests, reporting, escalation and recovery plans.

Project Mobilization and Delivery Readiness

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions, Finance, Commercial, Procurement, Legal and Service Delivery to confirm that scope, assumptions, resources, dates and acceptance criteria are executable.
  • Lead project mobilization, delivery-readiness reviews and the sales-to-delivery handover, closing gaps before execution begins.
  • Baseline the project scope, schedule, budget, governance, stakeholder plan and delivery controls.

Executive Stakeholder Management

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer, partner and Lenovo stakeholders.
  • Present programme status, financial performance, risks, mitigations and outcomes to executive steering committees.
  • Influence timely decisions and align stakeholders across geographies and functions.

Financial and Commercial Ownership

  • Own programme budgets, forecasts, resource utilisation, revenue, margin and profitability throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Protect commercial outcomes through contractual compliance, disciplined change control and supplier performance management.
  • Drive delivery efficiency, financial accuracy and customer value.

Technical Delivery Leadership

  • Own end-to-end AI infrastructure and data centre delivery, from design and site readiness through installation, integration, commissioning, acceptance and operational handover.
  • Direct deployment of GPU clusters, racks, cabling, network, storage and software, coordinating power, cooling and facility dependencies across live, new-build, colocation and hyperscale environments.
  • Convert the solution into an integrated critical-path plan covering resources, budget, quality, safety, testing and acceptance.
  • Lead design assurance, FAT, SAT, integrated systems testing, performance validation and defect closure, maintaining control of scope, schedule, cost, risk, change and dependencies.

Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Partner Delivery

  • Own the manufacturing, partner and supply-chain plan, aligning engineering approvals, bills of material, production, long-lead items, logistics and required-on-site dates to the critical path.
  • Hold OEMs, suppliers, logistics providers, construction and colocation partners, and specialist subcontractors accountable for capacity, quality and milestones.
  • Anticipate production, component, transport, customs and site-access constraints; drive recovery, alternate sourcing or resequencing before milestones are affected.
  • Coordinate factory testing, shipment, receipt, storage and installation release so equipment arrives complete, compliant and aligned to site readiness.

Project Governance and Continuous Improvement

  • Apply consistent project governance, delivery methods, controls and reporting standards.
  • Capture lessons learned and improve project quality, predictability and customer satisfaction.
  • Support and mentor project coordinators and less-experienced project managers when required.

Required Experience

Skills and Preferred Experience

  • 10+ years managing complex, high-value technical projects, including direct accountability for mission-critical data centre or AI infrastructure delivery.
  • Proven ownership of projects from mobilisation and planning through manufacturing, installation, commissioning, acceptance and operational handover.
  • Demonstrated delivery across IT, electrical and mechanical workstreams, including high-density compute, power, cooling, network, storage and software dependencies.
  • Strong command of project schedules, critical paths, budgets, resources, quality, safety, RAID management, change control and recovery planning.
  • Proven success managing OEMs, manufacturers, suppliers, logistics providers, contractors, colocation partners and specialist subcontractors against project milestones.
  • Commercially astute, with experience controlling project financials, forecasts, contractual obligations, supplier performance and change requests.
  • Credible with senior stakeholders, with a strong record of project reporting, customer escalation, trade-off decisions and delivery recovery.

Technical Experience

  • Deep understanding of GPU-based AI infrastructure, accelerated compute, high-density rack deployments and related network, storage and software dependencies.
  • Strong knowledge of mission-critical data centre architecture and MEP systems, including electrical distribution, standby power, HVAC, liquid cooling, heat rejection, fire and life safety, BMS and EPMS.
  • Practical understanding of capacity, resilience, rack density, white-space readiness and the interfaces between facility infrastructure and IT equipment.
  • Experience leading FAT, SAT, commissioning, integrated systems testing, performance validation, defect management and operational readiness.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing lifecycles, engineering submittals, long-lead procurement, logistics, import and export requirements, and required-on-site planning.

Leadership Competencies

  • Executive presence, sound judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Clear, concise communication with strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Decisive leadership through ambiguity, competing priorities and high-pressure delivery.
  • Strong coaching capability and a record of improving organisational performance.

Certifications

  • PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification preferred.
  • Agile or hybrid delivery certification desirable.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on senior project manager who combines technical understanding, commercial discipline and strong stakeholder leadership. They create a clear delivery baseline, coordinate complex workstreams, maintain rigorous project controls and retain ownership through acceptance and transition into service.

What We Will Offer You

  • Professional and personal development opportunities.
  • An open, stimulating environment within a forward-thinking global technology company.
  • Flat structures and fast decision-making.
  • Flexible working that supports professional and personal commitments.
  • A diverse, international team.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

name: P2P Lending Project Delivery Lead – Embedded Finance [Jakarta]
description_html:
About The Role


As Senior Project Delivery Lead, you won't just manage timelines, you'll own the delivery of entire embedded finance business models for our clients across Indonesia. This means going beyond system implementation to shape how alternative credit scoring, lead generation, and embedded finance actually work inside a client's business; commercially, operationally, and technically. You'll take signed engagements from kickoff to go-live and beyond, working shoulder-to-shoulder with operational experts (both in-house and client-side) to solve real business problems as they come up. This is a role for someone entrepreneurial: comfortable owning outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, and driven to make things happen rather than waiting for direction.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in Project/Program Leadership, Delivery, or Implementation roles with background in P2P Lending or Consulting.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or related field.
  • Have experience in lending partnership implementation, particularly in coordinating with banks, financial institutions, and lending partners on process design, system integration, and go-live execution.
  • Broad working understanding of Lead Generation, Embedded Finance, and Marketing. You don't need to be a credit scoring technical expert, but you're comfortable enough with the concepts to lead a business conversation and connect the dots across teams.
  • Strong PowerPoint and presentation skills. Able to structure and articulate plans, requirements, and project status clearly to both internal teams and enterprise clients.
  • Sharp communicator and stakeholder manager, structured thinker, strong documentation skills (Excel and slides). 
  • Productive with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to move fast,  without becoming complacent or over-reliant. 
  • Professional English required; Mandarin a strong advantage. 
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and hands-on; someone who spots a problem and solves it, not someone who waits to be told.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead Embedded Finance Delivery: Take signed deals from handover to go-live, building not just project plans but workable business models: how alternative credit scoring, lead generation, and embedded finance actually function within the client's operations.
  • Solve Problems in Complex Environments: Work directly with operational experts, both internal and client-side, to navigate real-world commercial and operational complexity (not just technical delivery). 
  • Coordinate Cross-Functional Teams: Work daily with Business Development, Product & Technical, Operations, and Global Talent teams to keep delivery moving and unblock issues fast. 
  • Own the Client Relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact post-signing, running status updates, managing expectations, and building trust through delivery. 
  • Manage Scope, Risk, and Quality: Spot scope creep and risk early, manage change requests, and hold the bar on what "done well" looks like. 
  • Drive Project Governance: Maintain project plans, status reports; run steering updates with internal and client stakeholders. 
  • Stand Up Delivery Teams: Help structure and onboard the delivery team for each new engagement, working closely with BD during handover. 
  • Report on Impact: Prepare status reports, delivery metrics, and post-implementation reviews; track delivery ROI and client satisfaction. 
  • Stay Responsive: Maintain timely communication via WhatsApp, LINE, or similar, with flexibility for urgent delivery matters.


Work Arrangement: Hybrid - Central Jakarta

name: Project Manager, AI Cluster Commissioning
description_html:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the commissioning and operational readiness of large-scale AI cluster deployments. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing all commissioning activities from installation of compute, network, and storage components through cluster integration, phased bring-up, validation testing, benchmarking, acceptance testing, and transition to operations.

Working across internal engineering teams, operations, facilities, suppliers, and technology partners, the Project Manager will ensure that complex AI infrastructure systems are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with defined performance and reliability requirements.

The successful candidate will have strong experience in large scale IT/HPC/AI/hyperscale projects, with the ability to manage multiple teams, vendors, and partners, technical packages, and complex project schedules to ensure successful delivery of critical environments.

This role combines project management, stakeholder management, and technical commissioning leadership for some of the world's most advanced AI computing environments.

Key Responsibilities

AI Cluster Commissioning

  • Manage the deployment and commissioning of large-scale AI clusters including compute, network, storage systems, integration with power and cooling systems, bring-up, component and system testing, benchmarking, and acceptance testing.
  • Manage internal teams as well as vendors and partners responsible for hardware deployment, executing defined test plans, remediation work, and acceptance testing.
  • Coordinate closely with infrastructure teams to ensure readiness of power, cooling, and network connectivity prior to and during commissioning.
  • Ensure commissioning follows the defined processes and executes the planned schedule for successful and on-time delivery of the project.
  • Success in this role is measured by delivery of fully commissioned AI clusters meeting performance, reliability, schedule, safety, and operational acceptance requirements.

Vendor and Partner Management

  • Manage relationships with suppliers, contractors, partners, and internal stakeholders delivering various technical work packages.
  • Review and manage project schedules, Statements of Work (SOWs), resource plans, and deliverables.
  • Monitor vendor performance against schedule, budget, quality, safety, and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple teams and resolve dependencies, conflicts, and execution risks.
  • Ensure supplier deliverables meet project objectives, technical requirements, and operational readiness standards.

Project Planning & Controls

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for AI cluster deployment and commissioning activities.
  • Identify project risks, dependencies, and constraints and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Lead issue management, escalation processes, and recovery planning when required.
  • Monitor project progress against key milestones and coordinate corrective actions where necessary.
  • Provide regular reporting, forecasts, and status updates to senior leadership and stakeholders.
  • Support project budget tracking, forecasting, scope management, and change control processes.
  • Ensure project documentation is maintained, organized, and communicated appropriately throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of project management experience delivering large-scale IT, cloud, data center, HPC, AI, hyperscale infrastructure, or critical facilities projects.
  • Experience managing complex projects involving multiple internal teams, vendors, contractors, and technology partners.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing project schedules, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
  • Strong understanding of data center infrastructure, including compute, network, storage, power, cooling, and supporting systems.
  • Experience coordinating commissioning, testing, validation, acceptance, or operational readiness activities.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver projects in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with commissioning of data centers, critical infrastructure, or complex technology systems.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, Agile Project Management, or equivalent project management certification.

Employment Basis

Full-time

name: Technical Programme Manager
description_html:
Who We Are

Provenir is the unified Decision Intelligence Platform that gives enterprises full control over end- to-end customer decisioning — to manage risk, drive growth, and transform business outcomes. By consolidating data, AI models, intelligence, agents and governance into a single decisioning environment, Provenir empowers business teams to configure and evolve strategy directly, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability and regulatory compliance. Trusted by 120+ institutions in 60+ countries, Provenir processes over 4 billion decisions annually — turning architectural coherence into sustained risk performance and measurable value. Ready to solve meaningful challenges, work with enterprise customers, and help shape the future of AI-powered decisioning? Join us.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager based in Indonesia to drive the delivery of our active projects and act as the dedicated technical point of contact for live customers. In this dual role, you will own project execution end-to-end while serving as the client relationship anchor whenever technical issues arise — coordinating closely with our dedicated support team to ensure issues are resolved smoothly.

This is a fully remote, individual-contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, APAC — Global Applied Intelligence, and working in a matrixed relationship with Solution Architects in the team. It is suited to someone who blends strong program management discipline with hands-on technical troubleshooting in a SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Management

  • Own end-to-end project management for active projects across Indonesia, including planning, scheduling, resourcing, and budget tracking.
  • Define project scope, milestones, and deliverables; drive execution against timelines.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (engineering, product, sales, and external partners) to remove blockers and keep delivery on track.
  • Track risks, dependencies, and issues; maintain clear status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and communications throughout the project lifecycle.

Technical Client Relationship & Issue Coordination

  • Serve as the first point of contact and relationship owner for live customers when technical issues arise.
  • Troubleshoot and triage incoming issues — read and interpret logs, investigate behavior across our risk decisioning products, and assess impact and urgency.
  • Coordinate with the dedicated SLA-driven support team to drive issues to resolution, ensuring the customer stays informed and confident throughout.
  • Translate between customer, support, and engineering — providing clear technical context, reproduction steps, and business impact so issues are prioritized correctly.
  • Identify recurring or systemic issues and feed insights back into product and engineering to drive long-term fixes.
  • Maintain trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, acting as their technical advocate.

Required Qualifications

  • 4–7 years in technical program/project management, technical account management, or a related technical delivery role within a SaaS/software environment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently — comfortable reading logs, tracing issues, and reasoning about system behavior (no coding required).
  • Strong understanding of risk decisioning products (e.g., fraud, credit, identity, or transaction risk platforms) and how customers integrate and operate them.
  • Proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects to successful, on-time delivery.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable collaborating with distributed, cross-functional teams spread across different locations and time zones, building alignment without being in the same room.
  • Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English (written and spoken).
  • Self-directed and effective working fully remotely across local customer time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with or alongside dedicated customer support teams in a coordination or escalation role.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and how customers consume SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana) and ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, Freshdesk).
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent certification.

What Success Looks Like

  • Active projects delivered on time, in scope, and within budget.
  • Live customers experience a single, trusted point of contact for technical issues — with smooth coordination into the support team and fast time-to-resolution.
  • Strong feedback loop established between customers, project delivery, support, and engineering.
  • High customer trust and satisfaction across the Indonesian client base.

Our employees are our top priority; we offer comprehensive health and wellness plans. You will enjoy paid time off and company holidays, flexible and remote-friendly opportunities, and maternity/paternity leave.

At Provenir, we recognize that diversity and inclusion make our teams stronger. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, citizenship, or veteran status or medical condition. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

name: IT Application Delivery Manager
description_html:
Description

We are looking for an IT Application Delivery Manager to take ownership of how application projects and enhancements are delivered across the organization — going beyond a traditional PMO function. This role is the next level up from standard project tracking: rather than simply monitoring and reporting status, the Delivery Manager actively manages, forecasts, and course-corrects timelines to ensure delivery commitments are met. The ideal candidate combines strong PMO governance discipline with a delivery-owner mindset — someone who is accountable for outcomes, not just visibility.

  • Lead and mature the IT Application Delivery function as the next evolution of the PMO — moving from a governance/reporting office to an active delivery-management capability.
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of application projects and enhancements, from planning and resourcing through go-live and stabilization.
  • Proactively manage expected timelines, not just track progress: continuously validate whether current pace will meet committed dates, and intervene early when a project is trending off-course.
  • Build and maintain realistic delivery baselines and forecasts, using leading indicators (velocity, blockers, dependency risk) rather than relying solely on status updates.
  • Identify schedule, resource, and scope risks ahead of time, and drive mitigation actions with project teams and stakeholders — escalating early rather than reporting delays after the fact.
  • Hold project managers, vendors, and delivery teams accountable to committed timelines, applying structured follow-up and corrective action plans when milestones slip.
  • Establish and enforce delivery governance standards: project intake, prioritization, resource allocation, stage-gate reviews, and change control across the application portfolio.
  • Manage cross-project and cross-team dependencies, ensuring sequencing and resourcing decisions protect the overall portfolio timeline, not just individual projects.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and application/engineering leads to set realistic timeline commitments upfront, balancing ambition with delivery capacity.
  • Report delivery health to leadership with clear, forward-looking risk indicators — highlighting what could cause a date to move before it does, not only what has already happened.
  • Coach and develop project managers and delivery leads to shift from passive progress-tracking toward proactive timeline and risk management.
  • Continuously improve delivery methodology and tooling (Agile/hybrid delivery practices, PPM/PM tooling, reporting dashboards) to increase delivery predictability.

Requirements

  • 8–12+ years of experience in IT project/program management or application delivery, including experience leading or maturing a PMO function.
  • Demonstrated experience operating beyond a traditional tracking-and-reporting PMO — with clear ownership of delivery outcomes and timeline accountability.
  • Strong track record of proactively identifying and resolving schedule risk before it results in missed deadlines, rather than reporting delays after they occur.
  • Solid understanding of application development and delivery lifecycles (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid), including dependency and resource management across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Experience managing vendors, cross-functional teams, and business stakeholders to hold delivery commitments.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable using delivery metrics (burn-down, velocity, critical path, earned value) to forecast rather than just report status.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to escalate and negotiate timeline trade-offs with senior leadership.
  • Hands-on familiarity with PPM/project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent).
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

About Ludios

Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games.

Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in.

Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about.

If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you.

As our Project Manager, you will be the operational heartbeat of the studio. You will bridge the gap between vision and execution, managing the development lifecycle to ensure our team delivers a world-class gaming experience to millions of players worldwide.

This role sits within our dynamic Jakarta studio, where we are embarking on our biggest, most ambitious project yet: a massive live-ops mobile game developed in direct collaboration with a world-renowned, household-name IP.

name: Network Engineer
description_html:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan


  • Merancang, membangun, mengelola, dan memelihara infrastruktur jaringan.
  • Memastikan jaringan berjalan dengan baik, stabil, aman, dan memiliki performa yang optimal.
  • Melakukan troubleshooting jaringan, menganalisis penyebab masalah (Root Cause Analysis/RCA), serta menentukan solusi yang tepat.
  • Melakukan perencanaan kapasitas jaringan, optimasi, upgrade, dan migrasi jaringan.
  • Membuat dan memperbarui dokumentasi jaringan, SOP, serta standar teknis.
  • Memberikan arahan teknis dan dukungan kepada anggota tim Network Engineer yang lebih junior.
  • Melakukan pemantauan jaringan serta berpartisipasi dalam jadwal pemeliharaan dan dukungan on-call.


Kualifikasi


  • Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Teknik Informatika, Teknik Telekomunikasi, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait.
  • Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang Network Engineering, terutama di lingkungan ISP, Data Center, atau jaringan perusahaan.
  • Memahami TCP/IP, routing, switching, BGP, OSPF, VLAN, dan redundansi jaringan.
  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam troubleshooting jaringan, optimasi performa, dan analisis penyebab masalah.
  • Berpengalaman menggunakan perangkat jaringan Cisco, Juniper, MikroTik, atau Huawei.
  • Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan firewall FortiGate serta memahami keamanan jaringan, VPN, SNMP, Syslog, dan tools monitoring jaringan.
  • Memiliki pengalaman dengan L2VPN/L3VPN menjadi nilai tambah, khususnya MPLS.
  • Memahami sistem RADIUS dan Linux Server menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Memiliki pengetahuan tentang Python, Ansible, atau otomatisasi jaringan menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Memiliki sertifikasi CCNP, JNCIP, MTCINE, HCIP, atau sertifikasi setara menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Memiliki kemampuan analisis, pemecahan masalah, komunikasi, dan dokumentasi yang baik.
  • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim serta bersedia menjalani jadwal on-call dan pemeliharaan jaringan sesuai kebutuhan.

location: Kecamatan Cimahi Selatan, West Java, Indonesia
description_html:
Overview:

We are looking for a highly experienced Edge Network Engineer to lead complex edge, network, and cloud platform deployments. This role will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert during onboarding, migrations, and new platform integrations. Success in this role requires exceptional technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead both technical workstreams and customer expectations.

The Edge Network Engineer position provides customer facing network design, implementation, configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocols, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, this role also serves as a Tier 4 escalation point from the global support organization.

Experience with SD-WAN—especially Versa Networks—is a major asset and will elevate your candidacy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead customer deployments of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration, and SD-WAN platforms.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for end-to-end implementation activities, including architecture planning, configuration, testing, and go-live support.
  • Work closely with project managers, systems engineers, and customer stakeholders to align on design and timelines.
  • Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, and networks.
  • Develop automation scripts and reusable tooling to improve speed and consistency of deployments within the larger context of the company strategy.
  • Document procedures, configurations, and lessons learned; contribute to internal knowledge bases.
  • Mentor junior engineers and participate in internal enablement and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Participate in periodic customer workshops to review implementation design as needed to support large-scale or complex rollouts.

Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies; experience with lightweight Kubernetes distributions (e.g., K3s) preferred.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DNS, NAT, Routing protocols and proxies.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing network interfaces, both physical and virtual.
  • Prior experience with SD-WAN deployment and management; Versa SD-WAN experience is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iptables, netstat, and other network diagnostic utilities.
  • Experience with cloud service providers such as Azure or AWS, including VM provisioning, datastore configuration, and SSO setup.
  • Comfortable working with REST APIs and using tools like Postman, Swagger, curl, and Python scripts for automation and testing.
  • Awareness of secure deployment principles; familiarity with TPM, encryption, and measured boot is a plus (can be trained internally).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bash scripting.
  • Experience with tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM platforms for Project/Change/Incident management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document issues, escalate appropriately, and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Background:

  • 5+ years in edge infrastructure deployment, implementation engineering, or similar technical field.
  • Experience supporting or deploying edge orchestration platforms (e.g., Zededa, Azure IoT Edge, AWS Greengrass).
  • Experience with zero-touch provisioning, telemetry pipelines, or site/network architecture at the edge is a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Work at the cutting edge of network operations, edge computing/networking, and satellite systems, enabling global connectivity in the most remote and demanding scenarios.
  • Be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team that values technical depth, mentorship, and continuous learning.

description_html:
About TCS:

A purpose-led organization that is building a meaningful future through innovation, technology, and collective knowledge. We're #BuildingOnBelief.

Role Purpose

Operational ownership of the GPU cluster interconnect and data center network fabric — InfiniBand/RoCE east-west fabric plus north-south DC and management networking.


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and support the NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand (NDR/HDR) and/or RoCE v2 Ethernet fabric interconnecting GPU nodes.
  • Manage fabric topology, subnet manager and congestion control tuning via NVIDIA UFM; monitor link error counters and drive proactive remediation.
  • Support spine-leaf data centre fabric (Cisco ACI / Juniper QFX / NVIDIA Spectrum), EVPN-VXLAN overlays, routing (BGP/OSPF) and management network segmentation.
  • Own network incident, change and problem management for the GPU platform; participate in CAB and maintenance windows.
  • Perform firmware upgrades on switches and cabling/optics validation; coordinate with OEM TAC for hardware failures.
  • Implement and audit network security policy, segmentation and access controls in line with internal standards.
  • Produce fabric health, utilisation and capacity reports; recommend design improvements for cluster scale-out.


Mandatory Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree (minimum) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 7-11 years of hands-on experience in Data Center Networking, Network Infrastructure, or HPC/AI Networking environments.
  • NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand NDR/HDR, UFM, RoCE v2, congestion control and collective-communication performance tuning.
  • Data centre switching and fabric design: spine-leaf, EVPN/VXLAN, Cisco ACI, Juniper QFX/EX, NVIDIA Cumulus/NetQ.
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, MPLS; firewall policy management (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and network segmentation.
  • Packet-level troubleshooting, optics/DAC/AOC cabling standards and structured DC cabling discipline.
  • Automation exposure (Python, Ansible) for network configuration and compliance.


Preferred Certifications

NVIDIA NCP-AII / NCA-AIIO; CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or CCNP Data Center; Juniper JNCIP-DC; Palo Alto PCNSE (desirable).

name: Senior IT Infrastructure Specialist
description_html:
We are seeking a Senior IT Infrastructure Specialist Network with strong expertise in designing, implementing, and managing medium-to-large-scale network infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role: the focus is on deep network technical execution, operational reliability, and security, while also serving as a technical reference and mentor for more junior team members.

You will be responsible for ensuring network connectivity is optimal, secure, and aligned with business and compliance requirements, for both internal and external connections across multiple office sites.

About The Job

  • Design, implement, and maintain brand agnostic network infrastructure including switches, firewalls, and VPN gateways to ensure optimal connectivity and security.
  • Run daily office network operations: network device administration & configuration, monitoring, incident management, and documentation.
  • Own the technical responsibility for network components and configurations, ensuring the reliability and security of both internal and external connections.
  • Configure and optimize routing protocols, switching, wireless networking, and QoS management.
  • Collaborate with the security team to enforce network security measures (e.g., IDS/IPS, RADIUS/802.1X, network segmentation) and support audits relevant to the network scope.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on network incidents and produce technical reports with follow-up recommendations.
  • Proactively propose network design improvements to support business growth and performance.
  • Support the development and maintenance of the network monitoring and performance reporting platform.
  • Serve as a technical reference and mentor for more junior team members within the network domain.
  • Collaborate with peering teams (Application, Identity, Operations) to align technical initiatives.

About You

  • Bachelor's (S1) or Master's (S2) degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or another science major.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience managing medium to large scale office networks, preferably involving multiple sites/locations.
  • Deep mastery of the common network stack, routing protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF), switching (VLAN, STP, link aggregation), wireless networking, and QoS management, as well as network monitoring tools (e.g., SNMP, NetFlow).
  • Experience configuring firewalls and implementing other network security measures (e.g., firewall policies, IPsec/SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, network segmentation, RADIUS/802.1X).
  • Hands-on experience (configuration & operations) with Cisco, UniFi, and Fortigate devices covering both firewalls and network equipment (switches, access points, routers) from these vendors.
  • Ability to work independently and translate technical requirements into detailed implementation solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and report-writing skills, including Cost-Benefit Analysis and Root Cause Analysis.
  • Effective communication in English and Bahasa Indonesia, including with audiences from diverse cultural backgrounds.
  • Willingness to travel (preferably within Southeast Asia) to support the infrastructure development of regional office sites.
  • Able to collaborate effectively with stakeholders, in both project and day-to-day operational contexts.
  • Able to communicate and explain technical matters in non-technical language to non-technical users/stakeholders.
  • Able to build and maintain strong working relationships and communication with vendors to ensure project success.

description_html:
Company Overview

We value passionate individuals who challenge the norm, deliver world-class solutions and bring diverse perspectives. Join our team, and together we will make a difference and change the world.

Job Description

About the MCC Compact

The Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) is an independent United States government agency that provides grant-based development assistance to selected countries to help reduce poverty through economic growth. On April 13, 2023, MCC and the Government of Indonesia (GoI) signed a five-year, USD 649 million compact (Compact II), which entered into force on September 4, 2024. Compact II addresses the high cost and limited reach of financial intermediation in Indonesia by improving the financing of transport and logistics infrastructure, expanding access to finance for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), and financing digital connectivity infrastructure.

About MCA-Indonesia II And The Program Management Consultant (PMC)

Compact II is implemented by the Millennium Challenge Account – Indonesia II (MCA-Indonesia II), the GoI entity accountable to MCC for delivering the compact's projects. MCA-Indonesia II is supported by a Program Management Consultant (PMC), managed by CDM Smith, which provides technical, managerial, and administrative support across the compact's projects. This includes work planning, quality assurance, technical advisory input, and coordination among MCA-Indonesia II, MCC, and government counterparts. This position sits within the PMC team and works in direct support of MCA-Indonesia II.

About The Digital Connectivity Expansion Initiative

The Digital Connectivity Expansion (DCE) initiative is structured around three initiative objectives: Objective I (Backhaul), improving open-access wholesale backhaul networks in underserved and commercially challenging areas; Objective II (Points of Interest, or POI, Connectivity), connecting unconnected public points of interest such as schools and health facilities; and Objective III (Shared Last-Mile), extending operator-neutral shared mobile or fixed access to communities on the margins of commercial coverage. Market respondents consistently viewed the three objectives as complementary components of one integrated connectivity model rather than as standalone interventions.

A Request for Information (RFI) process (Ref. IND2-26-50004-INFO) was conducted to gather market input on the technical, financing, and operational approaches to these three objectives. These market inputs spanned Very Small Aperture Terminal (VSAT) satellite providers, Internet Service Providers (ISPs) and system integrators, tower companies, a Mobile Network Operator (MNO), and a backbone provider, and confirmed strong support for a technology-neutral, hybrid network design — fiber, microwave, Fixed Wireless Access (FWA), Wi-Fi, Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) satellite, and VSAT were all identified as potentially relevant depending on geography, demand density, and site conditions — combined with a layered architecture (backhaul, access, and POI/end-user layers) rather than a single uniform technical model.

These RFI findings and the three initiative objectives form the basis for a structured validation study, to test whether DCE can be structured into a technically sound, deliverable program before proceeding to a full proposal by market respondents. A structured Gap Assessment against identified technical and site-readiness assessment — site condition data, technology selection logic, and open-access technical governance — as priority work required to complete it. This position is engaged specifically to identify technical and site-readiness assessment, such as site condition data, technology selection logic, open-access technical governance, and to provide the site-readiness tiering that underpins the Financial Modeler's cost model.

Objective of the Position

To support the Validation Study's assessment of the DCE initiative's technical and operational feasibility by developing a site readiness assessment and open-access technical governance framework, including network architecture logic, site archetypes, and implementation constraints. This work provides the technical basis needed for financial modelling and for private-sector co-creation discussion, supporting the Business Case's recommendation on whether, how, and under what conditions the initiative should proceed to structured market engagement.

The deliverable produces by this assignment is expected to contribute to the deliverable of a Validation Study.

Scope Of Responsibilities

  • Develop clear site readiness tiering archetypes (strong / moderate / weak existing infrastructure) as an interim proxy site.
  • Document the scope boundary as it applies to technology and network design choices, in a manner that supports — rather than overrides — the program's technology-neutral principle.
  • Draft an indicative open-access technical governance framework (network demarcation, capacity allocation principles) as a discussion basis for private-sector co-creation.
  • Provide site tiering and technical readiness inputs to the Financial Modeler's cost structure and model.
  • Draft the Technical Case of the validation study's Business Case document.
  • Coordinate with the Financial Modeler to ensure site archetypes align consistently across the Technical and Financial Cases.
  • Present interim and final technical findings to PMC, MCA-Indonesia II, and MCC, hand over the site readiness assessment and technical governance framework, with sufficient documentation for continued use by the PMC and MCA-Indonesia II team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years professional experience in telecommunications network engineering, covering backhaul technologies (fiber, microwave, satellite/VSAT/LEO/GEO) and access-layer technologies (FWA, Wi-Fi, mobile broadband).
  • Demonstrated experience assessing site and network readiness in underserved or rural areas, including translating incomplete or proxy data into practical technical categories, such as site archetypes or readiness tiers.
  • Ability to draft clear, decision-oriented technical narratives and frameworks for both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior government stakeholders and private-sector participants.
  • Familiarity with base transceiver station (BTS)/tower infrastructure condition assessment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant professional certification (e.g., Cisco Certified Network Associate/Professional (CCNA/CCNP), or equivalent network engineering certification).

Amount Of Travel Required

10% or less

Background Check and Drug Testing Information

In addition, CDM Smith may conduct drug testing for designated positions. Background checks are conducted after an offer of employment has been made in the United States. The timing of when background checks will be conducted on candidates for positions outside the United States will vary based on country statutory law but in no case, will the background check precede an interview. CDM Smith will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate. Additional Pay Range Information
