name: ENGINEER, NETWORK ENGINEERING
description_html:
The Role

Responsible for designing, implementing, configuring, maintaining, and supporting network infrastructure solutions for customers to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing network environments. This role encompasses the deployment, administration, monitoring, and optimization of LAN, WAN, wireless networks, routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and related network technologies to meet customer business requirements. The role also supports technical demonstrations, proof of concepts (POCs), and solution validation where required. Working closely with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders, the role provides technical expertise throughout the solution lifecycle, ensuring successful implementation, timely issue resolution, optimal network performance, and compliance with security best practices and industry standards.

Key Accountabilities

Design, implement, configure, and maintain network infrastructure solutions.

  • Install, configure, and support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and related network devices.
  • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity, routing, switching, and security issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve network connectivity, routing, switching, wireless, and security-related issues.
  • Configure and manage network services, including TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, NAT, and routing protocols.
  • Implement network security best practices, including firewall policies, secure remote access, network segmentation, and access control.
  • Perform network upgrades, firmware updates, configuration backups, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Monitor network health and recommend improvements to enhance performance, availability, scalability, and reliability.
  • Prepare and maintain network diagrams, configuration documentation, and technical reports.
  • Work closely with customers, channel partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver successful implementation, migration, and deployment projects.
  • Provide technical support during project implementation, post-deployment, and post-sales activities, ensuring timely resolution of customer issues within agreed service levels.
  • Participate in technical workshops, product demonstrations, Proof of Concept (POC) activities, and customer presentations when required.
  • Ensure network solutions comply with customer requirements, service level agreements (SLAs), and organizational security standards.
  • Stay current with emerging networking technologies, cybersecurity trends, and relevant vendor certifications to enhance technical expertise.

Skills & Experiences

Educational:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline. Experience:
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Network Engineering, Network Administration, Infrastructure Support, Systems Integration, or a similar technical role.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, and supporting enterprise network infrastructure.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing environment, system integrator, managed service provider (MSP), or value-added distributor (VAD) is an advantage. Technical Knowledge:
  • Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, routing, switching, VLANs, STP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, and wireless networking.
  • Hands-on experience with networking equipment from vendors such as Cisco, Fortinet, Aruba, Juniper, MikroTik, Huawei, Ruijie, or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of firewall technologies, network security principles, and secure remote access solutions.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring, diagnostic, and troubleshooting tools.
  • Knowledge of structured cabling, network infrastructure, and enterprise networking best practices.
  • Exposure to virtualization, cloud networking, or SD-WAN technologies is an advantage. Skills & Competencies:
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Customer-focused with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Willingness to travel within Indonesia for customer meetings, site assessments, project implementation, technical support, product demonstrations, and Proof of Concept (POC) activities as required. Preferred
  • Professional certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Juniper JNCIA/JNCIS, MikroTik MTCNA, Aruba Certified Associate, or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with Layer 1 to Layer 3 networking technologies.
  • Exposure to cybersecurity technologies, including network access control (NAC), IDS/IPS, and endpoint security.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or managed services environments.
  • Knowledge of virtualization, cloud networking, or SD-WAN technologies is an advantage.

What You'll Do

An experienced individual contributor within P&CSE, the Senior RF Systems Engineer delivers complex hands-on technical work across the satellite ground station engineering lifecycle with a high degree of autonomy. This is a purely technical role with no people management responsibilities and no direct reports. The postholder designs, integrates, and tests earth station RF systems; contributes to DiFi (VITA 49) and RFoIP programmes; deploys cloud-based (AWS / GCP) signal processing workloads; maintains DevOps pipelines and IaC modules; and applies AI tools to engineering workflows. The role includes participation in the P&CSE oncall rota. Candidates must be willing and able to fulfil this requirement as a condition of employment.

The day-to-day

  • Perform detailed RF system design and analysis: link budgets, G/T, EIRP, linearity, antenna system characterisation across L/S/C/Ku/Ka/Q/V bands.
  • Plan, execute, and document FAT, SAT, and IOT test campaigns for new and upgraded earth station RF systems.
  • Contribute to DiFi (VITA 49) digitiser chain design, validation, and interoperability testing.
  • Contribute to RFoIP encapsulation, QoS, PTP synchronisation, and SDR modem integration activities.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipeline stages, IaC modules (Ansible/Terraform), and automated RF test scripts.
  • Deploy and support containerised RF signal processing workloads on AWS EKS or GCP GKE.
  • Contribute to cloud RF data pipelines using AWS Kinesis / GCP Pub/Sub and post-pass analysis via Athena / BigQuery.
  • Apply AI/ML tools to engineering workflows: LLMs for documentation, anomaly detection on RF telemetry, AI-assisted simulation.
  • Provide third-line RF support to Operations and NOC, including on-call rota participation.
  • Produce and maintain engineering documentation (ICDs, test plans, acceptance reports) to P&CSE quality standards.
  • Travel to earth station sites and supplier facilities as required by programme activities.


What You'll Need

  • 8-12 years ground station system design, integration, and test experience.
  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or Telecommunications.
  • Proven hands-on RF expertise across multiple frequency bands with strong link budget and test skills.
  • Working knowledge of DiFi/VITA 49, RFoIP, DevOps CI/CD, AWS/GCP, and AI engineering tools.
  • Seeking a technical individual contributor role with no people management responsibility.


What Will Help You On The Job

  • Fully available for P&CSE on-call rota and international travel. Based in or able to commute to London.

name: Corporate IT Engineer
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000395

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

Corporate IT is the backbone that keeps thousands of Travelokans productive and secure across 11 markets — owning the internal systems, endpoints, networks, and infrastructure that the whole company runs on. From managed services and IT operations to network, communications, and infrastructure, we make technology invisible when it works and resilient when it matters most. We support a workforce that never stops, in a region where scale and speed are the norm, not the exception.

Here you operate hands-on across a real, diverse environment — not a slide deck. You will harden networks, sharpen service experience, and solve problems that thousands of people feel the moment they hit. If you want your work to be felt every single day by the people building Southeast Asia's leading travel super-app, this is your team.

About The Job

As an IT Operations Engineer, you will be a key contributor responsible for the health, visibility, and integrity of Traveloka’s internal IT environment. Your primary focus will be managing the lifecycle of corporate IT assets and conducting log analysis to ensure system reliability and proactive issue detection. Operating as an individual contributor, you will take ownership of routine operations, incident investigation, and baseline automation to keep our infrastructure compliant and efficient.

  • Asset Management Ownership: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of hardware and software assets across the regional fleet—tracking allocation, compliance, refresh cycles, and decommissioning.
  • Log Analysis & Monitoring: Review, parse, and analyze system and endpoint logs (using SIEM, ELK, or native log viewers) to identify anomalies, troubleshoot root causes, and catch operational issues early.
  • Basic Automation: Write simple scripts to automate repetitive daily tasks, such as asset data syncing, report generation, or basic system configuration tasks.
  • Incident Resolution: Investigate and resolve operational tickets and security log alerts, working across endpoint and identity tools to ensure seamless fixes.
  • Process & Compliance Optimization: Audit asset inventory regularly against compliance policies and log data to eliminate coverage gaps or untracked devices.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear asset inventories, logging procedures, and basic operational runbooks for the team.

Job Requirements

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience in IT operations, system administration, or technical support.
  • Proven experience managing IT Asset Management (ITAM) systems, inventory tracking, hardware/software lifecycle management, and compliance auditing.
  • Practical ability to write simple scripts (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) to automate manual data collection or routine administrative tasks.
  • Understanding of basic security concepts, least privilege access, and audit trail requirements.
  • Clear verbal and written English communication skills to document processes and collaborate across regional teams.
  • Degree in IT/Computer Science or equivalent

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

name: Senior Database Administrator
description_html:
Senior DBA :


The Senior Database Administrator is responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, performance optimization, and security of enterprise database systems. This role ensures high availability, data integrity, and optimal performance of databases, primarily using PostgreSQL and Oracle, while supporting complex SQL-based applications in a mission-critical environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and maintain PostgreSQL and Oracle database environments.
  • Monitor database performance, identify bottlenecks, and perform tuning at the SQL, schema, and system levels.
  • Develop, optimize, and review complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and triggers.
  • Ensure database availability, reliability, and scalability, including backup, recovery, replication, and failover strategies.
  • Implement and manage database security, user access control, encryption, and compliance with internal and external regulations.
  • Perform capacity planning, database upgrades, patching, and version migrations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex database issues in development, testing, and production environments.
  • Collaborate closely with application developers, system architects, and infrastructure teams to support application performance and data integrity.
  • Create and maintain database documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to junior DBAs and development teams.
  • Support on-call and incident management activities for critical production systems.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience as a Database Administrator, with strong exposure to enterprise systems.
  • Proven expertise in PostgreSQL and Oracle Database administration.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategies.
  • Strong understanding of database architecture, data modeling, and normalization.
  • Experience with backup and recovery tools (e.g., RMAN, pg_dump/pg_restore, replication solutions).
  • Familiarity with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
  • Experience with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in production environments.
  • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with database monitoring and performance tools.
  • Exposure to cloud database services (AWS RDS, Oracle Cloud, Azure Database).
  • Knowledge of data security, auditing, and compliance standards.
  • Experience in banking, fintech, or high-transaction systems is a strong advantage.
  • Relevant certifications (Oracle DBA, PostgreSQL Certification) are a plus.

description_html:

  • Memimpin dan membimbing tim DBA, termasuk perencanaan kerja, review hasil, dan peningkatan kompetensi teknis anggota tim.

name: Database Architect
description_html:
Job Requirements

Database Architect responsible for designing, optimizing, and governing enterprise-grade database architectures. Ensures high performance, security, and availability of data systems while establishing standards, policies, and best practices to support mission-critical operations and strategic data initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Design: Design and manage end-to-end database architecture including conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, normalization strategies, and schema optimization to support scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Performance & Reliability: Ensure database performance, security, and high availability through advanced query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, partitioning/sharding, and implementation of replication, clustering, and disaster recovery mechanisms.
  • Governance & Standards: Develop and enforce database policies, standards, and security protocols (encryption, auditing, access control) while providing technical recommendations for enterprise data management initiatives such as MDM (Master Data Management) and SSOT (Single Source of Truth).
  • Optimization & Support: Conduct proactive monitoring, bottleneck analysis, and troubleshooting of database systems; provide expert-level support for complex technical issues and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Database certification (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server) is highly preferred.
  • 1-3 years of experience as DBA, Database Architect, or Data Engineer.'
  • Proven experience handling enterprise or mission-critical database systems.

  • Strong knowledge of RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server); familiarity with NoSQL is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with data modeling tools, performance tuning, and high-availability architectures (replication, clustering, backup/restore, DR).

name: CRM & Sales Systems Specialist
description_html:
Who we are

DISPENDIX is a dynamic deep-tech company with products that enable scientists and researchers around the world to make new discoveries in areas such as drug discovery, diagnostics and personalized medicine. Our passion drives us to develop high-tech premium liquid handling instruments for laboratory automation in the life science industry. In 2018, DISPENDIX became part of BICO Group.

Our vision is: To enable and automate the life science lab of the future.

We are looking for a CRM & Sales Systems Specialist (m/f/d) to join our international team. The position is based in Bandung, Indonesia.

In this role, you will be responsible for our web-based sales tools and the business-critical data behind them. You will maintain and improve existing applications, manage databases and integrations, ensure data accuracy across systems, and support colleagues across Europe and the US. Your work will directly impact sales effectiveness, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve web-based sales tools developed in Java, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Maintain and administer SQL databases, including performance optimization, security, access management, and backups.
  • Ensure product, pricing, customer, opportunity, order, forecast, and inventory data remains accurate and up to date.
  • Support annual pricing updates, new product introductions, and ongoing data maintenance activities.
  • Maintain and enhance REST API integrations between sales tools, CRM, and ERP systems.
  • Monitor and manage scheduled data synchronization jobs and troubleshoot integration issues.
  • Build, test, and deploy new integrations when connecting additional platforms and systems.
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues, remove duplicates, and improve data consistency across business applications.
  • Create SQL queries, reports, and analyses to support Sales, Operations, and Management teams.
  • Maintain development and test environments and ensure all changes are properly tested before release.
  • Document applications, database structures, integrations, and operational procedures.
  • Provide user support for colleagues in Europe and the US, ensuring business-critical issues are resolved in a timely manner.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 3 years of professional experience developing and maintaining web-based applications in Java.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for browser-based user interfaces.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
  • Experience with database design, complex queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, JSON, and system integrations.
  • Experience managing business-critical data, including data quality, reconciliation, and reporting activities.
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and standard software development practices.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of existing applications and systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with international and cross-functional teams.

What we offer

Joining DISPENDIX means being part of something big and shaping the future of medicine. We are a fast-growing life sciences company with award winning products and a fun, cool team that is friendly and supportive.

  • Agile start-up culture: being a dynamic and international company and still benefit from a flat organizational structure. We work agile (SCRUM) in cross functional teams that is very progressive.
  • Freedom: There is a lot of opportunity to get involved in new projects and have an impact. There is a level of freedom to take ownership and responsibility and work on projects you enjoy.
  • Development: We regularly celebrate individual accomplishments and develop new skills through training courses. We have a talented team you can learn from and gain hands-on knowledge outside of your main responsibilities.
  • Flexible working: We focus on results not working hours, we want our employees to be as productive and happy as possible. Depending on the position and tasks also mobile working is possible.
  • Team building: Teamwork is a top priority for us! We are open-minded, help each other and enjoy organizing team events.
  • A chance to make a difference: We are in the life sciences industry and our work is an excellent way to contribute to the development of new drugs and treatments that will be used to help hundreds of thousands of people worldwide.

Do you want to become part of our success story? Then apply online via our job portal. Please note that for Data Privacy compliance we are not able to accept any e-mail applications!

At DISPENDIX, we don’t just accept difference — we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. We are an equal opportunity workplace and will always pride ourselves on being a collaborative environment.

BICO leverages a global portfolio of pioneering brands fusing automation, intelligence, and data to unlock scientific discovery at scale in pharma and biotech. With 53,600+ instruments installed in over 65 countries, BICO products, software, and solutions are found in more than 3,500 laboratories, including the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical companies, and have been cited in over 13,000 publications. BICO strives towards the vision to enable life-science labs to accelerate the discoveries that change lives. BICO is listed on Mid-Cap, Nasdaq Stockholm under BICO. www.bico.com

name: Sr. Database Specialist (Contract)
description_html:
HIRING: Database Specialist – SQL Server to PostgreSQL Migration


We are looking for an experienced Database Specialist / Database Engineer to lead and support large-scale database migration initiatives, focusing on Microsoft SQL Server to PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL within an enterprise environment.


Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead end-to-end database migration, from assessment and planning to execution, go-live, and post-migration stabilization.
  2. Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing, execution-plan analysis, and parameter tuning.
  3. Troubleshoot database issues across SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.
  4. Analyze and resolve compatibility differences between database engines, including data types, transactions, isolation levels, and query behavior.
  5. Monitor database performance using AWS tools such as CloudWatch, Performance Insights, and Database Insights.
  6. Diagnose application-generated queries involving .NET / .NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and Npgsql.
  7. Provide technical guidance, documentation, and recommendations to customer, development, and operations teams.


Requirements

  1. 7+ years of experience as a Database Engineer, DBA, or Database Consultant.
  2. At least 3 years of experience in cross-engine database migration projects.
  3. Proven experience leading at least one large-scale, multi-TB SQL Server-to-PostgreSQL migration, including go-live and stabilization.
  4. Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server / Azure SQL, including T-SQL, execution plans, 5. Change Tracking/CDC, and Azure SQL Database limitations.
  5. Strong expertise in PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, including query planning, indexing, VACUUM/ANALYZE, statistics, and performance tuning.
  6. Solid knowledge of AWS Aurora PostgreSQL, RDS Proxy, Amazon EKS, CloudWatch, and AWS database authentication/security.
  7. Working knowledge of Entity Framework Core and Npgsql to diagnose ORM-generated queries and recommend application-to-database performance improvements.
  8. Excellent technical communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English, both written and spoken.


⭐ Nice to Have: AWS database or solutions architecture certification, Aurora Query Plan Management, high-volume OLTP/batch workload tuning, and experience in banking, automotive, or enterprise environments.


🎯 Ideal Candidate: A hands-on database expert who can lead complex migrations, resolve cross-engine compatibility challenges, and deliver reliable, high-performance database solutions.

name: Data Governance Engineer
description_html:
We are looking for a Data Governance Engineer to strengthen our data capabilities with more robust standards and policies to handle our data. This will include defining how we process the data, access the data, and visualize the data. In short this Data Governance role would be in charge to implement how we store the and and manage who can access it, also to create policies around our data warehouse and visualization tools. All these we aim to be as automatic as possible.

About The Role

  • Establish and promote proper procedures, policies, and standards to our data that enable our organization to use data more effectively and efficiently.
  • Propose and establish data quality standards, metrics, and monitoring systems to be applied in all our data stacks and ensure it is implemented well.
  • Work with business, engineering, legal, risk, and other related departments/team to set up our data policies consisting of Data Classification, Data and Dashboard User Access Matrix, etc.
  • Design and set up our Data Catalog to enable the same data understanding and knowledge among the business users, engineering, and other related teams.
  • Promote and communicate all these procedures, policies, and standards to our stakeholder and related business and maintain business flow to ensure our stakeholder could leverage more usage to our data.

About You

  • At least 1-3 years of experience in data fields.
  • Experience in data governance related roles will be a big plus.
  • Strong understanding of data security, data modeling, data quality/monitoring, and data architecture.
  • Experience and knowledge hands on in UNIX and python programming (Spark, Airflow, and other data engineering related preferred).
  • Proficiency using SQL is a must and writing efficient SQL query.
  • Experience and knowledge hands on in cloud data warehouse (AWS and GCP preferred).
  • Strong in communication to business and technical users (Bahasa and English).
  • Experience in documenting processes, data flows, and policies are preferred.
